Title: Club Data Analyst
Description:
This Is What Your Role Looks Like

Are you excited about turning building and facility data into insights that make a real difference to how our clubs run? Are you able to spot a recurring issue in a mountain of maintenance data and translate it into a number a manager can act on? Our Facility Team is expanding, and we're looking for a Club Data Analyst who will help our Facility Department make the most out of data and take club performance to the next level. You'll turn raw club data — starting with facility ticket data (preventive and corrective maintenance) and financial data — into standing dashboards, flagged issues, and cost/impact figures.

Your Responsibilities


Analyse existing facility ticket, maintenance, and financial data (mainly in Databricks) to identify recurring issues, root causes, and cost drivers.
Build and maintain dashboards, so managers have a standing, self-serve overview instead of one-off analyses.
Flag day-to-day issues and anomalies for the responsible managers to investigate and act on.
Evaluate the cost impact of processes and supplier performance (SLA adherence, benchmarking between suppliers, cost-per-intervention on recurring assets).
Write your own SQL/Genie queries and build new views and aggregations on existing data.
Projects: your scope naturally grows as the long-term data-landscape approach makes more club data available.


Who Are You?

You're an analytical thinker who can digest complex maintenance and cost data, spot trends versus noise, and translate them into a clear signal for non-technical stakeholders such as facility managers. You're a self-starter and proactive in flagging issues, without pulling the decision or the fix toward yourself.

Additionally, We're Looking For Someone Who Has


A completed Bachelor's/Master's degree (HBO/WO), in Data Science, (Business) Informatics, or similar.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Databricks/Genie or a comparable data platform.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and a solid grasp of statistical analysis.
Knowledge of and experience with data related to buildings and Facility Management (e.g. maintenance, ticketing, asset, or supplier/SLA data) — a requirement for this role.
Affinity with cost and financial analysis (cost-per-intervention, benchmarking).
Experience independently building your own views/aggregations on existing data.


What We Offer You

At Basic-Fit, it's not just about work, it's about your growth. As a Club Data Analyst, you'll have the freedom to make an impact and develop yourself in a dynamic environment.

What You Can Expect From Us


Learning & Development: Unlimited access to GoodHabitz and LinkedIn Learning.
Career Growth: Plenty of opportunities for professional and personal development.
Work Culture: An informal, international, and down-to-earth environment. We value working together, so we work 4 days in the office, 1 day from home.
Innovation: Your ideas contribute to strategic projects.
Salary: A monthly gross salary between €3.500 and €5.500 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience and background.
Perks & Benefits: Travel allowance, bike plan, health insurance discounts, remote work allowance, and a pension plan (52% contribution by Basic-Fit).
Fitness: Access to our gym at HQ.


About Basic-Fit

Basic-Fit is Europe's leader in the value-for-money fitness market, with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries. We are continuously growing and improving. If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact while having fun at work, you've come to the right place!

What Makes Us Unique?


Work with Impact: What you do makes a difference. We don't just work for our members, partners, and teams—we work with them.
Collaboration: Everyone works together to achieve goals and celebrate success.
Diversity & Inclusion: We welcome everyone into our workplace.


🎯 Apply Now!

Ready for your next adventure? Click the Apply button, and we'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Questions? Feel free to contact Yara van Bodegom at yara.vanbodegom@basic-fit.com.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Insify
We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.

Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. Every product has its own lifecycle, its own risk reporting obligations and its own conversion funnel, multiplied by the nuances of every country we expand into. Most insurers live with that: a spreadsheet per question, a definition per team. We're building it differently: one metric layer that all teams argue from, so that a question gets answered once and the answer holds when we add the next product or country.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

About The Role
You would join the Data & Analytics team, the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on. You would own how a product area is measured: what we track, what it means, and the experiments that decide the roadmap.

Together with a group of analysts & data engineers, you would work with Product & Growth teams on how a small business finds us, buys, renews and claims, and on where that changes as we add products and countries. The team serves groups with genuinely different needs: our growth efforts demand fast signals, risk and financial reporting need numbers that still reconcile months later.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and the decisions about where to invest next are being made on the numbers you would produce.

What You'll Be Doing


Owning how a product area is measured and how Product and Growth decide on it: deciding what success looks like before anyone hands you a spec, and being the person leaders check with before a roadmap call
Designing and running A/B tests and reading them honestly, including when the result is ambiguous
Following how customers move through our products across markets, conversion, drop-off and retention, and explaining why it changes
Fixing how we measure things when you find a gap, in the metric layer as well as in the analysis
Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others




What You'll Need


5+ years as an analyst, with real ownership and influence of wider outcome
Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that ingestion, transformation or 'debugging' the product itself
Have a track record of defining metrics & KPIs yourself, rather than being told what to measure
Have a track record of interpreting the behavior behind cohort, funnel or conversion analysis, not just reporting on it
You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt




Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

Nice to have


Experience designing or running A/B tests and interpreting the results
Experience in B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
Experience with a product distributed across different country markets
Experience with Databricks or dbt specifically




Our stack
Databricks and dbt, with SQL-based transformation. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason from data than about which tools you have used before.

We offer:


Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €85,000 to €110,000
Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves
Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days
Pension. We contribute 6% for you
Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it
Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them
A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks
Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating

Title: Data Insights and Reporting specialist
Description:
In de rol van Data Insights and Reporting specialist bij ASN Bank in Utrecht werk je aan data-gedreven oplossingen die écht impact maken, voor onze klanten, onze collega's en een duurzamere wereld.

Wat ga je doen

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verzamelen, analyseren en vertalen van data naar bruikbare rapportages en inzichten voor CCC en lending. Je bouwt rapportages, visualiseert data in Excel en PowerPoint en weet deze door te vertalen naar Tableau dashboards, zodat de organisatie op basis van data weloverwogen beslissingen kan nemen. Waarborgt dat alle ontwikkelde rapportages en dashboards voldoen aan de geldende AVG-richtlijnen en interne databeveiligingsstandaarden

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden



Ontwerpt rapportages en modellen die complexe operaties inzichtelijk en stuurbaar maken
Data visualisatie: Je zet complexe data om in heldere grafieken, tabellen en presentaties in Excel en PowerPoint
Tableau dashboards: Je vertaalt rapportages en analyses door naar interactieve Tableau dashboards, zodat stakeholders data inzicht krijgen in belangrijke KPI’s en trends
Opstellen en onderhouden van nieuwe rapportages naar behoefte van stakeholders binnen de organisatie
Verint-beheer: Je beheert de Verint-applicatie en vertaalt de onderhoudsbehoefte en wensen van de organisatie naar gerichte onderhouds- en verbeteracties, in samenwerking met de leverancier




Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken in het Team Quality & Workforce Management (Q&WFM), het kloppend hart van onze organisatie. Dit team zorgt ervoor dat de juiste mensen, op het juiste moment, op de juiste plek inzetbaar zijn en dat de kwaliteit van onze mensen en dienstverlening continu wordt verbeterd.

Wat breng je mee

Jij bent analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig: je weet complexe data-inzichten helder over te brengen aan diverse stakeholders. Je werkt zelfstandig én als prettige samenwerkingspartner, en hebt een proactieve houding als het gaat om kwaliteitsverbetering en innovatie.

Verder heb je



HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau
Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring met grote datasets, inclusief opschonen en transformeren van data
Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python/PySpark, SQL en/of R
Ervaring met analysetools zoals Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, Excel of Jupyter
Kennis van datamanagement, waaronder data governance, DQ-management en metadata management




Dit krijg je van ons

Deze functie valt in schaal 9 met een salarisrange tussen de € 4.552,48 en € 6.069,97 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:



Een flexibel in te delen 36-urige werkweek
8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand, op een moment dat het jou goed uitkomt
Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband: 208,8 uur verlofuren per jaar
Een goede collectieve pensioenregeling
€ 750,- per jaar om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen (te sparen tot € 3.000,-)
Elke 5 jaar € 900,- om je thuiswerkplek weer helemaal op orde te maken
Een NS-Business Card en een kilometervergoeding voor als je op de fiets komt




Nieuwsgierig naar de rest? Lees hier meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Over ons

ASN Bank is een toegankelijke en vooruitstrevende bank met oog voor mens, maatschappij en de toekomst. We dragen op duurzame wijze bij aan financiële oplossingen voor onze klanten én aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken in Nederland. Daarbij hebben we bijzondere aandacht voor duurzaamheid, financieel welzijn en goed wonen. Als bank combineren we het gemak van veilig mobiel bankieren met de kracht van persoonlijk advies. Dankzij ons landelijk dekkend netwerk van kantoren zijn we ook fysiek dichtbij op de momenten die ertoe doen.

Word onze collega

Wil jij je sterk maken voor morgen? Solliciteer dan vandaag bij ASN Bank. Upload je motivatie en cv, dan nemen we snel contact met je op. De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en een assessment. Voor meer informatie kun je terecht bij Monique Visser, corporate recruiter, via Monique.visser@asnbank.nl .

Wij werken op een prettige manier samen met een aantal preferred suppliers. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

Title: ESG Data Analyst

EMEA Recruitment are exclusively partnered with an international business in their search for an ESG Data Analyst to join the team.




This is a key analytical role supporting the development of high-quality, consistent and audit-ready ESG reporting across a complex international industrial organisation. You will sit at the intersection of sustainability, data and operations, helping strengthen ESG governance while ensuring reporting meets evolving CSRD and ESRS requirements.




Please note this role involves weekly travel.




Key Responsibilities for ESG Data Analyst

Consolidate and manage ESG data across multiple international operational sites, ensuring consistency, accuracy and compliance with CSRD and ESRS requirements.
Develop and improve ESG data collection frameworks, templates, dashboards and reporting tools to create efficient and reliable processes.
Review and validate ESG datasets, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and data-quality issues to ensure information is accurate and audit-ready.
Maintain strong data governance processes, including data controls, adjustments, documentation and traceability for assurance purposes.
Analyse ESG performance through benchmarking, trend analysis and gap assessments, providing insights to support continuous improvement.
Partner with sustainability, operations and other key stakeholders to align ESG metrics with business plans, budgets and long-term sustainability targets, including decarbonisation initiatives.
Support stakeholders with ESG reporting requirements, tools and data-quality standards, providing training and clear communication as reporting expectations evolve.




Experience Required

Around 3-5 years’ experience working with sustainability information, ESG reporting, non-financial data or a related analytical discipline.
Relevant degree-level education within sustainability, environmental studies, analytics, finance or another quantitative/business-related field.
Good understanding of European sustainability reporting requirements and the evolving regulatory landscape, with practical exposure to ESG reporting standards.
Experience working with complex datasets, including checking data integrity, investigating inconsistencies and preparing information for internal or external review.
Strong analytical capability with advanced Excel skills and experience using visualisation, reporting or database tools such as Power BI or SQL.
Comfortable improving data processes and reporting workflows, including introducing greater structure, consistency and automation across multiple data sources.
Strong English communication skills and confidence working across different functions and international teams; additional European languages are beneficial (Dutch, French, German).

Title: Data Analyst - Entry Level
Description:
At TCC Global, we create innovative loyalty marketing solutions that drive customer engagement and strengthen brand loyalty for some of the world’s leading retailers. Our passionate team delivers exceptional results through precision execution, strong client partnerships, and seamless operational processes.

As a Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics (D&A) department, you will sit in TCC’s client- and stakeholder-facing BI team. You will play a central role in proving TCC’s value proposition by measuring loyalty campaign ROI, analyzing the drivers of campaign performance, and translating findings into clear proof points and business insights that inform commercial and operational decisions. The role carries hands-on tasks across measurement, analysis, data pipeline building, and report development. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to deliver insights, scale campaign measurement, support commercial proposals, and optimize campaign execution through in-store and digital channels. Working day-to-day with Power BI, Azure ML, and AI tooling, you will help shift the business toward democratized, AI-served insights — delivered faster, embedded with stakeholders, and closer to the decisions they support.

The role supports the BI function within the Data & Analytics department, with the following responsibilities:


Measure and analyze campaign performance and ROI; translate results into proof points that demonstrate TCC’s value proposition, in close collaboration with Marketing.
Deliver business analyses that support commercial proposals, client conversations, and internal de-cision-making across Commercial, Delivery, and Operations.
Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests from across the business — turning open-ended questions into structured analyses with clear, timely answers.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
Develop and optimize data pipelines on TCC’s data platform (Azure).
Contribute to the evolution of analytical and AI-served tools (including Enterprise AI / text2sql) that put insights directly in the hands of colleagues and clients.
Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate analysis, pipeline, and reporting work.
Support running solutions — monitor pipelines and reports in production, investigate issues, and contribute to iterative improvement.
Apply data governance standards in day-to-day work, ensuring trusted, well-documented outputs.
Participate in agile delivery ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and share best practices across the team.



Must‑haves: 


1–2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role, with hands-on experience in performance/campaign analysis and dashboard development;
Strong analytical and technical skills across SQL, Python, statistics, Power BI (including DAX/data modelling), and cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure);
Ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments, collaborating cross-functionally, and using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis and reporting workflows;
Fluent English.



Nice‑to‑haves:


Exposure to Azure AI Foundry and broader modern AI/data platforms;
Experience in retail, loyalty, marketing, or campaign analytics;
Additional language skills such as Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, or German;
Strong curiosity for emerging AI tooling and continuous learning across the data and AI stack;
Practical experience with data pipelines, ELT/ETL processes, testing/data quality practices, and software engineering fundamentals such as Git and code reviews.



What we offer:


Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Opportunities for growth and professional development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas truly matter.
Hybrid working model.



TCC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered without distinction of age, culture, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnicity, or disability status.

Title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
Description:
How do you help bol make better decisions?

Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.

The biggest challenge

Advertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.

What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business Analytics

You'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.

In practice:


Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decision
Build and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and why
Dive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely on
Apply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't needed
Use AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagement
Coach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-taker
Write clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problems


Why you can make a difference

You have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.

Where you'll be working

You'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.

Something for you?


Story finder: You don't stop at "revenue is down." You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.
Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.
Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.


Nothing for you?


Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.
Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.
Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.


We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart


29 days: to recharge
Travel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging covered
Pension plan: 75% premium covered
Annual bonus: Based on sustainability goals

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Word jij enthousiast van het ontdekken van inzichten én het bouwen van slimme datagedreven oplossingen? Zie jij kansen om met predictive analytics, AI en moderne analysetechnieken betere beslissingen mogelijk te maken? En wil jij bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data- en AI-gedreven werken binnen Nederlandse Loterij? Kom dan in beweging en versterk Nederlandse Loterij als Data & Analytics Specialist.


Jouw speelveld

Nederlandse Loterij is georganiseerd in drie bedrijfseenheden: Loterijen, TOTO en New Business. Binnen Business Intelligence werken we aan de volgende stap in datagedreven besluitvorming. Naast het leveren van betrouwbare inzichten en dashboards, bouwen we ook voorspelmodellen, experimenteren met AI-oplossingen en ontwikkelen nieuwe manieren om de business slimmer te ondersteunen.


Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, data analytics en data science. Je schakelt met Marketing, Product, Retail en Business Control en krijgt de ruimte om niet alleen vragen te beantwoorden, maar ook zelf nieuwe kansen te signaleren.


Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen er beter onderbouwde strategische en operationele keuzes gemaakt worden. Je combineert scherpe analyses met voorspellende modellen en moderne AI-technieken om complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en aanbevelingen. Je werkt met SQL en Python op ons datawarehouse en lakehouse in Databricks en benut, waar relevant, externe databronnen en nieuwe AI-toepassingen. Zo bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie datagedreven besluitvorming binnen Nederlandse Loterij.


Je scoort in deze rol door:

  • complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar slimme analysevraagstukken;
  • analyses uit te voeren die verder gaan dan beschrijvende rapportages;
  • samen met collega's AI-toepassingen te onderzoeken en toe te passen, bijvoorbeeld met LLM's, Agentic AI of adaptive AI;
  • nieuwe en/of geavanceerde analysetechnieken actief naar het team te brengen;
  • collega’s te stimuleren om meer datagedreven te werken.


Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus Business Intelligence team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. We combineren klassieke BI met advanced analytics en AI. We geloven dat de grootste impact ontstaat wanneer analyses, voorspelmodellen en AI-oplossingen samenkomen in de dagelijkse besluitvorming.


Samen werken, samen winnen

Nederlandse Loterij is dé betrouwbare kansspelorganisatie van Nederland met acht sterke spelmerken. We zijn marktleider, expert en staan voor verantwoord, eerlijk en veilig spelen. Bijna alles wat we verdienen dragen we af voor een gelukkig, gezond en sportief Nederland. Naast een kansspelorganisatie met een maatschappelijke insteek zijn we een werkgever. Binnen onze organisatie werken we samen met ruim 500 toptalenten.


Door samen te werken en samen te winnen, is er altijd reden om te juichen. Binnen het Business Intelligence team helpen we elkaar presteren en gaan we niet voor het eigen succes. Onze verschillen maken ons samen sterk. Sport verbindt ons.


Jouw talent

De mensen die bij Nederlandse Loterij werken zijn nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en continu in ontwikkeling.


Jouw talent is een optelsom van:

  • een afgeronde wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science of een vergelijkbare sterke analytische rol;
  • uitstekende kennis van SQL en ervaring met Python/PySpark voor complexe analyses en voorspelmodellen;
  • ervaring met Databricks;
  • ervaring met statistische analyses, voorspellende modellen of experimentatie (zoals A/B-testen);
  • ervaring met DBT is een pré;
  • ervaring met BI-tools zoals Qlik Sense is een pré. Geen eis;
  • affiniteit met of ervaring in een adviserende rol, waarbij je complexe analyses vertaalt naar heldere inzichten voor de business;
  • nieuwsgierigheid naar de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen AI en de motivatie om deze praktisch toe te passen. Ervaring met generatieve AI, agentic AI of andere moderne AI-toepassingen is een pré.


Daarnaast beschik je over sterke analytische vaardigheden, ben je kritisch op de kwaliteit van data en analyses en vind je het leuk om nieuwe technieken te verkennen. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen uit te dagen en helpt collega's om data én AI slimmer in te zetten.


Jouw score

Als Data & Analytics Specialist bieden we jou:

  • een salaris dat ligt tussen €4.900,- en €6.800,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring
  • een interessante bonusregeling
  • een functie voor 32 - 40 uur per week
  • Voor €3,25 geniet je van een gezonde en gevarieerde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant


Ons kantoor in Rijswijk is in principe de plek waar jij je werk doet, maar je werkt vooral op een plek die het beste past bij wat je doet. Bekijk hieronder welke arbeidsvoorwaarden jij nog meer kan verwachten. Vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact op met Rani Adjodhia, Corporate Recruiter bij Nederlandse Loterij via rani.adjodhia@nederlandseloterij.nl.

Title: Digital Analyst
HTML:
Turn B2C data into sharper journeys, smarter trading and stronger growth.

Lijnden | B2C (Ecommerce, IT, UX & Online Merchandising) | 40 hours | Full-time

At Just Brands, we build menswear brands with character. PME Legend, Cast Iron and Vanguard each have their own voice, their own audience and their own place in the market. In B2C, growth is shaped by thousands of decisions across ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, site merchandising, site experience, IT, UX and marketplaces.

The challenge is not having more data. The challenge is knowing what matters, what it means and what to do next. That is where ecommerce performance, customer behaviour, trading insights and business intelligence come together.

But what really sets us apart is how we work together.

We’re team first. No ego, no unnecessary layers, no endless talking, no corporate theatre. We back each other, speak up, take ownership and keep pushing for better. We work hard, stay sharp and make sure there’s room to enjoy the ride too.

That’s where you jump onboard.

Why this role matters

This is where ecommerce analytics, B2C performance and digital decision-making become commercial impact. As our Ecommerce Performance Analyst, you support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels: Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and Marketplaces.

You collect, analyse and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency. You help teams understand what is happening, why it is happening and which actions will create better results. You are not here to build dashboards that quietly gather dust.

You are here to turn B2C data into decisions that teams trust, use and act on.

What you’ll do

  • Support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels, including Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and marketplaces;
  • Collect, analyze and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency;
  • Build, maintain and improve dashboards for ecommerce performance, customer behavior, campaign performance, trading, funnel performance and channel results;
  • Design forecasting tools to anticipate customer behavior, sales trends, demand patterns and commercial opportunities;
  • Provide performance analytics to senior stakeholders, supporting decision-making and P&L accountability across online channels;
  • Lead department-wide projects that improve data collection, data integration and financial insight generation across B2C operations;
  • Analyze ecommerce KPIs such as revenue, conversion rate, traffic quality, average order value, margin, retention, customer lifetime value, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for Ecommerce, CRM, Digital Marketing, Site Merchandising, Retail, Marketplaces, UX and IT;
  • Monitor digital marketing and CRM performance across paid media, email, automation flows, campaign traffic and customer segments;
  • Support ecommerce trading rhythms with weekly and monthly insights on what is selling, what is slowing down and where commercial opportunities sit;
  • Analyze customer journeys and identify friction points across web shops, apps, landing pages, checkout, content and onsite experience;
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation, including test setup, measurement, analysis and learnings;
  • Improve data quality, tracking consistency, reporting definitions and governance across B2C;
  • Help teams understand the story behind the numbers by presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What success looks like in your first year

  • B2C teams use your dashboards and insights in weekly and monthly decision rhythms;
  • Ecommerce, CRM, marketing, site experience and marketplace teams make better decisions based on trusted data;
  • You identify conversion, trading or customer journey opportunities that lead to measurable business improvements;
  • Forecasting becomes sharper and helps teams anticipate sales trends, customer behavior and commercial risks;
  • Data collection and integration improve, reducing noise, manual work and reporting confusion;
  • Senior stakeholders receive clearer performance analytics that support P&L ownership and better prioritization;
  • A/B tests and experiments create learnings that change how we build campaigns, pages and customer journeys.

What makes this role exciting

  • You work across the full B2C ecosystem: ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, marketplaces, site experience, UX and IT;
  • You sit close to revenue, conversion, customer behaviour, trading performance and P&L decisions;
  • You influence both commercial performance and customer experience for three strong menswear brands;
  • You work on dashboards, forecasting, experimentation and strategic B2C projects;
  • You help shape how a growing international business becomes more data-driven;
  • You turn scattered data into clear direction, which is where the magic gets wonderfully operational.

You’ll probably love this role if you…

  • enjoy turning messy data into clear direction and practical next steps;
  • like investigating why performance changes, not just reporting that it changed;
  • understand that good analytics is part numbers, part business sense and part storytelling;
  • get energy from working with ecommerce, marketing, CRM, UX, IT and marketplace teams;
  • care about both performance and customer experience;
  • prefer impact over perfection and want your work to change decisions.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Ecommerce or a related field;
  • 5+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, performance analysis or B2C data analysis;
  • Strong knowledge of ecommerce KPIs: conversion rate, revenue, AOV, traffic quality, margin, retention, CLV, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Strong experience with GA4, SQL, Excel and Power BI or Tableau;
  • Experience building dashboards, reporting structures and forecasting models;
  • Experience with digital marketing analytics, CRM analytics, campaign performance and customer journey analysis;
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, CRO or UX analytics is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect commercial, financial and customer data;
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving retail or ecommerce environment;
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Fluent English; Dutch or German is a plus.

What Just Brands is really like

We’re team first. In B2C, that means we challenge assumptions with data, keep conversations sharp and turn insight into action. No ego. Just practical collaboration, honest decisions and a team that likes improving what actually matters.

You’ll Join a Company Where

  • People help each other out;
  • Ideas and people matter more than job titles;
  • Hard work matters, and so does enjoying the ride;
  • If something can be better, we improve it.

What you get

  • Salary depending on experience and background;
  • End-of-year bonus equal to one gross monthly salary;
  • Healthy and varied lunch every day;
  • Exclusive access to our own Gym, including classes such as boxing, yoga and padel;
  • Parties and drinks that will be talked about for years to come;
  • Staff discount on our clothing.

Position Title:Commercial Analyst

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 44045

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

McCain feeds the world — from the fries in your favorite restaurant to the snacks in your freezer. Behind every commercial decision we make sits a question only data can answer: Where are we winning? Where are we losing? What should we do next? That's the work of this role.

You'll be the analytics partner to our QSR channel team, supporting the largest customer relationships in global foodservice. You’ll have access to our syndicated data, and rely on your creativity and skills to source new data. Your dashboards and analyses won't sit on a shelf; they'll shape how we work with customers, set targets, and place bets for the years ahead.

What You’ll Be Doing.


Sit with QSR sales leads to understand their growth plans, then build the data products (dashboards, deep-dives, scorecards) that let them track and act on those plans week to week.
Stitch together internal data (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) with syndicated sources (Datassential, Technomic, Circana/NielsenIQ) to answer questions.
Design semantic models in Power BI that hold up under real stakeholder use — clean DAX, performant Power Query, and reporting that people genuinely return to.
Draw on field and customer conversations to bring broader context to the analysis, so the story explains not just what happened but why
Lead the evaluation and onboarding of new third-party data sources when the existing stack can't answer the question.
Partner with IT and other Commercial Analytics teams so the solutions you build plug into the broader McCain data ecosystem rather than becoming one-off islands.
Translate analysis into story — the kind that lands in a customer meeting, not just a quarterly review.


What You’ll Need To Be Successful.


3+ years in a data analyst, BI developer, or commercial analytics role, working directly with sales, customer, or commercial datasets.
Power BI at a builder level — you've designed and maintained semantic models that other people depend on, not only consumed dashboards someone else built.
Strong DAX — comfortable writing time intelligence, iterators, and context-aware measures; can diagnose and fix a slow or incorrect calculation.
Data modeling fundamentals — star schema, fact/dimension design, handling slowly changing data, and knowing when to push logic upstream vs. into the model.
Comfort working across multiple source systems (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) and a bias toward fixing data quality at the source rather than patching it in the visual layer.
Experience with AI development tools and comfort using GPT tools to write and debug code
Commercial business acumen — you can translate a stakeholder's vague ask ("we want to understand the customer better") into a concrete analytical plan, and you push back when the data won't support the conclusion they're hoping for.
Communication and data storytelling — you can present an analysis to non-technical leaders, defend the methodology, and make the "so what" land.
Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline — or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Preferred / strong plus
SQL — can read, write, and validate queries independently (joins, window functions, CTEs). You use it to check whether the data is telling the truth before publishing a report.
Experience in CPG, retail, or foodservice — especially supporting a QSR, grocery, or large-customer channel.
Hands-on work with syndicated industry data: Datassential, Technomic, Circana (IRI), NielsenIQ, or similar foodservice panels.
Working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP (ECC or S/4HANA), and Databricks — or comparable enterprise source systems and lakehouse platforms.
Experience working in a global or matrixed organization, with comfort navigating multiple stakeholders across regions and functions.
Exposure to Python or PySpark for data prep and analysis beyond what Power Query handles efficiently.
Familiarity with version control (Git), Power BI deployment pipelines, or other practices that bring engineering discipline to BI work.
Knowledge of the UK / European retail or foodservice landscape.

Benefits Of The Role.


Real customers, real decisions. You're not building reports for the sake of it. The QSR channel is one of McCain's most strategic, and your work is read by our top leaders.
Scope to build, not just maintain. This isn't a ticket-queue analyst role. You'll have room to choose tools, propose new data sources, and shape how we measure commercial performance in GB&I and Europe.
A data team that takes the craft seriously. You'll join a Global Commercial Analytics function that invests in modern tooling (Power BI, Databricks), values clean semantic modeling, and treats analysts as partners to the business — not order-takers.

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Wij zijn Klimaatroute: hét energieadviesbureau van Nederland. Elke dag helpen wij bewoners en ondernemers om hun woning, bedrijf of sportvereniging te verduurzamen. Dat doen we met persoonlijke aandacht, praktisch advies en resultaatgerichte begeleiding. Zo maken we verduurzaming haalbaar én toegankelijk voor iedereen.



De energie- en duurzaamheidssector ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. We voeren steeds meer complexe verduurzamingsprogramma’s uit, verwerken grote hoeveelheden data en ondersteunen opdrachtgevers die behoefte hebben aan betrouwbare inzichten en verantwoording. Juist daarom is een sterk datalandschap onmisbaar en zoeken wij versterking.

Als Data Analist werk je aan uiteenlopende verduurzamingsprogramma's die dagelijks grote hoeveelheden data genereren. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van informatiebehoeften naar betrouwbare data-oplossingen én voor de realisatie daarvan, van bron tot dashboard.


Je helpt collega's uit Finance, Operations en Commercie om hun vraagstukken scherp te krijgen en zorgt ervoor dat requirements helder en eenduidig worden gedefinieerd. Vervolgens vertaal je deze informatie met onder andere SQL en Databricks naar dashboards en rapportages die collega's helpen betere beslissingen te nemen en meer inzicht te krijgen in onze prestaties, projecten en maatschappelijke impact.



Binnen een klein en betrokken team krijg je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om het data- en analyticslandschap van Klimaatroute verder vorm te geven. Je hebt daarbij directe invloed op technische keuzes, architectuur en de manier waarop data binnen de organisatie wordt ingezet. Tegelijkertijd kun je terugvallen op de kennis, expertise en schaal van het centrale datateam binnen Essent. Zo combineer je de slagkracht van een kleine organisatie met de ontwikkelmogelijkheden en vakkennis van een grote speler.
Data Engineering & Analytics

  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van datamodellen binnen het datawarehouse;
  • Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van ETL-processen, data-integraties en datamappings;
  • Werken met SQL, Databricks, dbt en Power BI om data toegankelijk, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar te maken;
  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards, rapportages en analyses voor management en operatie;
  • Bewaken en verbeteren van de prestaties, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van data-oplossingen;
  • Controleren van databronnen op beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en bruikbaarheid;
  • Zorgen voor consistente definities, betrouwbare rapportages en een duurzame datastructuur gebaseerd op principes als herbruikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en een single source of truth.

Business & Samenwerking


  • Ophalen en vertalen van informatiebehoeften vanuit verschillende afdelingen binnen Klimaatroute;
  • Doorvragen op doelstellingen, KPI-definities en besluitvormingsbehoeften om vraagstukken en requirements scherp te krijgen;
  • Adviseren van stakeholders over data-oplossingen, inzichten en de toegevoegde waarde van nieuwe verzoeken;
  • Signaleren van overlap met bestaande dashboards, rapportages en data-oplossingen;
  • Samenwerken met collega's binnen Klimaatroute en het centrale datateam van Essent.
Jij bent een ervaren Data Analist die energie krijgt van bouwen en complexe vraagstukken vertaalt naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je de behoefte achter een vraagstuk en weet je technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor collega's buiten IT. Je durft kritisch door te vragen, neemt eigenaarschap en bent niet bang om een verzoek uit te dagen als dat leidt tot een betere oplossing.


Verder beschik je over:
  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie;
  • Sterke kennis van SQL en ervaring met tools zoals Databricks en Microsoft Fabric (ervaring met Python is een pré);
  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van schaalbare data-oplossingen en kennis van data-architectuurprincipes en datamodellering;
  • Ervaring met het ophalen, analyseren en structureren van requirements binnen een businessomgeving;
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om technische vraagstukken en oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-technische collega's;
  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om zelfstandig regie te voeren op projecten en verbeterinitiatieven;
  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.
  • Een startsalaris tussen de €4.200 en €5.200 per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
  • Een uitdagende rol waarin je dagelijks bouwt aan data-oplossingen met maatschappelijke impact;
  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om het data- en analyticslandschap van Klimaatroute verder vorm te geven;
  • Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de Klimaatroute Academy;
  • Aandacht voor jouw vitaliteit met OpenUp, Urban Sports Club en een leasefietsplan;
  • 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en pensioenregeling via Zwitserleven;
  • Dagelijks ontbijt, gezonde snacks, een verse lunch, teamactiviteiten en evenementen waarin succes samen worden gevierd;
  • Werken aan een groter doel: mensen in beweging zetten. Vandaag voor morgen.
Wij zijn Klimaatroute: hét energieadviesbureau van Nederland. Al 15 jaar helpen we elke dag bewoners, ondernemers en sportverenigingen verduurzamen.



Onze missie: Zoveel mogelijk mensen helpen verduurzamen. De energietransitie is een grote opgave. Die kunnen we alleen samen realiseren. Veel mensen en bedrijven willen verduurzamen, maar lopen vast in de praktijk. De keuzes zijn complex, regels veranderen en tijd, middelen of overzicht ontbreekt vaak. Wij maken verduurzaming haalbaar voor iedereen. Met persoonlijke aandacht, praktisch advies waar je direct mee aan de slag kunt en begeleiding zolang dat nodig is.

Title: Junior Data Analist
Description:
Op het hoofdkantoor

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

Bij Albert Heijn werken is niet zomaar een baan. Het is werk met betekenis. Je werkt in een informele cultuur samen met een bevlogen team dat graag voorop wil blijven lopen en verschil wil maken. Je kunt bij ons flexibel werken, zowel vanuit huis als op ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam. Een baan bij Albert Heijn is niet alleen een baan voor nu, maar ook een stap voor de toekomst.

Wie zoeken we?

Wil jij echt het verschil maken voor onze klanten? Ben jij nieuwsgierig en ga je graag op zoek naar wat er achter cijfers, inzichten en ontwikkelingen schuilgaat? Werk jij graag samen met de business om vanuit je inzichten concrete actie te realiseren? Word jij enthousiast van het doorgronden van nieuwe vraagstukken en het bouwen van data-gedreven oplossingen? En wil je jezelf snel ontwikkelen in een team dat vooroploopt in analytics en AI? Dan zoeken wij jou als onze nieuwe Junior Data Analist Strategic Analytics.

Jouw nieuwe baan.

Als Junior Data Analist Strategic Analytics vertaal je doelstellingen op het gebied van markt- en klantperformance naar concrete inzichten en adviezen. De focus ligt op de commerciële performance en het marktaandeel van Albert Heijn. Bijvoorbeeld: hoe kunnen we groei realiseren binnen een bepaalde klantgroep? Hoe versterken we ons marktaandeel? En hoe binden we klanten aan AH op hun alledaagse boodschappen?

Je analyseert markt-, verkoop- en klantdata om kansen te signaleren. Met jouw analyses onderbouw je hoe Albert Heijn prijs, promotie, assortiment en marketing het best kan inzetten en welke initiatieven het meest kansrijk zijn. Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere inzichten en pragmatische adviezen, en legt ingewikkelde concepten op een begrijpelijke manier uit aan stakeholders in de business.

Je hebt een proactieve houding: je pakt nieuwe problemen snel op, begrijpt ze van A tot Z en bouwt er creatieve, duurzame oplossingen voor. Daarnaast draag je bij aan het steeds schaalbaarder en granulairder maken van onze analyses, waarbij we alle mogelijkheden van AI benutten.

Dit doe je niet alleen, maar samen met de collega's van het Strategic Analytics team (+/- 12 FTE) en in nauwe samenwerking met de business. Hiermee maak je impact op de miljoenen klanten die dagelijks bij Albert Heijn winkelen. Samen maken we beter eten bereikbaar voor iedereen!

In deze functie werk je 40 uur per week, deels vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam (minimaal 2 dagen per week) en deels vanuit huis.

Dit ga je als Junior Data Analist bij ons doen.


Je analyseert markt-, verkoop- en klantdata om kansen en verbeteringen te signaleren voor de commerciële performance en het marktaandeel van AH.
Je vertaalt complexe data naar concrete inzichten en adviezen over de inzet van prijs, promo, assortiment en marketing.
Je bouwt pragmatische, datagedreven oplossingen en rapportages waarmee de business betere beslissingen neemt.
Je hebt intensief contact met business stakeholders en legt ingewikkelde data-concepten op een begrijpelijke manier uit.
Je pakt nieuwe vraagstukken snel op, doorgrondt ze volledig en draagt bij aan innovatie en het opschalen van analyses met AI.



Dit breng je mee.

Als grootste supermarkt van Nederland vullen we met onze 125.000 medewerkers dagelijks zo'n 7 miljoen borden. En als het aan ons ligt, doen we dat binnenkort ook samen met jou als onze Junior Data Analist. Zeker als je de broodnodige proactiviteit en resultaatgerichtheid naar Albert Heijn meebrengt. We zoeken gedreven collega’s, die sterk in hun schoenen staan en ambitieus zijn. Ook heb je:


Een masterdiploma in Econometrics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, Data Science of andere relevante studie.
Gevorderde kennis op het gebied van statistiek, en gevorderde analyse technieken
0-2 jaar werkervaring als data analist of equivalent.
Ervaring met het oplossen van business vraagstukken met data analytics en/of data science technieken door middel van PySpark en Python.
Ervaring met cloudplatformen, GitHub, ontwikkelomgevingen (IDE’s), Microsoft Azure Databricks en visualisatietools zoals Power BI is een pre.



Daarnaast heb je:


Talent voor het meenemen en overtuigen van business stakeholders op basis van statistische analyses en data science modellen.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en presentatievaardigheden.
Een nieuwsgierige en leergierige mindset, waarbij je enthousiast wordt van het doorgronden van nieuwe vraagstukken.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Goede beheersing van de Engels taal is een pre.

Title: Decision Scientist/Data Analyst, Marketplace Strategy Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

We are looking for a Decision Scientist to join our Marketplace Strategy Intelligence team. This team is the data engine behind how Vinted understands and reports on its performance. As a Decision Scientist you will uncover insights that shape our strategy, help set ambitious growth targets, and contribute your data expertise to some of our most important strategic initiatives.

About the team: Marketplace Strategy & Planning domain identifies growth areas for Vinted’s Marketplace in different markets, categories and other business opportunities. As the data team inside Strategy & Planning we quantify and measure our Marketplace strategy, including setting OKRs, defining metrics, and forecasting of our performance. We work on highly visible strategic projects, with a wide range of stakeholders and data sources, and deliver the data products to support strategic decision making.

In this position, you’ll


Collaborate with your team and stakeholders to shape the strategy of Vinted’s Marketplace, working on a variety of projects to identify areas of growth for the Vinted Marketplace, from international expansion to exploring new business models
Contribute to defining metrics and setting targets (we use OKRs at Vinted) for the Marketplace, and track and forecast their performance over time.
Enable stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights, by creating and maintaining dashboards.
Analyze our internal data to uncover data insights, and translate these to concrete business opportunities
Identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows and reporting processes, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort over time.


About You


2+ years working experience working as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Product Analyst or a Strategic role with a strong data component
Highly business-oriented and affinity with online marketplaces
Strong in analytical thinking and problem-solving, detail-oriented and know how to balance analytical rigor with business impact.
Experience in SQL and Python for data analysis, experience with dashboarding tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.). Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is a plus.
Strong interpersonal skills and a good and pro-active communicator who can present complex topics clearly and persuasively to different audiences and stakeholders
Comfortable in a high-paced, high-stakes environment. You deal well with ambiguity and learn quickly, and are inspired by our mission.


Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€53.900—€72.900 EUR

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns – wir suchen ab sofort Verstärkung in Vollzeit an unserem Firmensitz in Ostfildern-Kemnat.




Sie denken in Zusammenhängen und möchten mit Daten echte Mehrwerte schaffen? Dann erwartet Sie bei uns eine spannende Aufgabe. In dieser Position analysieren Sie Unternehmens- und Produktionsdaten, leiten daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab und tragen aktiv zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse bei.




Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

Description:
Job Description

Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare and cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® – recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.

The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth.

To strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a

Sustainability Data Analyst (f/m/d)

Your Role


Collaborate with business stakeholders and leadership teams to gather requirements, develop, and support data modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders
Integrate different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data consistency, accuracy and reliability
Conduct business analysis activities to understand business user requirements and translate data and information flows within business processes
Analyze sustainability, quality and regulatory data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support informed decision-making in sustainability initiatives
Perform data profiling, validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of enterprise data
Maintain data quality standards and enforce data governance policies, standards and best practices
Maintain clear documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and contribution to improved data modeling and governance


Your Profile


Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
Proven experience with Power BI, Power Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer
Good communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data visualization


Your Perks


An interesting position with an attractive company – recognized as a “top employer” by kununu
Free parking spaces directly next to the office and good public transport connections
Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free
Company fitness via “EGYM Wellpass”
Bicycle leasing via “JobRad”
EAP (mental support for employees)
Learning platforms such as “GoodHabitz” and “Learn TTI” for your professional development
Special employee benefits via “Family & Friends” and additional corporate benefit

We look forward to getting to know you!

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Firma: Unfallkasse Baden-Württemberg - Business Intelligence Analyst (m/w/d)

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir unbefristet für unseren Standort in Stuttgart oder Karlsruhe einen Business Intelligence Analyst (m/w/d).

Sie haben ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen und Spaß daran, aus Daten echte Insights zu gewinnen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig!

In der Rolle des Business Intelligence Analysts gestalten Sie das Reporting im Unternehmenscontrolling aktiv mit – von der Konzeption und Erstellung aussagekräftiger Power-BI-Dashboards bis zur Analyse von Unternehmenskennzahlen über alle Bereiche hinweg. Sie arbeiten eng mit Fachabteilungen zusammen, entwickeln neue Perspektiven auf unsere Daten und liefern die Grundlage für fundierte Entscheidungen im Management.

Was Sie von uns erwarten können:


Eine interessante, abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit großem Entscheidungsspielraum
Eine unbefristete und krisensichere Anstellung in der EG 10 TVöD - VKA ( Stufe 1 bis 6, abhängig von der einschlägigen Berufserfahrung) bzw. für DO-Angestellte A11 LBesO BW, Jahressonderzahlungen und Leistungsprämie
Flexible Arbeitszeiten (zwischen 6 und 20 Uhr) bei einer 39-Stunden-Woche zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie
Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr, zusätzlich Weihnachten und Silvester arbeitsfrei
40 Euro-Zuschuss zum DeutschlandticketJob
Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
BGM-Gesundheitsangebote
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (Zusatzversorgung)
Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch ein umfassendes Onboardingkonzept
Rabatte in UKBW Partnershops


Ihre neuen Aufgaben:


BI-Systeme & Reportinglösungen: Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Power BI basierten Berichtswesens der UKBW
Koordination externer Dienstleister: Betreuung und Steuerung externen Dienstleister im Kontext des BI-Systems Power BI
Datenerfassung: Steuerung einer einheitlichen Erfassung statistikrelevanter Daten (Kontrolle & fachliche Begleitung / Anleitung der Mitarbeiter/innen)
Statistikmanagement: Überwachung der Erstellung und Lieferung der Gesamtstatistik an den Dachverband sowie weiterer Statistiken


Was Sie mitbringen:


Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor) im Bereich BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbarer Studiengang
Deutschkenntnisse: mindestens C1 in Wort und Schrift
Einschlägige Berufserfahrung sowie vertiefte Statistik- und Controlling-Kenntnisse (mind. 1 Jahr)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (insbesondere Excel, Access)
Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten
Vorerfahrungen und Kenntnisse in BI-Systemen (bevorzugt Power BI) und SQL
Vernetzte, dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit zu konzeptionellen und eigenverantwortlichen Arbeiten
Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Dienstreisen zu unserem anderen Standort (Karlsruhe oder Stuttgart)


Kontakt:

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bitte online.

Bewerber (m/w/d) mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Through gaining efficiency and accuracy, this position will enable leaders within the Joint Integrated Air and Missile Defense community better understand and display trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across U.S., Allied, partner nation programs and operational activities.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships with respect to Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD).
  • Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
  • Contribute to impactful work and guide rapid decision-making across IAMD planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Service components to institute common operational pictures to provide real-time data-driven information to enable customers to make rapid assessments and accelerate decision-making cycles.
  • Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
  • Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, Maven, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Apply data visualization through formats including, but not limited to Maven, dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint.
  • Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across the Integrated Air and Missile defense enterprise in the US European Command Area of responsibility through campaign assessments, Allied and partner nation engagements, and operational planning missions.


Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights, specializing in IAMD information.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

  • 3+ years of experience in application development, AI and ML engineering, software engineering, or data science
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex software or machine learning applications at enterprise scale
  • 1+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data to support machine learning workflows
  • 1+ years of experience with building scalable data pipelines, ETL and ELT workflows, or model training and deployment pipelines
  • Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment
  • Ability to code and develop scalable solutions from scratch using languages such as Python or TypeScript
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, problem-solve creatively, and operate with minimal supervision
  • Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats and support project teams to scale, monitor, and operate AI/ML platforms
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience in a professional work environment, or 7+ years of experience in a professional work environment in lieu of a degree


Nice If You Have: 

  • Experience with Palantir tools, such as Foundry
  • Experience with Full-Stack application development for deploying ML models
  • Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including Databricks
  • Experience working on real-time data, streaming applications, or AI model deployment
  • Knowledge of U.S. Joint Force Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) or Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) combat systems, data architectures, Command and Control, and IAMD information concepts


Clearance:

Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Erste praktische Erfahrung in KI-/ML-Projekten, Data Analytics oder Analytics Engineering sowie gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL
Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, DevOps, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Frontend-Technologien, GenAI-Frameworks oder RAG-Architekturen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, ETL, Datenplattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake sowie BI-Tools wie Power BI, Qlik, Tableau oder QuickSight
Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, analytische Ergebnisse verständlich zu kommunizieren und erfolgreich im Team zu arbeiten

Title: Senior Techno-Functional Business Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Advantest Europe GmbH

Senior Techno-Functional Business Analyst (m/f/d)

Böblingen

Aufgabe

As part of our Digital Transformation we are seeking a highly skilled senior Techno-Functional Business Analyst (TF BA) with strong expertise in process & data mapping, requirement & data analysis as well as data quality. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams by understanding business needs and how they fit into the business strategy, analyzing source systems, identifying data integration needs, and supporting the design of scalable solutions and business models. The role focuses on translating business needs into clear, detailed technical requirements while ensuring solutions are scalable, feasible, and aligned with business objectives. The TF BA collaborates closely with the business, developers, architects, and QA teams throughout the solution lifecycle. This role requires a blend of business acumen, technical data expertise, and analytical problem-solving skills to ensure high-quality data solutions that support enterprise analytics and decision-making. This senior role requires strong stakeholder management skills and solid process & data skills. The role will own the domain «product & part» and therefore will work on the interface between product development lifecycle and all downstream processes and where they need part data (downstream processes such as Sales, Supply Chain, Service Assurance). Hence solid experience with modelling process and data streams for product and part processes is a must have for any candidate applying. Title: (Senior) Consultant - Business Analyst Financial Crime Compliance (Financial Services) (w/m/d)
Description:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?

Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.

Unser Bereich Financial Services fokussiert sich auf Finanzdienstleistungen und unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Asset Manager dabei, in einer sich stets verändernden und schnelllebigen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Risk-Consulting-Teams in Frankfurt/Main, München, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart, Hamburg oder Berlin berätst du unsere Kund:innen aus Banken, Versicherungen und dem Finanzdienstleistungssektor bei der Entwicklung von Risikostrategien und Kontrollsystemen, beim quantitativen und qualitativen Management diverser Risikoarten und bei der Umsetzung vielfältiger regulatorischer Anforderungen. Dabei nutzt du innovative Technologien und intelligente Methoden und übernimmst vielfältige Aufgaben:


Beratung national und global agierender Banken, Finanzdienstleister oder Asset Manager zur Digitalisierung der Compliance-Funktion; Evaluierung von Automatisierungs-/KI-Use-Cases und Unterstützung bei der Definition von Anforderungen und Priorisierungsentscheidungen, bspw. im Bereich Geldwäscheprävention, Verhinderung von Marktmissbrauch, regulatorische Compliance oder Crypto Assets Compliance
Optimierung bestehender und Entwicklung neuer Prozesse sowie IT-Anwendungen in der Compliance-Funktion; fachliche Begleitung bei der Einführung / Upgrade oder Konsolidierung von Compliance-Überwachungssystemen, bspw. zu Transaction Monitoring, Trade Surveillance, Adverse Media oder Sanctions Screening
Aufbereitung und deskriptive Analyse (un)strukturierter Daten für die Nutzung in Machine-Learning-Modellen bzw. für die Verarbeitung in Modellen und anderen Algorithmen zur Unterstützung der Compliance-Funktion
Entwicklung von Prototypen im Bereich Machine Learning / Data Science / KI-Modelle inklusive geeigneter Software mit dem Ziel der Übergabereife an die IT der Kunden
Eigenverantwortliche Übernahme von Teilaufgaben in der Weiterentwicklung unseres Service-Portfolios als Teil unserer Financial Crime und Compliance Community im EY Financial Services Netzwerk und externen Stakeholdern (bspw. FinTechs, RegTechs)


Dein Skillset


Erfolgreicher Abschluss in Informatik / Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften oder vergleichbarer Studiengänge
Berufserfahrung in der Analyse und Konzeption fachlicher Anforderungen an Compliance-IT-Systemen, Daten- und Prozessmodellierung, sowie Erfahrung mit Programmiersprachen (bspw. VBA, SQL, SAS oder R), Datenvisualisierungstools und/oder Erfahrung mit Data-Science-Tools, z.B.: Python, Tableau, PowerBI, Azure, AWS usw.
Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und Englisch


Dein Mindset


Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.


Deine Benefits

Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Title: Senior Specialist Sales Controlling (m/f/d)
Description:
Entdecken Sie eine spannende Rolle

Die Position Senior Specialist Sales Controlling (m/w/d) ist verantwortlich für die finanzielle Steuerung, das Performance Reporting sowie die Unterstützung strategischer Initiativen in einem schnelllebigen Produktionsumfeld. Die Rolle verbindet ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis mit Fachwissen in den Bereichen Finanzcontrolling, Projektanalyse und Business Partnering unter Nutzung moderner ERP-Systeme und fortschrittlicher Analysetools.

Die Position unterstützt die Exentec Vertriebsorganisation durch hochwertiges Finanzreporting und strategische Analysen und wandelt Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse um. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Exentec Sales Teams und dem Management der Global Business Lines sorgt die Position für Transparenz, fördert die Performance und ermöglicht fundierte Entscheidungen.

Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Senior Management und bereichsübergreifenden Führungskräften in verschiedenen Regionen leistet die Position einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Steigerung der Profitabilität, zur Stärkung der finanziellen Governance und zur Förderung einer datengetriebenen Unternehmenskultur.

Erfahren Sie mehr über Ihre neuen Aufgaben


Erstellung monatlicher Managementberichte (Finanzabschlüsse, Pipeline-Reports, KPI-Dashboards) unter Verwendung von Standardtools (Tagetik, SAP, Salesforce) sowie BI-Lösungen (Power BI, Excel)
Unterstützung bei der Datenextraktion, -validierung und Qualitätssicherung mithilfe automatisierter Lösungen zur Verbesserung von Transparenz und Datenzuverlässigkeit
Mitwirkung am Finanzcontrolling über Projekte und Geschäftsbereiche hinweg durch die Analyse von Performance, Kostenstrukturen und Abweichungen
Unterstützung der Planungs- und Forecast-Zyklen, einschließlich Budgetplanung und strategischer Geschäftsplanung, durch Datensammlung, Erstellung von Vorlagen und Validierung von Eingaben
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten Stakeholdern zur Sicherstellung einer fristgerechten und präzisen Bereitstellung von Planungsannahmen
Förderung operativer Exzellenz durch die Verbesserung von Controlling-Prozessen, die Reduzierung manueller Tätigkeiten und die Optimierung von Datenflüssen
Unterstützung von Automatisierungsinitiativen und der Implementierung neuer Tools
Erstellung von Ad-hoc-Analysen und Reports für das Senior Management und Global Sales


Zeigen Sie Ihre Kompetenzen


Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Finance, Accounting, Economics oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
Mehr als 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling, vorzugsweise in internationalen Industrieunternehmen
Ausgeprägte MS-Office-Kenntnisse, einschließlich Power BI und Copilot
Erfahrung mit gängigen Reporting-Tools (z. B. Tagetik, Lucanet, Hyperion oder vergleichbaren Lösungen)
Kenntnisse in SAP FI/CO sind von Vorteil
Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (C-Level)
Offenheit gegenüber BI-Tools und KI-gestützten Analysen (AI-Driven Analytics)
