Vi arbejder med nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder og organisationer og løser både faste analyseopgaver og mere komplekse, skræddersyede problemstillinger.

Vi har kontorer i København, Aarhus og Odense og lægger vægt på et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor man arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af teams. Du får en fleksibel arbejdsdag med mulighed for hjemmearbejde, men vi ser kontoret som et vigtigt sted for faglig sparring og samarbejde.

Title: (Senior) Consultant – Financial Services Advisory
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you motivated by working with data, analytics, and quantitative problem-solving in the financial services sector? Do you have 1–4 years of experience from banking, consultancy, or a similar data-driven environment, and would you like to help clients turn complex data into clear insights and practical solutions? Welcome to KPMG.

We are looking for a curious and structured data and analytical profile to join our Financial Services Advisory team. As a Consultant or Senior Consultant at KPMG, you will support banks and financial institutions with data analysis, quantitative assessments, reporting, regulatory data requirements, and the development of practical analytics solutions. The role is ideal for someone with a solid analytical foundation, hands-on data skills, and an interest in how data supports business decisions, performance management, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

About The Position

As our new colleague in Financial Services Advisory, you will work with data and quantitative assignments across banking and financial services, including opportunities to:


Support clients with data analysis, data quality assessments, reporting, and analytical insights across banking and financial services.
Contribute to the development, validation, and implementation of credit risk methodologies and models (PD, LGD, CCF), including segmentation, calibration, parameter estimation, performance monitoring, model governance, and regulatory compliance within IRB and risk management frameworks.
Transform, structure, and automate large and complex datasets from banking processes, customer portfolios, finance, risk, loss databases, and regulatory reporting.
Support projects related to data governance, BCBS 239, data lineage, controls, documentation, and management reporting.
Develop analyses, dashboards, and quantitative solutions using tools such as SQL, Python, SAS, Excel, and Power BI.
Translate complex data findings into clear conclusions, recommendations, and client-ready presentations.
Participate in client meetings, proposals, and internal development initiatives as part of a collaborative advisory team.


You will gain exposure to a broad range of data-driven projects and build a solid consulting toolkit while developing your technical, analytical, and communication skills in a financial services context.

The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate is a motivated professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and communicating insights clearly. We imagine that you bring:


A master’s degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, actuarial, engineering, computer science, or similar discipline.
Approximately 1–4 years of relevant experience from a bank, financial institution, consultancy, or data/analytics function.
Hands-on experience working with data extraction, data preparation, data quality, analysis, reporting, or dashboarding.
Solid analytical skills and the ability to structure complex problems, identify patterns, and draw practical conclusions.
Experience with SQL, Python, SAS, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. Experience with credit risk modelling, IRB methodologies, IFRS 9, model monitoring, banking data and products, BCBS 239, regulatory reporting, or data governance.
The ability to communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and to present data-driven insights in a simple and client-oriented way.


This is an opportunity to grow as a data and quantitative consultant, working closely with experienced colleagues and clients on assignments where high-quality data, sound analysis, and clear communication make a real difference.

This position involves limited international travel activities. You’re working address will be at Dampfærgevej 28, 2100 Copenhagen and at the client’s site. We offer flexible work-from-home opportunities but prioritize meetings at the office on Fridays to be with colleagues.

Why KPMG?

KPMG offers a competitive compensation package, healthcare, fitness, sports clubs, massage on-site, fruit, and canteen facilities.

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals focused on progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Ready to work on data-driven financial services?

Apply now to be part of a collaborative team where your skills are not just valued – It is celebrated!

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we would like to get to know you better.

Feel free to contact Claus Bruhn Bentzen, cbentzen@kpmg.com or Bjørn Larsen, bjolarsen@kpmg.com . We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG.

Title: Bliv analytiker med interesse for kredit, data og regulering i en foreningsejet Nykredit-koncern
Description:
Vil du arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, kreditfaglighed og regulering – og omsætte komplekse krav til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis? Vi søger en analytiker, der vil få en central rolle i arbejdet med myndighedsrapportering, kreditpolitik og faglige ekspertgrupper på privatområdet.

Stillingen rummer både faste leverancer med stor faglig tyngde og mulighed for at udvikle processer, datagrundlag og samarbejdsformer. Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for kolleger på tværs af Kredit og resten af organisationen og bidrager til at sikre høj kvalitet, fremdrift og klare beslutningsgrundlag.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som analytiker.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:


Bidrage til den løbende opdatering af kreditpolitikken på privatområdet og omsætte regulatoriske krav, forretningsbehov og kreditfaglige vurderinger til klare og anvendelige retningslinjer, der hjælper rådgiverne i den gode kundedialog.
Bidrage til løbende at forbedre og effektivisere arbejdsgange, kontroller og rapportering.
Samarbejde med specialister, forretningsområder og øvrige interessenter om at skabe sammenhæng mellem data, regulering og den praktiske kreditproces.
Udvikle og vedligeholde dataudtræk og arbejde struktureret med validering, fejlsøgning og dokumentation.



Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan være nyuddannet eller have få års erfaring inden for den finansielle sektor og være motiveret for at opbygge en solid faglig profil inden for kredit, data og regulering.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


har en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx inden for økonomi, finansiering eller lignende,
har erfaring med eller interesse for kredit, risikostyring og rapportering,
kan arbejde analytisk og detaljeorienteret uden at miste forståelsen for den forretningsmæssige sammenhæng,
kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger klart og præcist på dansk – både skriftligt og mundtligt,
har erfaring med SAS eller et andet programmerings- eller analyseværktøj – eller lyst og evne til hurtigt at lære det,
trives med tilbagevendende leverancer, deadlines og høje krav til kvalitet,
tager ansvar, følger op og skaber fremdrift i samarbejde med mange fagligheder.



Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og motiveret for at lære. Har du solid forretningsforståelse, kan vi hjælpe dig med at udvikle dine datakompetencer. Har du derimod en god analytisk og teknisk værktøjskasse, hjælper vi dig med at opbygge den nødvendige kreditfaglige indsigt. Du får en grundig introduktion og løbende sparring fra erfarne kolleger.

Dit nye team

Du bliver en del af et team på fire medarbejdere og en leder i Aalborg under Kreditrapportering og styring. Resten af afdelingen er placeret i København. Du får en bred kontaktflade til kolleger, der arbejder med kreditpolitik, kreditbevilling, data, risikostyring og myndighedskrav. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og på at finde løsninger sammen. Hos os går kvalitet og ansvarlighed hånd i hånd med en åben og hjælpsom kultur.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, afdelingsdirektør Henrik Hanghøj Kraglund på tlf. 26 86 51 47 eller mail hkra@nykredit.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Henrik Kraglund | LinkedIn.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Title: Group Business Controller & BI Analyst
Description:
Finance meets BI, automation and AI

Do you enjoy working with numbers and technology? Are you curious about how data, automation and AI can make Finance smarter and more effective?

LEMAN is looking for a Group Business Controller & BI Analyst who wants to combine hands-on business controlling with BI development and help shape the future of Finance.

This is a hybrid role with an approximately 50/50 focus on business controlling and BI. You'll work with budgets, forecasts and performance analysis while also building Power BI solutions, improving reporting processes and exploring new ways to use automation and AI.

In other words: you don't just analyse the numbers. You help improve how we work with them.

The role

You'll join our Finance organisation and report to the Head of Controlling. You'll work closely with colleaguesreit in Finance, IT and across the business, giving you a broad network and plenty of opportunity to influence how we use data and technology.

As part of the role, you'll be responsible for controlling activities related to LEMAN Logistics, covering our warehousing operations in Denmark, Norway, the UK and the US. You'll work closely with local logistics directors and lead the monthly performance follow-up.

You'll also support Group back-office functions such as People & Culture, IT and Commercial with financial analysis, reporting and decision support.

Your Main Responsibilities


Prepare and follow up on budgets, forecasts and financial performance
Analyse results, identify deviations and turn data into clear business insights
Lead monthly performance reviews with local logistics directors
Support Group functions with financial analysis and decision-making
Build and develop reports and dashboards in Power BI
Take ownership of the continued development of BI solutions within Finance
Identify opportunities to improve financial analysis, reporting and processes through automation and AI
Act as the link between Finance, IT and the wider business


Who are you?

You have a solid foundation in controlling or finance analytics, but you're also genuinely interested in data, technology and how things can be done better.

You don't need to be an IT specialist. What matters is that you understand Finance, enjoy working with data and are comfortable getting hands-on with technology.

We Imagine That You


Have a relevant degree, such as cand.merc., HD or equivalent
Have around 3–5 years of relevant experience in controlling, finance analytics or BI
Have practical experience with Power BI and SQL
Have an interest in automation, AI and new technology
Understand budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting
Can turn business needs into practical reporting and BI solutions
Communicate confidently with financial, technical and operational stakeholders
Are curious, proactive and comfortable building relationships across the organisation
Enjoy taking ownership and driving things forward
Speak and write Danish fluently and have strong English skills


You don't have to tick every box. If you have a strong Finance background and a real interest in BI, technology and improving the way things work, we'd like to hear from you.

A role with room to make a difference

This isn't a role where you simply maintain existing reports and follow established processes.

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Finance works with data, BI, automation and AI and to see your ideas turn into solutions that are used across the organisation.

You'll be part of an experienced Finance team where you can exchange ideas, learn from colleagues and challenge existing ways of working. At the same time, your role will be highly visible across the organisation, giving you the opportunity to build a broad network and make a real impact.

Why LEMAN?

LEMAN is a global logistics company with an ambition to continuously improve how we use data and technology to make better business decisions.

We believe that good work should leave room for life outside work. That's why we offer:


Flexible working from home by agreement
11% employer-paid pension contribution + 2% employee contribution
Company-paid internet and mobile phone
Canteen and lunch scheme
Insurance coverage
Employee association with regular social activities
Fitness facilities and massage treatment
The opportunity to take 1–2 months of fully paid sabbatical leave
Enjoy a benefits package designed with you in mind: 25 days of annual leave, five additional paid leave days, bank holidays, comprehensive medical coverage, pension and delicious meals. We can’t wait to tell you more in person!
Flexibility: We understand that life is unpredictable, which is why we offer flexible working arrangements, where possible, to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance. You'll have the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits you best – whether that means working from home, adjusting your hours, or taking time off when you need it.
Sabbatical: Need a break from the daily grind? We offer sabbatical opportunities to take extended time off to recharge, explore your passions, and come back to work feeling refreshed and inspired.
Investment in Professional Development: We're committed to helping our people grow and reach their full potential.
Global Travel Opportunities: We're a global organisation with offices around the world, which means that there are plenty of opportunities to travel and experience new cultures.
Social and Company Events: We believe that work should be enjoyable, which is why we organise regular social and company events to bring our people together.


About Us

LEMAN is a global company with deep roots and a modern, people-centric approach. We believe in empowering our colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and inspired to perform at their best.

Every day, we provide customised logistics and transport solutions that make a difference for companies and people around the world. We’re large enough to deliver top-quality global supply chain solutions yet small enough to offer truly personal experience – for both our customers and each other.

Title: Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Annalect, we help businesses across industries make better decisions — from marketing strategies to business development and sales forecasting. Our approach combines deep industry understanding with advanced, AI-powered analytical methods, enabling us to deliver insights and recommendations that make a real difference for our clients. In Denmark, we are more than 70 specialists based in Copenhagen and Aarhus. As part of Omnicom Media Group, we have over 300 colleagues in Denmark and a global network of more than 5,000 experts with whom we collaborate to create the best possible solutions for our clients.




Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team

Are you passionate about applying Data Science in real-world scenarios? Do you want to leverage mathematics, statistics, and programming to help our clients make better decisions? Are you driven by data and analysis, and eager to translate insights into actionable recommendations? Join Annalect’s Data Science Consultancy team!




About the Role

We are looking for a new colleague to join Annalect, Omnicom Media Group’s specialist unit for data-driven analytics and decision support systems. Our work includes analyses that quantify the impact of our clients’ marketing activities and provide the foundation for ongoing optimization. Annalect consists of 60 employees, with 20 dedicated to the Data Science Consultancy team. Our team utilizes mathematics, statistics, and econometrics to process large volumes of data, delivering business-oriented decision support. As a Data Science Consultant, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle for our clients – from data collection and coding, to building and optimizing statistical models in R, and communicating results and recommendations to clients. You will work closely with a project lead and the team, receiving ongoing support and feedback. As you gain experience, you will have the opportunity to conduct analyses independently, manage client communications, and deliver your own projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Collect client data and extract data from media systems
Programming and data processing
Structure, code, and interpret data
Develop statistical models in R
Analyze results and prepare recommendations in close collaboration with a project lead
Prepare deliverables for clients in PowerPoint and dashboards
Maintain ongoing dialogue with clients and media agencies throughout the project
Lead your own projects




Your Profile

We imagine that you:

Hold a relevant academic degree (e.g., Cand.Merc. (MAT), Cand.polit. IMM, AEF, or similar)
Have basic experience with statistical models and methodologies
Possess strong analytical skills
Are proficient in R Studio (or other programming languages such as Python, SAS, VBA, SQL and are eager to further develop your skills in R Studio)
Are experienced in Excel and PowerPoint
Are interested in building an understanding of marketing, digital platforms, and the media landscape




What We Offer

We offer a position in an exciting company with many opportunities. You will be part of a strong professional community and work alongside some of the industry’s most talented specialists. We also have a vibrant social environment, including Friday bars, annual parties, company football team, DHL race, and more. Our culture is relaxed, with room for fun and focus for deep work on projects.




Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position or the company, please contact Analytics Director Anders Mousten at anders.mousten@omc.com.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.


Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. Søg jobbet

Du vil indgå i et stærkt fagligt data og BI-kontor på Danmarks største arbejdsplads. Her skal du være med til at støtte indkøbsområdet med beregning af indkøbseffektiviseringer opnået gennem udbud samt databehandling til brug for disse udbud, såvel som ad hoc-analyser og løbende databestillinger på området.

Som indkøbscontroller i kontoret Forretnings- og Masterdata får du mulighed for at bidrage til arbejdet med datakategorisering, beregning af indkøbseffektiviseringer og dataanalyse på indkøbsområdet i Københavns Kommune. Området gennemgår for tiden en udvikling med øget fokus på at sikre, at kommunens indkøb effektiviseres gennem bedre indkøbsaftaler og aftaledækning af indkøbsområderne.

Du får mulighed for at være en del af driften på området ved at stå for dataunderstøttelse af udbudskonsulenterne og de efterfølgende beregninger af indkøbseffektiviseringerne. Dette omfatter forbrugsdataudtræk, datakategorisering, samarbejde med udbudskonsulenter til afgrænsning af udbud og beregninger af de indhentede aftalers effektiviseringer. Dette vil ske i tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet, udbudskonsulenter og resten af kommunens forvaltninger.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Vi lægger vægt på at finde dig med lyst til at indgå i et stærkt samarbejde med de andre controllere på indkøbsområdet i teamet Analyse og Governance. Det sker gennem tæt sparring om både beregningstekniske og datamæssige problemstillinger på indkøbsområdet. Der vil også være et stigende fokus på at sikre kvaliteten og metoderne for beregningen af indkøbseffektiviseringerne samt forbedring af de faste processer på området. Dine primære opgaver vil være at


afdække forbruget på et indkøbs- eller udbudsområde
deltage i kategori- og arbejdsmøder med udbudsjurister og controllere i forvaltningerne
kategorisere kommunens indkøb gennem fakturadata
beregne de opnåede effektiviseringsgevinster igennem indkøbsaftalerne
skrive indstillinger til behandling og godkendelse af effektiviseringsberegningerne
besvare løbende databestillinger, aktindsigter og politikerspørgsmål på indkøbsdataområdet


Arbejdsopgaverne følger et fast årshjul og kan strække sig over flere uger eller måneder. Derfor skal du kunne have flere bolde i luften, og du vil have gavn af tålmodighed, vedholdenhed og selvstændighed for at løse opgaverne bedst muligt indenfor de givne rammer.

Stærke kompetencer og personlig karakter

Dette er en spændende mulighed for dig, der har erfaring med og interesse for dataarbejde på økonomiområdet. For at løse opgaven kræver det ofte, at man nysgerrigt undersøger data og finder det spændende at gå igennem en masse data for at finde det rette svar.

Som person er du grundig, detaljefokuseret og kvalitetsbevidst i dit arbejde. Du har lyst til at samarbejde på tværs af fagområder og er ikke bange for at være opsøgende.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du har


analytisk sans, er kvalitetsbevidst og har stort fokus på detaljer
gode samarbejdsevner og trives i tværgående samarbejde
en kritisk stillingtagen til opgaveløsningen og er metodisk stærk i databeregninger
en struktureret tilgang til dine opgaver, og at du kan varetage dem selvstændigt fra start til slut
erfaring med håndtering af store datamængder og datakategorisering i praksis
erfaring med Excel, pivottabeller og gerne Power Pivot
kendskab til økonomidata er en fordel, men ikke et krav


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke lige så vigtig som dine tidligere erfaringer. Uanset din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund opfordrer vi den rette kandidat til at søge. Det kan både være, at du har stor erfaring, men det kan også være, at du er ny på arbejdsmarkedet og leder efter et job, hvor du kan få lov til at bidrage med dataarbejde.

Stærkt fagligt miljø med mulighed for indflydelse

Vi tilbyder et job i et stærkt fagligt miljø i en organisation med store datamængder og fokus på at lave værdiforøgende analyser, drifts- og ledelsesinformation. Du bliver en del af kontoret Forretnings- og Masterdata i Koncernservice, som hører under Økonomiforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune. Forretnings- og Masterdata har over 60 dedikerede datamedarbejdere.

Som en del af Københavns Kommune tilbyder vi gode arbejdsvilkår som fx


fleksible arbejdsforhold med gode muligheder for hjemmearbejde
et job med mening og personlig udvikling på landets største arbejdsplads
et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor sparring og feedback er en naturlig prioritet
gode og dygtige kolleger med en åben omgangstone og et stærkt fællesskab


Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst mellem kommunen og den relevante faglige organisation.  Arbejdstiden udgør 37 timer ugentligt.

Hvis du har spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Stine Kærbo Ellehammer på 23 42 92 01.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 20. september 2026

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Title: Reporting and Analytics Senior Manager
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about environmental data and analytics and eager to make a real impact?

Join our Nature Impacts team at the LEGO Group and become a key player in driving our global sustainability journey. Together, we'll shape the future by addressing vital environmental factors. Let's build a better world, brick by brick!

Please note that no relocation assistance is offered for this position.


Core Responsibilities

The primary responsibility of this role is to act as an expert on global data collection and analytics development as well as oversee our reporting responsibilities for our Nature topics - water, waste, pollution, and biodiversity.

You will support our goal to better understand our environmental effects and help to create predictive analytics, dashboarding, and target setting that enables us to achieve our sustainability ambitions. Additionally, you will be ensuring our accurate and auditable voluntary reporting and compliance-based reporting for Nature topics.

More specifically you will



Collect, analyze, and interpret relevant sustainability data, including all environmental factors (excluding carbon) to help promote sustainability practices and areas of improvement throughout the global value chain
Generate comprehensive reports, dashboards, and visualization tools to communicate insights and facilitate data-driven decision-making
Develop and implement effective data analytics strategies and methodologies, including implementation of controls to ensure compliance with relevant sustainability regulations and standards
Oversee the compilation of and manage the process for our CDP report for Water and Forestry and contribute to our CSRD and other compliance-based reporting with our team of experts
Collaborate with teams to identify key performance indicators and establish benchmarks for sustainability metrics for analytics creation
Identify IT systems and tools vital to support the global objectives, collaborating with internal and external digital teams to develop and maintain said systems


Play your part in our team succeeding

The Nature Impacts team sits within the core LEGO Group Sustainability department and defines the global strategies for Water, Waste, Pollution and Biodiversity across the value chain, as well as beneficial actions to carbon and nature that sit outside the value chain.

This role will operate at the intersection of our Nature agenda, Corporate Reporting, and Predictive Analytics

Do you have what it takes?



Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in business, environmental science, sustainability, or another related field is required
Environmental data analytics compilation with one or more sector areas such as chemicals, machinery, packaging, logistics, construction products, electronics/tech
Ability to produce reports (screening-level and ISO-conformant, comparative and non-comparative) and presentations based on the results of environmental data compilation
Experience reporting against large external reporting platforms (e.g. CSRD, CDP, etc.)
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with collaborators at all levels
Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to finding opportunities for improvement.
Proficient in English, written and verbal


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Title: Business Analyst til Tryg Privat
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med dér, hvor forretningsmæssige og finansielle indsigter bliver til strategiske beslutninger? Hos os får du en central rolle tæt på forretningsledelsen og mulighed for at præge et af Nordens største forsikringsselskaber.

Bliv en del af Finans teamet i Tryg Privat og omsæt komplekse finansielle analyser og rapportering til reel forretningsimpact.

Vi søger netop nu en Business Analyst, med stor vedholdenhed, veludviklede analytiske evner og som er mere end almindeligt nysgerrig for at forstå, hvordan forretningen hænger sammen og hvad der driver den.

Om jobbet | Analyser og rapportering, der understøtter forretningen

Som vores nye kollega, vil du få til opgave at skabe et godt overblik over de vigtigste nøgletal i forretningen. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil bestå af:


At udarbejde månedlige rapporteringer, kommentere på og kommunikere økonomiske betragtninger
At udarbejde analyser på salg, salgsomkostninger og præmie udvikling
At bidrage til udviklingen af prognosemodeller og rapportering
At foretage diverse analyser med henblik på at revidere vores indsatser
Foruden de ovenstående opgaver, vil du også have et tværfaglige samarbejde med andre afdelinger i Tryg Privat og intern i vores egen Finans, Analyse og BI division (FAB).


Om dig | analytiske og gode kommunikationsevner

Vi leder efter dig, der har stærk analytisk sans, og samtidig har evnerne til at formidle det komplekse på en simple og let forståelig måde. Du har en uddannelsesmæssige baggrund indenfor økonomi, som eksempelvis cand.merc, HD, eller tilsvarende. Det er ikke en nødvendighed at du har forsikringserfaring, men det er dog essentielt, at du har en del erfaring med økonomistyring og forretningsanalyser.

Du evner at kommunikere økonomiske problemstillinger på en måde, som gør det let forståeligt. Du har gode analytiske evner og en fordel, hvis du både har interesse og erfaring med behandling af data – gerne via Excel og PowerBI.

Vi håber desuden at:


Du besidder et stort drive og er proaktiv
Du er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og tage ansvar for processer
Du veksler uproblematisk mellem detaljen og det brede overblik
Du trives med både korte og længere deadlines, og kan bevare overblikket i pressede situationer


Om os | En del af et stærkt fagligt & socialt miljø

Du vil indgå i et højtspecialiseret Finansteam med fagkompetencer inden for økonomi, rapportering og analyse. I vores afdeling lægger vi vægt på samarbejde, godt humør og en uformel omgangstone. Du får et interessant og selvstændigt job, der i høj grad skal understøtte vores strategiske udvikling fremadrettet.

Søg allerede i dag | Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest d. 22. september 2026. Vi opfordrer til, at du undlader at vedhæfte billede i dit CV.

Vi inviterer løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag. Når den rette kandidat er fundet, afsluttes rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen i øvrigt, er du velkommen til at kontakte Milena Iversen Leder af Finans Privat DK & Forecast på mail milena.iversen@tryg.dk

Title: Strategy & Analytics Manager
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Hybrid)

Salary: DKK 60,000-65,000/month + bonus

Type: Full-time, Permanent




Annapurna is partnering with a leading international subscription-based consumer business to hire a Senior Strategy & Analytics Manager into its Danish leadership team.

This is a high-impact role supporting senior leadership across strategic decision-making, commercial performance and business transformation. * Ability to connect analysis to wider commercial and strategic outcomes

* Highly independent, proactive and comfortable operating with autonomy

This is an excellent opportunity for an ex-consultant or analytically strong strategy professional looking for a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and genuine influence over business performance.

Title: Sales Analyst - Nordics & Benelux
Description:
📍ZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyze change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.

📍 Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5,000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.

About Zuru Edge 🚀

ZURU Edge is the FMCG arm of ZURU Group - a founder-led, vertically integrated business that designs, manufactures and sells its own consumer brands. We do not acquire heritage brands and manage their decline; we build new ones and put them into retail at a speed most consumer goods companies cannot match. Rascals, Millie Moon, Monday Haircare, Daise, Gumi Yum Surprise and Bonkers all compete in categories where execution and pace decide the winner.

📊 Your Role

This is a commercial role with an analytical core. You will start as the person who understands the numbers behind the business - sell-in, sell-out, distribution, promotional performance, forecast - and you will move steadily towards owning customer relationships and the revenue that comes with them.

This is deliberately not a back-office analyst role. If you want to build a career in data or finance, this is the wrong job. If you want to be a Key Account Manager and understand that the best ones are the ones who know their numbers cold, this is a good place to start.

You will work in close and cross-functional collaboration with our global teams.

In this role, you will directly report to the Head of Sales Benelux and Nordics.

📌 Core Roles And Responsibilities


Territory analytics & insight (≈50%)
Own weekly and monthly sell-in and sell-out reporting for the territory — by market, customer, brand and SKU — and be able to explain why every meaningful movement happened.
Track retail sell-through, distribution (stores ranged, TDPs), in-stock rates and units-per-store velocity across retail and distributor partners; flag stock and availability risks before they turn into lost sales or returns.
Build and maintain the promotional calendar, and run post-promotion evaluations: what the uplift was, what it cost, and whether we would do it again.
Support the monthly demand forecast and the regional P&L review — variance to budget, forecast accuracy, and the mix and margin drivers behind the result.
Turn analysis into customer-ready material: category stories, range review arguments, and the fact base behind a listing proposal.
Commercial execution & account ownership (≈30%)
Own a defined set of smaller retail accounts and distributor partners — order flow, range, pricing within agreed guardrails, promotional plan and quarterly business reviews. This starts in your first year, not at the end of it.
Support the sales team on the region's largest customers: prepare the negotiation fact base, build the range and promotional proposal, join the meetings, and follow up on what was agreed.
Prepare for and take part in customer meetings, category and range reviews, and joint business planning.
Drive new listings and distribution gains — in under-developed markets, in growing channels, and for brands not yet ranged with an existing customer.
Work with Brand and Marketing on launch plans, in-store activation and sampling, and make sure product is on shelf when the campaign goes live.
Sales operations & coordination (≈20%)
Own customer masterdata, pricing and article set-up for the territory.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and Customer Service on the order book, allocations, delivery windows and open orders.
Manage new line forms, retailer portals and listing documentation across Benelux and Nordics.
Track trade spend and rebates for the territory together with Finance.


💡 Skills & Experience Required


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
1-2 years experience as a sales or category analyst ideally within FMCG.
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced: PivotTables, XLOOKUP, modelling) and ability to build clean, insight-led slides in PowerPoint. Experience in Power BI is a plus.
Attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data streams and deadlines simultaneously.
Confident communicator who can distil complex data into clear, concise insights for non-analytical audiences.
Structured and analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to travel within Europe as needed.


⭐ What We Offer


Competitive salary.
Regions with room to grow. You will not be maintaining someone else's account base. There is measurable whitespace across eight markets and help closing it will be visibly your work.
Unusual breadth, early. Direct exposure to senior commercial leadership, and visibility across analytics, negotiation, brand and supply chain in one role.
Brands people notice. A portfolio in fast-moving categories, launched and scaled at a pace few FMCG businesses can match


LIFE@ZURU

At ZURU, we have cultivated a high-performing culture that encourages excellence. Our team works towards ambitious goals, learning, performing, and improving together, all while having fun. We empower talented individuals to do their best work every day.

At ZURU, you get out what you put in. You are responsible for driving your own career and we provide the platform to achieve it. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, there are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else.

We recognise that ZURU’s success stems from our people and you can only be at your best when you are looking after yourself. ZURU encourages all our team members to invest in their wellbeing by providing an array of benefits and tools.

🌱 Culture for Growth – a high-performance environment with opportunities to stretch and succeed

🌎 Global Opportunities – work with colleagues and partners across Europe, Asia and the US

💡 A-Player Team – collaborate with some of the best talent in the industry

⚡ ZURU – Tomorrow Reimagined

Title: Retail Performance Manager
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
ARE YOU PASSIONATE ABOUT TURNING DATA INTO ACTION AND DRIVING COMMERCIAL SUCCESS ACROSS AN INTERNATIONAL RETAIL BUSINESS? JOIN GANNI AND HELP SHAPE THE PERFORMANCE OF OUR GLOBAL RETAIL NETWORK.

Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

As Retail Performance Manager, you will play a key role in driving commercial performance and supporting the continued development of GANNI's global retail network. Working closely with Retail, Finance, Merchandising, Client Development, Retail Operations, and other key stakeholders, you will combine commercial analysis with cross-functional project management to support business growth.

You will monitor retail performance across the store network, identify opportunities to improve commercial results, and translate business insights into actionable initiatives. In addition, you will support retail expansion projects, including new store openings, relocations, franchise developments, and commercial business cases, ensuring projects are delivered in alignment with business priorities.

This is a highly collaborative role that combines analytical thinking, commercial understanding, and strong project management skills.

Responsibilities ahead of you:

Retail Performance & Business Analysis


Monitor and analyse retail performance across the global store network, identifying opportunities, risks, and commercial trends.
Track key performance indicators including sales, traffic, conversion, average transaction value, units per transaction, productivity, profitability, and client metrics.
Develop performance reporting, dashboards, business reviews, and presentations to support commercial decision-making.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and target-setting processes together with Retail and Finance.
Translate business insights into actionable recommendations that improve store performance.


Commercial Performance


Partner with Retail leadership to develop and follow up on commercial action plans.
Support stores and regional teams in improving sales performance, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Identify best practices and help implement initiatives that strengthen commercial performance across the retail network.
Work closely with Merchandising, Finance, Client Development, and Retail Operations to align commercial priorities.


Retail Expansion & Business Projects


Support retail expansion initiatives, including new store openings, relocations, outlet developments, and franchise projects.
Coordinate project timelines, stakeholders, and operational readiness across multiple functions.
Build business cases and commercial analyses to support investment decisions.
Support lease negotiations, CAPEX planning, and commercial presentations where relevant.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with Retail, Finance, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, Client Development, and other HQ functions.
Present business insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Title: Lead Sustainability Data Scientist
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
We offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainability data analytics, AI and forecasting at Novo Nordisk. Are you ready lead the development of sustainability forecasting models, scenarios, and predictive analytics to support strategic decision-making. If so, then you might be our new Lead Sustainability Data scientist working as part of the Sustainability Data Solutions and AI Team at Novo Nordisk.

The position

We offer an exciting and challenging role where you will play a significant part in tackling sustainability challenges through data and AI. A key focus will be on identifying, establishing and maintaining accurate data from source-system to final data metrics. The aim is to ensure timely sustainability reporting, delivery of data products and develop our forecasts. In this role, you will play an important role in optimizing the overall data process from the collection of data and all the way to turning it into relevant products.

The position will be working across various departments in and outside sustainability thus, working at the intersection of sustainability and technology, ensuring the development of data analytics and providing decision support. To succeed in this, you can apply a highly structured working approach while collaborating with a wide variety of stakeholders globally and across the business

As part of the Sustainability Data and AI team, your main responsibilities will be to:


Deliver the technical forecasting solution for sustainability, combining commercial data with capacity plans, supply chain and procurement data, and others
Collect data from various source systems, sometimes manual, and identify potential optimisations e.g. digitalisation, AI, etc.
Deliver full End-2-End analytics from business requirement to data source/availability to end product (e.g. front end or model)
Set direction for the application of advanced analytics such as machine learning, predictive modelling and AI models within related to sustainability


Qualifications

You are structured with a strong business understanding from a corporate setting or consultancy and proven data and digital skills. You can open doors, challenge status quo and build business sound analytics. You thrive in a high-paced environment where not everything is a straight line.

The Right Candidate Should Have The Following Skills


Proven track record (+5 years) of preparing, analysing and designing data for analytical purposes in the space of sustainability or data science within a corporate setting or consultancy
A degree in Management, Engineering, Data science or Sustainability with strong data acumen
Profound user experience in BI solutions such as Microsoft Power Suite, Tableau or similar.
At the forefront of understanding and applying AI
Experience in data analytics or engineering through self-service analytics such as Alteryx and able to work in coding languages e.g. Python, Julia or others. Experience working with solutions such as Databricks, Snowflake or Haystack is a plus but not a pre-requisite
Some prior experience working with sustainability analytics, reporting or modelling will be an advantage
Good communication skills


As a person we are looking for someone who enjoys being part of a fast-paced, diverse team and at the same time can work with a high degree of independence. You support those around you and work in a highly structured manner with a clear eye for details. Someone who is proactive and collaborative. You are ambitious and naturally focused on your deliverable. You bring the ability to deep dive into models and also to communicate with those with less technical insight than you. Finally, you have strong communication skills, both oral and written English. The ideal candidate excels at building and maintaining strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders across different functions.

About The Department

The Sustainability Data Solutions and AI team is part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights Department in Novo Nordisk. The team consists of highly skilled data analysts and data engineers as well as business analysts who drive data analytics on the sustainability agenda on behalf of Novo Nordisk. The Department is currently consisting of 7 people in HQ, 2 colleagues in Poland and 2 colleagues in Bangalore, India. We work closely with stakeholders across Novo Nordisk to implement the sustainability strategy across our entire value chain.

Working in Novo Nordisk

Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company with a 100-year legacy of driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Building on our strong legacy within diabetes, we are growing massively and expanding our commitment, reaching millions around the world and impacting more than 40 million patient lives daily. All of this has made us one of the 20 most valuable companies in the world by market cap. Our success relies on the joint potential and collaboration of our more than 65,000 employees around the world.

We recognize the importance of the unique skills and perspectives our people bring to the table, and we work continuously to bring out the best in them. Working at Novo Nordisk, we’re working toward something bigger than ourselves, and it’s a collective effort. Join us! Together, we go further. Together, we’re life changing.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600DKK to 1,091,600DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

For further information, please contact Kim Salling, Director, Sustainability Data Solutions and AI

Deadline

September 11th, 2026

Please note that we will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We will close this recruitment when we have found the right candidate.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for pricing i en international organisation – og omsætte komplekse data til stærke kommercielle beslutninger?



 



Vi søger en erfaren og analytisk stærk Pricing Analyst, som både kan gå i dybden med data og samtidig løfte blikket og se de større kommercielle sammenhænge.



Du bliver en del af vores Commercial Excellence & Execution-team, hvor du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores CRM & Pricing Specialist og en Junior Analyst. Rollen har en bred international berøringsflade, og du vil arbejde med pricing på tværs af organisationen – både strategisk, analytisk og operationelt. 



Pricing er et vigtigt fokusområde for os, og du får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af både vores pricing-strategi, modeller og processer.



 



Din rolle



Som Pricing Analyst får du en central rolle i vores arbejde med pricing og bliver involveret i både den strategiske udvikling og den løbende eksekvering.



Du vil bl.a.:

udvikle pricing-strategi og bidrage til implementering af nye pricing-initiativer
opdatere priser og udarbejde anbefalinger til prisniveauer og approval levels
analysere prisniveauer globalt samt på lande- og kundeniveau
udarbejde og understøtte pricing-analyser, beregninger og simuleringer
forberede og implementere nye prislister samt løbende verificere og justere priser i systemerne
følge op på og rapportere udviklingen inden for pricing
vedligeholde og videreudvikle LOGSTORs standardmodel og proces for indexering
beregne LOGSTOR-indexeringer
bidrage til løbende optimering af processen omkring prislister.

 



En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne bevæge sig mellem det strategiske, det analytiske og det operationelle – og omsætte data og komplekse analyser til klare anbefalinger, der kan anvendes i forretningen.



 



Hvem er du?



Det vigtigste for os er, at du har solid erfaring med pricing og analytisk, kommercielt arbejde – og at du kan omsætte data og komplekse problemstillinger til klare anbefalinger for forretningen.



Du har sandsynligvis arbejdet med pricing, commercial excellence, business analysis, controlling eller et beslægtet område og har opbygget en stærk forståelse for de mekanismer, der påvirker pris, marked og lønsomhed.



Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan være inden for økonomi, business, finance eller lignende, men din praktiske erfaring, forretningsforståelse og analytiske tyngde vægter højere.



Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

har stærke analytiske kompetencer og solid kommerciel forståelse
har erfaring med pricing og financials
arbejder struktureret og har et skarpt blik for detaljen
er selvkørende og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver
er stærk i Excel og komfortabel med komplekse datasæt og systemer
kan kommunikere komplekse analyser og resultater enkelt og forståeligt
kan omsætte analytiske muligheder til et kommercielt perspektiv
kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Erfaring med SAP og Power BI vil være en fordel.



 



Så hvorfor vælge Kingspan LOGSTOR?



Hos Kingspan LOGSTOR bliver du en del af en international virksomhed, hvor vores løsninger spiller en vigtig rolle i den grønne omstilling og en mere energieffektiv infrastruktur.



I denne rolle får du samtidig mulighed for at sætte et tydeligt aftryk på et område med stor kommerciel betydning. Du kommer tæt på forretningen, arbejder på tværs af markeder og får mulighed for både at udfordre, udvikle og være med til at sætte retningen for vores pricing-arbejde.



Du bliver en del af et internationalt miljø med dygtige kolleger og en uformel omgangstone. Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver på vores kontor i Løgstør, hvor vi blandt andet har attraktiv kantine, fitnessfaciliteter og en aktiv personaleforening.



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Karina Pagter Toft på +45 21538694.



Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Som Pricing Analyst får du en central rolle i vores arbejde med pricing og bliver involveret i både den strategiske udvikling og den løbende eksekvering.

Du vil bl.a.:

  • udvikle pricing-strategi og bidrage til implementering af nye pricing-initiativer
  • opdatere priser og udarbejde anbefalinger til prisniveauer og approval levels
  • analysere prisniveauer globalt samt på lande- og kundeniveau
  • udarbejde og understøtte pricing-analyser, beregninger og simuleringer
  • forberede og implementere nye prislister samt løbende verificere og justere priser i systemerne
  • følge op på og rapportere udviklingen inden for pricing
  • vedligeholde og videreudvikle LOGSTORs standardmodel og proces for indexering
  • beregne LOGSTOR-indexeringer
  • bidrage til løbende optimering af processen omkring prislister.

 

En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne bevæge sig mellem det strategiske, det analytiske og det operationelle – og omsætte data og komplekse analyser til klare anbefalinger, der kan anvendes i forretningen.

 

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har solid erfaring med pricing og analytisk, kommercielt arbejde – og at du kan omsætte data og komplekse problemstillinger til klare anbefalinger for forretningen.

Du har sandsynligvis arbejdet med pricing, commercial excellence, business analysis, controlling eller et beslægtet område og har opbygget en stærk forståelse for de mekanismer, der påvirker pris, marked og lønsomhed.

Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan være inden for økonomi, business, finance eller lignende, men din praktiske erfaring, forretningsforståelse og analytiske tyngde vægter højere.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • har stærke analytiske kompetencer og solid kommerciel forståelse
  • har erfaring med pricing og financials
  • arbejder struktureret og har et skarpt blik for detaljen
  • er selvkørende og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver
  • er stærk i Excel og komfortabel med komplekse datasæt og systemer
  • kan kommunikere komplekse analyser og resultater enkelt og forståeligt
  • kan omsætte analytiske muligheder til et kommercielt perspektiv
  • kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Erfaring med SAP og Power BI vil være en fordel.

 

Så hvorfor vælge Kingspan LOGSTOR?

Hos Kingspan LOGSTOR bliver du en del af en international virksomhed, hvor vores løsninger spiller en vigtig rolle i den grønne omstilling og en mere energieffektiv infrastruktur.

I denne rolle får du samtidig mulighed for at sætte et tydeligt aftryk på et område med stor kommerciel betydning. Du kommer tæt på forretningen, arbejder på tværs af markeder og får mulighed for både at udfordre, udvikle og være med til at sætte retningen for vores pricing-arbejde.

Du bliver en del af et internationalt miljø med dygtige kolleger og en uformel omgangstone. Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver på vores kontor i Løgstør, hvor vi blandt andet har attraktiv kantine, fitnessfaciliteter og en aktiv personaleforening.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Karina Pagter Toft på +45 21538694.

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Title: Senior Operations Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced analyst who can take full ownership of capacity planning and forecasting within our operations team, and who thrives on turning data into concrete actions close to the business.

You will hit the ground running from day one and become a key person in professionalising our operations setup.

Over time, the role has the potential to grow into a broader operations responsibility as the organisation scales.

What you will be working on

Capacity planning & forecasting


Own and develop our capacity planning model across all advisors and task types
Build robust forecasting models that support staffing decisions and resource allocation
Ensure we always have an up-to-date and reliable picture of capacity vs. demand


Analysis & insight


Analyse time usage, efficiency and SLA adherence across the operations team
Identify automation opportunities and quantify the potential of specific initiatives
Deliver ongoing reporting to the leadership team


Direct collaboration with operations


Work closely with the operations team to translate analyses into action
Be the data resource that makes it easier for operations to make good decisions


What you bring


3-5 years in a comparable position
Strong analytical profile with experience in capacity planning, workforce management or operations analytics
Solid experience with SQL and data processing, preferably in Snowflake/DBT
Comfortable with forecasting methods and statistical modelling
Experience with BI tools. We use Lightdash.
Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Self-driven and action-oriented. You do not wait to be led.


Nice to have


Experience with Python for automation and modelling
Background from a company with seasonal fluctuations or variable demand
Experience building or optimising operational processes


What we offer


A role with real influence over how Skatteguiden scales its operations
Close collaboration with a strong data team and an engaged operations organisation
Opportunity to grow into a broader area of responsibility over time
Office-first culture in Copenhagen with a focus on professional sparring and community


Lean process


20-minute "vibe check" online screening call with The Hub
1-hour onsite case session with the hiring manager, a team member and product manager
30-minute onsite meet & greet with the CEO and COO

Title: Graduate - Data & Analytics | Autumn 2027
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
How will you contribute to shaping a better future—together?

Are you ready to kick-start your career in a collaborative and high-performing environment? Join our Data and Analytics team at EY-Parthenon and work alongside experienced colleagues on challenging and meaningful projects from day one.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in the Data & Analytics team, you will help our clients uncover the key drivers behind their businesses by combining analytics, technology, and commercial understanding. Working across mergers, acquisitions, and strategic initiatives, you will analyze large and complex datasets, develop innovative solutions, and apply advanced analytics and AI to answer critical business questions and support strategic decision-making.

As part of a Nordic-wide team with diverse backgrounds spanning data science, engineering, finance, and accounting, you will have the opportunity to work on projects across the Nordic countries, working side by side with talented colleagues who will support and guide you from day one.

To learn more about our various teams within EY-Parthenon, please visit our career site.

What We Look For


You have a dynamic, growth-focused mindset. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds who bring curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to grow. How you absorb information and take action matters as much as your education and experience. Varied perspectives make our team stronger.
You are curious and purpose driven. You see opportunities, ask insightful questions, and have a genuine interest in finance, M&A, technology and analytics — with a curiosity for emerging innovations and technology trends.
Graduating in 2027 or have recently completed a relevant master’s degree. We welcome applications from a variety of academic backgrounds. Relevant fields may include Economics, Finance, Data Science and Engineering.
Qualifications:
An analytical mindset and a genuine enjoyment of tackling complex problems.



Ability to collaborate effectively in teams with people from varying technical and personal backgrounds.



Strong communication and presentation skills.



Experience/knowledge of programming language, data modelling, visualization and AI/ML using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude.

What’s In It For You


Attractive compensation package with comprehensive insurance package, pension and employee benefits.
An exciting introductory program, connecting you with fellow graduates across the Nordics.
Personalized support and mentorship through a dedicated buddy and counselor invested in your success.
Flexible and hybrid-working conditions.
Continuous learning and development opportunities, empowering you to shape and grow your career through hands-on experiences and new challenges.


What You Can Expect

If this opportunity sounds like a fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Application deadline: 11 October 2026.

The Steps In Our Recruitment Process Are As Follows


Application: Upload your CV and latest grade transcript.
Assessment: After we receive your application, you’ll get an assessment link within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes to finish.
Video: After completing the assessment, you'll be asked to submit a short video about your motivation for this role.
Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to two rounds of face-to-face interviews, including one case interview. The interviews will take place in November and December 2026.


Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive recruitment experience, please let us know if you require any accommodation during the recruitment process.

Get to know us and follow us on Instagram (@ey_denmark).

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Commercial Excellence Specialist / Analyst - CRM (Hubspot)




What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Commercial Excellence Specialist within our International Vehicle Payments (IVP) line of business. This position is with Corpay One (DK) and is located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Do you want to use your analytical, mathematical and technical skills to help commercial teams make better decisions, build smarter processes and move faster?

At Corpay One, we are looking for a Commercial Operations Specialist / Senior Associate to join our Commercial Excellence Team. This is a role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, technology, business and commercial performance — and who can turn complexity into clear insights and practical improvements.

You will help us create overview, analyze performance and improve processes across our commercial teams. With HubSpot, internal databases and our wider tech stack as your main tools, you will help us improve the customer journey, automate workflows and make sure we work in a more data-driven way. You will become an important part of our commercial organization and play a key role in creating structure, visibility and better decision-making.

You will report directly to the CRM Manager, and collaborates closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership.




How We Work

As a Commercial Excellence Specialist, you will be expected to work in an office environment. Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in our Copenhagen office location.
Company-issued equipment
Support and collaboration from a dedicated results focussed team




Role Responsibilities

Expanding our understanding of our business, customer journey and commercial model
Analyzing data across sales, customer segments, pipeline, activity and performance
Building and improving reporting, dashboards and decision-making material for leadership
Identifying patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities to improve our commercial processes
Understanding and improving how we use technology across the customer journey, including AI, HubSpot, ChatGPT, Aircall, Clay, Fireflies and internal databases
Working with segmentation, prioritization and performance analysis
Turning data and analysis into clear recommendations and concrete commercial initiatives
Presenting insights internally and evaluating performance together with relevant stakeholders
Driving projects across the organization with both commercial and technical teams

In short: you will help our commercial teams — and Corpay One as a whole — reach our goals through data, technology, analysis and better processes.




Why you will enjoy working with us

You will have real impact. This role is close to the business, leadership and the decisions that shape our commercial direction.
You will join an ambitious environment. We have high expectations, learn quickly and like to test new ideas in practice.
You will get responsibility from day one. We believe talented people grow best when they are trusted with ownership and given room to make a real difference.
You will not be on your own. You will be part of an ambitious and fun team that supports each other — both when we succeed and when we learn.
You will work with a product that matters. Our solution removes real hassle and manual work for bookkeepers and business owners — and our customers love it.




About You

We imagine you have a few years of experience from a role where analysis, data, technology and business understanding have been important. This could be from Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Finance, Sales Operations or a similar area.

Most importantly, you have strong analytical ability, solid mathematical understanding and the curiosity and technical confidence to quickly understand new systems and complex problems.




Desired Experience & Skills

Have 3-5+ years of relevant experience
Have strong mathematical, analytical and technical skills
Are comfortable working with data, models, segmentation, funnels, KPIs and performance analysis
Have experience with CRM systems and commercial tools — ideally HubSpot
Work in a structured way and can create clarity from complex data, tools and processes
Can turn analysis into clear recommendations and practical actions
Have strong business understanding and an interest in how commercial teams drive growth
Learn new systems quickly and are curious about technology, automation and AI
Speak and write fluent Danish and English
Likely have a background in mathematics, economics, finance, data, engineering, strategy or a similar field

Your exact background matters less than your ability to think clearly, understand complex connections and use data and technology to create business impact.




What We Offer

Competitive salary of DKK40-45K per month based on experience
Paid annual leave plus bank holidays
Option to buy or sell up to 5 days of annual leave annually through the benefits enrolment window
Pension scheme
Private Medical Insurance
Access to the Gratitudes benefits platform, offering flexible discounts, supermarket savings of 4–5%, and a range of exclusive employee offers
