Title: Analytikere med flair for databehandling til PET's kontraspionageindsats mod Rusland
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du vilje, evne og mod til at tage ansvar for Danmarks sikkerhed?

Vi står for din, Danmarks og Rigsfællesskabets sikkerhed. Vi arbejder med loven i hånden – også i samfundets skyggesider. Det er vores pligt at identificere, undersøge og stoppe dem, der truer vores samfund og demokrati, og dem, som vil os det ondt. Vi er Politiets Efterretningstjeneste – Danmarks nationale efterretnings- og sikkerhedstjeneste. Vi arbejder for dig – vil du arbejde for os?

Bliv en del af indsatsen rettet mod russisk spionage

Du tilbydes en central rolle i at bidrage til PET’s efterretningsindsats rettet mod spionagetruslen mod Danmark og danske interesser – specifikt på ruslandsområdet.

Som analytiker på ruslandsområdet i PET’s Afdeling for Kontraspionage vil du indgå på et operationshold, som varetager en række fremadrettede og bagudrettede efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer rettet mod grupper, netværk og enkeltpersoner, der mistænkes for at udgøre en spionagetrussel mod Danmark og/eller danske interesser.

Efterforskningsmæssig dybde og dataforståelse

I denne rolle vil du have et særligt fokus på analyse og behandling af informationer fra en bred vifte af datakilder – herunder teledata, telefoner og computere samt data fra andre af PET’s avancerede digitale indhentningsmuligheder. Du vil bidrage til at identificere mønstre, forbindelser og trusler ved hjælp af dine analytiske evner og tekniske kompetencer inden for databehandling.

En spændende og udfordrende hverdag

Du vil indgå på et operationshold, som primært beskæftiger sig med truslen fra de russiske efterretningstjenester. Et operationshold i på ruslandsområdet i Afdelingen for Kontraspionage består af medarbejdere med enten politimæssig eller anden relevant baggrund. Du vil som en integreret del af holdet skulle bidrage med dine kompetencer inden for databehandling og sammen med holdet træffe beslutninger om, hvilken retning efterforskningen skal tage for at imødegå spionagetruslen.

Hos os får du rig mulighed for at arbejde med hele PET´s værktøjskasse og bidrage med input til udvikling af nye værktøjer og metoder. Vi er et fagligt nysgerrigt center, der ønsker at skubbe til de grænser, der var gældende i går. Som en del af arbejdet hos os kan der desuden være mulighed for tjenesterejser af kortere eller længere varighed til både ind- og udland.

Om dig

Vi søger en kandidat med passion for og ekspertise i databaseret analyse og databehandling, der kan bidrage til vores efterforskning. Du er nysgerrig på data og besidder evnen til at tænke kreativt, ud af boksen og udvikle løsninger til komplekse dataudfordringer for derigennem at støtte vores efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer. Du er også i stand til at sætte dig ind i og anvende data i skiftende størrelser og formater i efterforskninger, der altid kan angribes fra en ny vinkel.

Strukturering og systematisering af data fra PET’s indhentning
Kvalitativ og kvantitativ analyse med formålet af afdække operative muligheder
Udvikling af nye operative tiltag på grundlag af det analytiske output
Understøttelse af teamets løbende drift af igangværende sager
Koordinering med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere

Title: Økonom til at udvikle og bearbejde finansielle data om pensionssektoren og investeringsfonde
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Du løser opgaver med et enestående formål
Nationalbanken er den eneste af sin slags. Vi er samfundets bank, statens uafhængige rådgiver og landets vågne øjne på økonomien. Stabile priser, sikre betalinger og finansiel stabilitet kommer ikke af sig selv, og som medarbejder i Nationalbanken spiller du en central rolle i at sikre Danmark en robust økonomi.

Som økonom er du en del af afdelingen Finansiel Statistik, hvor vi udvikler, bearbejder og analyserer finansielle data. Finansielle data belyser det økonomiske kredsløb og robustheden af dansk økonomi, og er grundstenen i mange analyser.

Dine primære opgaver omfatter:


at udvikle og formidle data og statistikker om investeringsfonde og forsikring- og pensionssektorens investeringer, risikoafdækning og hensættelser til pensioner.
at være i dialog med danske pensions- og forsikringsselskaber og investeringsfonde om deres finansielle aktiviteter, og at sikre at de finansielle data afspejler de seneste markedsudviklinger, og
at deltage i analyser og samarbejde på tværs af Nationalbanken og internationalt.


Vi vil, at du både lykkes og trives i rollen som økonom i Nationalbanken. Derfor lægger vi vægt på, at du har følgende forudsætninger for at søge stillingen:


Du er interesseret i finansielle markeder og at arbejde med kvantitative metoder og store datasæt. Du kan have relevant arbejdserfaring fra pensionssektoren, investeringsfonde eller med håndteringen af store datamængder, men det er ikke en forudsætning. Vi sørger for at klæde dig på, så du bedst muligt kan varetage dine opgaver.
Som person sætter du pris på at samarbejde med andre. Du formår at løse egne opgaver samt tager initiativ og ansvar for dine og bankens opgaver.
Du har høj motivation og ser frem til en stejl indlæringskurve.
Du kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger og løsninger, og du har lyst til at arbejde med data, fx i SQL, R og Python. Du er også nysgerrig på at benytte Git og AI-værktøjer, fx Copilot, i det daglige kodningsarbejde.


Du er guld værd i Nationalbanken
Der er kun én Nationalbanken. Vores opgaver er at sikre betalinger, føre fastkurspolitik og levere analyser, viden og anbefalinger til gavn for landets økonomi. Dit arbejde og vores vitale systemer har essentiel betydning for det finansielle og politiske Danmark, og for landets internationale relationer.

Vi ønsker at sikre rammerne for en effektiv opgaveløsning, en stor sammenfølelse og en god balance mellem livet på og uden for arbejdet. Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt fra bankens lokationer, men du har også mulighed for at planlægge din hverdag under fleksible former, herunder aftale en ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, hvis rolle og opgaver tillader det. Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på din læring og løbende udvikling af færdigheder. Vi mener det, når vi siger, at din udvikling er i højsædet. Du er nemlig guld værd i Nationalbanken.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Søren Bjerregaard

Chef for Værdipapir- og Betalingsbalancestatistik

SBJE@nationalbanken.dk

+45 33636803

Oplysninger om ansættelsesvilkår kan fås hos HR-partner:

Ronny Schandorph ROSC@nationalbanken.dk +45 33636458

Ansøg nu

Ansøgningsfristen er:

14. september 2026

Title: Business Intelligence Consultant
Company: SameSystem - Retail WFM | Part of ECIT
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
BI Consultant




Please note that fluency in Danish is a requirement for this position.

Due to the summer holidays, please expect a longer processing time.




SameSystem

Are you ready to turn data into real commercial value for some of Europe's largest retail and hospitality brands? At SameSystem, we empower companies like Bestseller, Nike, Normal, and Matas to optimize their operations daily with our cutting-edge AI-driven Workforce Management Solution. We're looking for a BI Consultant who is as comfortable building a clean dashboard as sitting across the table from a customer explaining what it means for their business.

This is a full-time role, and you'll join our Customer Success team in Copenhagen. You'll own the business intelligence and reporting side of our platform: building and maintaining reports in our BI tool, Sisense, and being the person our customers and colleagues turn to when a number needs to make sense. We've deliberately placed this role in Customer Success rather than in a back-office data team, because the reporting is only worth as much as the commercial insight it drives. This role suits someone who is happy behind the screen building things properly, but who does not want to only sit behind the screen.

This is a new role, so the right person will have real influence over how we build, package, and deliver the analytics side of our platform.




Key responsibilities

Building the reports

Design, build, and maintain BI reports and dashboards in Sisense, with strong attention to data integrity, performance, and usability
Translate customer and internal requirements into robust data models and reporting logic
Own reporting quality across accounts, including validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement
Develop new reporting capabilities and scope custom development work as our customers' needs grow




Working with customers

Join customer meetings and represent the BI and analytics part of the SameSystem platform
Talk specific development and scoping with customers, and translate their business questions into what we can actually build
Help customers see the value in their data, and support Customer Success and Sales in retention, upselling, and expansion through analytics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support to feed customer needs back into the platform




What we're looking for

Proven experience building reports and dashboards in a BI tool. Experience with Sisense is a strong plus; solid experience with a comparable tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik) is very welcome
Enough experience under your belt to own your work end to end
Strong SQL and data modelling skills, and the instinct to build things properly rather than just quickly
Commercial acumen. You understand that a report exists to drive a decision, and you're comfortable talking value and scope with customers
Confidence in client-facing settings, presenting clearly to both operational and managerial stakeholders
The balance we keep coming back to: someone who can do focused, hands-on build work and also step into a customer meeting and hold their own
A self-starter who takes ownership and isn't afraid to share ideas. Execution matters
Nice to have: comfort scoping and pricing development work. If pricing is new to you, that's fine, we can teach it
Fluency in Danish and English; additional European languages are a plus
Familiarity with retail operations or workforce management is a plus




What you'll get

At SameSystem, we are committed to transforming retail and hospitality through cutting-edge technology. Joining our team means:

Working in a dynamic environment where innovation drives success.
Contributing to the success of over 185,000 employees across 12,500+ stores in 24 countries.
Access to professional growth opportunities in a company that values expertise and collaboration.
Being part of a supportive culture that prioritizes work-life balance and employee satisfaction.
Lots of social activities and fun parties as well as "clubs" run by employees where SameSystem sponsors going to a sauna, playing badminton, drinking port wine, or whatever else the team can think of.
Lunch and as much coffee, soda or energy drink as you can muster.




If you have any questions about this position, please reach out to Nikolai May Yde at nikolai.yde@samesystem.com.

Title: Marketing Science Analyst
Description:
Are you experienced with data and analytics, and motivated by using them to make marketing and commercial decisions sharper for strong brands in Denmark and internationally?




We are looking for an experienced analyst to join the strategy unit within NoA Denmark. You will work alongside our lead Data Scientist and a team of experienced strategists on real client challenges for leading Danish and international brands.




What matters most is that you can put analytical methods to work in practice, and that you understand the commercial and marketing context they are applied in.




About NoA

The North Alliance (NoA) is one of the leading strategic and creative networks in the Nordics, with around 1200 people across the group. In Denmark, the NoA family includes &Co, NoA Ignite, Bold, NoA Health and NoA Connect.




We bring together strategy, creativity, design, technology and specialist expertise to help ambitious organisations create growth.




The strategy unit works across NoA, supporting its agencies and clients with strategic and analytical expertise. We focus on understanding how marketing creates value for the business, using data and analysis to help clients make better decisions.

The unit is newly established, giving you the opportunity to join early and help shape how we work.




What you will do

You will work closely with our lead Data Scientist and our strategists, running analyses within the frameworks and approaches he develops, and turning them into the data and insights our strategy consultants build recommendations on.




You will work hands-on with both third-party and client data from leading brands in Denmark and international markets. Your work may cover areas such as marketing performance, customer behaviour, campaign effectiveness and commercial outcomes.

Depending on the project, you might:




Build models and pipelines to gather and analyse web and other external data
Develop and test AI- and LLM-based tools for analysing marketing and advertising
Conduct statistical analyses and modelling, including correlations and regression
Contribute to marketing measurement frameworks, dashboards and reports
Explore new data sources, tools and techniques
Work with strategists and consultants to turn analysis into clear, actionable insights
Take part in client sessions and workshops, presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and non-technical audiences




You will own your analyses end to end, with a strong senior team around you to spar with along the way.




What we are looking for

This role is suited to someone who already has experience from an agency, media or consultancy environment, or from an in-house marketing or commercial function. Exactly how many years matters less than what you have done with them. A background in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing or a related field is relevant, but what counts most is how you have applied it in practice.




We are looking for someone who:

Understands how marketing and media work commercially, and what actually drives value for a business
Works confidently and independently in Python or R, and is comfortable with SQL
Is strong at applying established analytical and statistical methods to messy, real-world client data
Can explain analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and hold their own in a room with senior stakeholders
Enjoys working with people from different disciplines
Is structured and reliable, and can take an analysis from brief to finished output without close supervision
Is comfortable working in English




Most importantly, you are someone who gets analyses done — pragmatic about method, precise about output, and focused on making the work genuinely useful to the client.




What we offer

Real ownership of analyses for leading brands from day one
Close collaboration with an experienced lead Data Scientist and a strong team of senior strategists
The opportunity to work on challenging projects for leading brands, Danish and international
Exposure to strategy, marketing, data science and AI in a real client environment
The chance to join a new unit early and help shape how we work
A collaborative culture with a flat hierarchy and room to develop
Great colleagues, high ambitions and plenty of fun along the way




Interested?

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.




Please send us your CV and a brief application, including a short introduction to yourself and why you are interested in joining the strategy unit at NoA.




We review applications as they come in, and the right fit decides the start date.

Title: Økonom til finansielle data om pensionssektoren og investeringsfonde i Nationalbanken
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Nationalbanken er den eneste af sin slags. Vi er samfundets bank, statens uafhængige rådgiver og landets vågne øjne på økonomien.

Som økonom er du en del af afdelingen Finansiel Statistik, hvor vi udvikler, bearbejder og analyserer finansielle data. Finansielle data belyser det økonomiske kredsløb og robustheden af dansk økonomi, og er grundstenen i mange analyser.

Dine primære opgaver


At udvikle og formidle data og statistikker om investeringsfonde og forsikrings- og pensionssektorens investeringer, risikoafdækning og hensættelser til pensioner
At være i dialog med danske pensions- og forsikringsselskaber og investeringsfonde om deres finansielle aktiviteter, og at sikre at de finansielle data afspejler de seneste markedsudviklinger
At deltage i analyser og samarbejde på tværs af Nationalbanken og internationalt


Du har de essentielle forudsætninger for at lykkes


Du er interesseret i finansielle markeder og i at arbejde med kvantitative metoder og store datasæt. Du kan have relevant arbejdserfaring fra pensionssektoren, investeringsfonde eller med håndteringen af store datamængder, men det er ikke en forudsætning. Nationalbanken sørger for at klæde dig på
Som person sætter du pris på at samarbejde med andre og tager initiativ og ansvar for dine og bankens opgaver
Du har høj motivation og ser frem til en stejl indlæringskurve
Du kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger og løsninger, og du har lyst til at arbejde med data, fx i SQL, R og Python. Du er også nysgerrig på at benytte Git og AI-værktøjer som Copilot i det daglige kodningsarbejde


Der arbejdes som udgangspunkt fra bankens lokationer, men hverdagen kan planlægges fleksibelt, herunder med en ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan fremvise straffeattest eller blive sikkerhedsgodkendt.

Title: KMD - Legal Operations Analyst
Description:
RESOLVA bistår KMD med rekrutteringen af en Legal Operations Analyst




ROLLEBESKRIVELSE

KMD søger en analytisk og nysgerrig Legal Operations Analyst, der vil være med til at opbygge arbejdet med Legal Operations, Business Intelligence og Legal AI. Du kommer ind tidligt i udviklingen af en ny funktion og får mulighed for at præge, hvordan data, teknologi og procesforbedringer fremover skal understøtte den juridiske organisation, og du vil arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, teknologi, processer og forretning.




En central del af rollen bliver at styrke anvendelsen af data på tværs af den juridiske funktion og skabe et bedre datagrundlag for blandt andet beslutninger og ledelsesrapportering. Det indebærer blandt andet at strukturere og analysere data om f.eks. kontrakter (herunder i forbindelse med udløb eller genforhandling), juridiske complianceopgaver og andre relevante aktiviteter samt omsætte data til klare indsigter, forbedrede processer og anvendelig rapportering.




KMD har allerede implementeret nye systemer og løsninger, som danner et godt fundament for den videre udvikling af området. En del af rollen bliver i den forbindelse blandt andet at arbejde med KMD's Contract Lifecycle Management-system og bidrage til den videre udvikling af processer inden for contract management og claims management samt til, hvordan data og digitale løsninger bedst struktureres og anvendes i praksis.




Rollen rummer samtidig et væsentligt udviklings- og transformationsspor. Du vil bl.a. være med til at designe workflows og operating models, etablere fælles processer for modtagelse, prioritering og opfølgning på juridiske opgaver samt identificere muligheder for automatisering og relevant anvendelse af AI. Herudover vil du være involveret i de strategiske overvejelser om, hvor der er størst behov og potentiale for udvikling og optimering. Description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for pricing i en international organisation – og omsætte komplekse data til stærke kommercielle beslutninger?



 



Vi søger en erfaren og analytisk stærk Pricing Analyst, som både kan gå i dybden med data og samtidig løfte blikket og se de større kommercielle sammenhænge.



Du bliver en del af vores Commercial Excellence & Execution-team, hvor du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores CRM & Pricing Specialist og en Junior Analyst. Rollen har en bred international berøringsflade, og du vil arbejde med pricing på tværs af organisationen – både strategisk, analytisk og operationelt. 



Pricing er et vigtigt fokusområde for os, og du får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af både vores pricing-strategi, modeller og processer.



 



Din rolle



Som Pricing Analyst får du en central rolle i vores arbejde med pricing og bliver involveret i både den strategiske udvikling og den løbende eksekvering.



Du vil bl.a.:

udvikle pricing-strategi og bidrage til implementering af nye pricing-initiativer
opdatere priser og udarbejde anbefalinger til prisniveauer og approval levels
analysere prisniveauer globalt samt på lande- og kundeniveau
udarbejde og understøtte pricing-analyser, beregninger og simuleringer
forberede og implementere nye prislister samt løbende verificere og justere priser i systemerne
følge op på og rapportere udviklingen inden for pricing
vedligeholde og videreudvikle LOGSTORs standardmodel og proces for indexering
beregne LOGSTOR-indexeringer
bidrage til løbende optimering af processen omkring prislister.

 



En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne bevæge sig mellem det strategiske, det analytiske og det operationelle – og omsætte data og komplekse analyser til klare anbefalinger, der kan anvendes i forretningen.



 



Hvem er du?



Det vigtigste for os er, at du har solid erfaring med pricing og analytisk, kommercielt arbejde – og at du kan omsætte data og komplekse problemstillinger til klare anbefalinger for forretningen.



Du har sandsynligvis arbejdet med pricing, commercial excellence, business analysis, controlling eller et beslægtet område og har opbygget en stærk forståelse for de mekanismer, der påvirker pris, marked og lønsomhed.



Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan være inden for økonomi, business, finance eller lignende, men din praktiske erfaring, forretningsforståelse og analytiske tyngde vægter højere.



Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

har stærke analytiske kompetencer og solid kommerciel forståelse
har erfaring med pricing og financials
arbejder struktureret og har et skarpt blik for detaljen
er selvkørende og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver
er stærk i Excel og komfortabel med komplekse datasæt og systemer
kan kommunikere komplekse analyser og resultater enkelt og forståeligt
kan omsætte analytiske muligheder til et kommercielt perspektiv
kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Erfaring med SAP og Power BI vil være en fordel.



 



Så hvorfor vælge Kingspan LOGSTOR?



Hos Kingspan LOGSTOR bliver du en del af en international virksomhed, hvor vores løsninger spiller en vigtig rolle i den grønne omstilling og en mere energieffektiv infrastruktur.



I denne rolle får du samtidig mulighed for at sætte et tydeligt aftryk på et område med stor kommerciel betydning. Du kommer tæt på forretningen, arbejder på tværs af markeder og får mulighed for både at udfordre, udvikle og være med til at sætte retningen for vores pricing-arbejde.



Du bliver en del af et internationalt miljø med dygtige kolleger og en uformel omgangstone. Din daglige arbejdsplads bliver på vores kontor i Løgstør, hvor vi blandt andet har attraktiv kantine, fitnessfaciliteter og en aktiv personaleforening.



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Karina Pagter Toft på +45 21538694.



Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Title: Sales Analyst - Nordics & Benelux
Description:
📍ZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyze change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.

📍 Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5,000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.

About Zuru Edge 🚀

ZURU Edge is the FMCG arm of ZURU Group - a founder-led, vertically integrated business that designs, manufactures and sells its own consumer brands. We do not acquire heritage brands and manage their decline; we build new ones and put them into retail at a speed most consumer goods companies cannot match. Rascals, Millie Moon, Monday Haircare, Daise, Gumi Yum Surprise and Bonkers all compete in categories where execution and pace decide the winner.

📊 Your Role

This is a commercial role with an analytical core. You will start as the person who understands the numbers behind the business - sell-in, sell-out, distribution, promotional performance, forecast - and you will move steadily towards owning customer relationships and the revenue that comes with them.

This is deliberately not a back-office analyst role. If you want to build a career in data or finance, this is the wrong job. If you want to be a Key Account Manager and understand that the best ones are the ones who know their numbers cold, this is a good place to start.

You will work in close and cross-functional collaboration with our global teams.

In this role, you will directly report to the Head of Sales Benelux and Nordics.

📌 Core Roles And Responsibilities


Territory analytics & insight (≈50%)
Own weekly and monthly sell-in and sell-out reporting for the territory — by market, customer, brand and SKU — and be able to explain why every meaningful movement happened.
Track retail sell-through, distribution (stores ranged, TDPs), in-stock rates and units-per-store velocity across retail and distributor partners; flag stock and availability risks before they turn into lost sales or returns.
Build and maintain the promotional calendar, and run post-promotion evaluations: what the uplift was, what it cost, and whether we would do it again.
Support the monthly demand forecast and the regional P&L review — variance to budget, forecast accuracy, and the mix and margin drivers behind the result.
Turn analysis into customer-ready material: category stories, range review arguments, and the fact base behind a listing proposal.
Commercial execution & account ownership (≈30%)
Own a defined set of smaller retail accounts and distributor partners — order flow, range, pricing within agreed guardrails, promotional plan and quarterly business reviews. This starts in your first year, not at the end of it.
Support the sales team on the region's largest customers: prepare the negotiation fact base, build the range and promotional proposal, join the meetings, and follow up on what was agreed.
Prepare for and take part in customer meetings, category and range reviews, and joint business planning.
Drive new listings and distribution gains — in under-developed markets, in growing channels, and for brands not yet ranged with an existing customer.
Work with Brand and Marketing on launch plans, in-store activation and sampling, and make sure product is on shelf when the campaign goes live.
Sales operations & coordination (≈20%)
Own customer masterdata, pricing and article set-up for the territory.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and Customer Service on the order book, allocations, delivery windows and open orders.
Manage new line forms, retailer portals and listing documentation across Benelux and Nordics.
Track trade spend and rebates for the territory together with Finance.


💡 Skills & Experience Required


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
1-2 years experience as a sales or category analyst ideally within FMCG.
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced: PivotTables, XLOOKUP, modelling) and ability to build clean, insight-led slides in PowerPoint. Experience in Power BI is a plus.
Attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data streams and deadlines simultaneously.
Confident communicator who can distil complex data into clear, concise insights for non-analytical audiences.
Structured and analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to travel within Europe as needed.


⭐ What We Offer


Competitive salary.
Regions with room to grow. You will not be maintaining someone else's account base. There is measurable whitespace across eight markets and help closing it will be visibly your work.
Unusual breadth, early. Direct exposure to senior commercial leadership, and visibility across analytics, negotiation, brand and supply chain in one role.
Brands people notice. A portfolio in fast-moving categories, launched and scaled at a pace few FMCG businesses can match


LIFE@ZURU

At ZURU, we have cultivated a high-performing culture that encourages excellence. Our team works towards ambitious goals, learning, performing, and improving together, all while having fun. We empower talented individuals to do their best work every day.

At ZURU, you get out what you put in. You are responsible for driving your own career and we provide the platform to achieve it. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, there are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else.

We recognise that ZURU’s success stems from our people and you can only be at your best when you are looking after yourself. ZURU encourages all our team members to invest in their wellbeing by providing an array of benefits and tools.

🌱 Culture for Growth – a high-performance environment with opportunities to stretch and succeed

🌎 Global Opportunities – work with colleagues and partners across Europe, Asia and the US

💡 A-Player Team – collaborate with some of the best talent in the industry

⚡ ZURU – Tomorrow Reimagined

Title: Procurement Analyst
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vil du kombinere indkøb, dataanalyse og forretningsoptimering i en global industrivirksomhed?

Hos Johnson Controls søger vi en analytisk stærk indkøber, der kan omsætte data til konkrete forbedringer på tværs af vores supply chain. Du får en central rolle mellem indkøb, produktion, planlægning samt Master Data teamet, hvor du bidrager til både den daglige drift og datadrevne beslutninger.

Du bliver en del af en global virksomhed, som udvikler og producerer energieffektive køle- og varmepumpeløsninger til industrien og dermed understøtter den grønne omstilling. Du vil som procurement analyst primært supportere vores lokale fabrik i Højbjerg, Århus.

Dine opgaver


Analyse af indkøbs-, lager- og leverandørdata
Vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af masterdata i SAP
Identificering af optimeringsmuligheder inden for lagerstyring, forecast og lead times (PFEP-koncept)
Support af forretningen med analyser og beslutningsgrundlag
Deltagelse i proces- og systemforbedringer på tværs af supply chain
Udarbejdelse af KPI'er, rapporter og dashboards
Indkøb af varer og ydelser til lokal produktion
Leverandøropfølgning og analyse af performance


Hvem er du

Du har erfaring inden for indkøb, supply chain eller dataanalyse og motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og indsigt.

Vi Ser Gerne, At Du Har


Erfaring med SAP inden for indkøb, lager eller produktion, PTP
Erfaring og arbejde med LEAN processer
Stærke analytiske kompetencer og erfaring med rapportering
Avancerede Excel-kompetencer og gerne erfaring med Power BI
Forståelse for supply chain-processer og masterdata
Kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at omsætte data til handling
Gode kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SAP S/4HANA, LEAN, forecast- og lageroptimering eller SQL.

Som person

Du er struktureret, nysgerrig og datadrevet. Du trives med at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen, tager initiativ og formår at omsætte komplekse analyser til praktiske løsninger.

Hvad tilbyder vi


En nøglerolle med stor indflydelse på forbedringer i supply chain
Mulighed for at kombinere dataanalyse, indkøb og procesoptimering
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger
Gode udviklingsmuligheder i en global organisation
Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår, sundhedsforsikring og pensionsordning
Mulighed for at bidrage til den grønne omstilling


Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så upload dit CV og din ansøgning via vores karriereportal på Johnson Controls' hjemmeside.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi opfordrer derfor til, at du søger hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Annapurna is partnering with a leading international subscription-based consumer business to hire a Senior Strategy & Analytics Manager into its Danish leadership team.

The business is specifically looking for someone with exceptional analytical capability - someone who can combine deep quantitative analysis with strong commercial judgement and executive-level communication.

Working closely with the Portfolio Director and wider leadership team, you will help drive initiatives across customer retention, pricing, portfolio performance, growth and operational improvement in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

* Strong quantitative and analytical skillset - this is essential

* Advanced Excel, Power BI and PowerPoint capabilities

* Ability to connect analysis to wider commercial and strategic outcomes

* Strong communication skills with experience presenting to senior stakeholders

* Highly independent, proactive and comfortable operating with autonomy




Experience within subscription, telecoms, utilities, SaaS or recurring-revenue businesses is advantageous, as is exposure to pricing, retention or AI-driven analytics.




This is an excellent opportunity for an ex-consultant or analytically strong strategy professional looking for a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and genuine influence over business performance.

Title: BI & Data Consultant
Description:
Join Our Digital Transformation Journey

At Palsgaard, we are continuing our digital transformation by strengthening the applications, data platforms, and integrations that support our global business processes.

To support this journey, we are looking for a BI & Data Consultant who will play a key role in developing and improving our data platform, BI solutions, integrations, and business application landscape. The role combines hands-on technical development with close collaboration across IT and the business to turn data, BI, digital opportunities, and AI into scalable solutions.

In this role, you will work across a focused portfolio of BI, data platform, integration, and business-critical application technologies, including:


Our central data platform, which consolidates business data for reporting, analytics, and integrations between applications.
Power BI, Fabric, semantic models, and Microsoft Copilot, helping strengthen reporting, AI adoption, and value creation across the organization.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) and related integrations.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Work Point, and other business applications that support our global processes.


Our solutions are largely cloud-based and built on Microsoft Azure technologies. You will play an active role in maintaining, enhancing, and future-proofing our data platform, BI solutions, and related application landscape while ensuring strong collaboration between business stakeholders, IT, and external partners.

Your responsibilities:

As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be an important part of Palsgaard’s Global BI and Data Platform team in our global IT department in Juelsminde. You will contribute to strengthening the digital and data foundation that supports Palsgaard’s strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:


Develop, maintain, and further modernize our central data warehouse/data platform, including data ingestion, transformation, data modelling, and preparation of reliable data for reporting and analytics.
Develop Power BI reports from our backlog in close collaboration with global business stakeholders and the BI team, ensuring high-quality, scalable data models and clear analytical storytelling.
Contribute to improving how Palsgaard uses AI across the organization and how AI can support the development, documentation, automation, and quality of BI solutions created by the team.
Support daily operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of BI, data platform, and integration solutions.
Develop an understanding of Palsgaard’s broader IT application landscape and contribute to projects across global IT.


What we are looking for:

You bring a strong existing skill set, a relevant educational background, and solid hands-on experience within BI, data engineering, ETL processes, data warehousing/data platforms, and data modelling. You have the technical foundation to contribute actively from the start, while also bringing the curiosity and ambition needed to understand our business processes and help raise the capability, quality, and performance of our Global BI and Data Platform team.

Ideally, you bring a combination of:


A strong existing skill set within BI, ETL, data warehousing/data platforms, and semantic data modelling, supported by solid hands-on experience.
A good understanding of Microsoft-based technologies, preferably including Azure-based data warehouse development, Power BI/Fabric and Microsoft Dynamics AX or Finance and Operations (D365F&O).
The ability to understand existing business processes and translate business needs into sustainable data and application solutions.
An interest in working where business processes, technology, and data meet, combined with curiosity about new digital opportunities.
Experience with AI tools, combined with an understanding of relevant use cases and governance considerations, will be considered an advantage.


Who are you?

We are looking for a colleague who:


Has an outgoing and collaborative mindset, builds trust easily, and works effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and external partners.
Is a self-starter, takes ownership, works in a structured and pragmatic way with an eye for the detail, and follows initiatives through from idea to implementation.
Is motivated to contribute to the future roadmap for how data, BI, and AI are used across Palsgaard.
Communicates clearly and builds strong relationships across functions and locations in a global organization.


What We Offer

At Palsgaard, you will join a company with a strong heritage, ambitious growth plans, and a clear focus on digital transformation.

We offer attractive employment conditions, including a 7th vacation week, health insurance, profit sharing through an additional pension scheme, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development.

You will become part of an international environment with colleagues and customers around the world, while enjoying the benefits of working in a collaborative and informal culture located in beautiful surroundings at Palsgaard Estate in Juelsminde.

For further information, please contact Team Lead, Global BI and Data Platform, Martin Nordestgaard +45 4072 2788

Why Join Palsgaard?

This is a unique opportunity to take on a broad and influential role where you will help shape how data, BI, AI, and business applications are used across a global organization.

You will work with modern Microsoft technologies, drive digital initiatives across the organization, and contribute to building a scalable, integrated, and data-driven platform that supports our future growth.

At Palsgaard, technology is not just about systems—it is about enabling our people and business to perform at their best. As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be at the center of that journey.

  • Contribute to improving how Palsgaard uses AI across the organization and how AI can support the development, documentation, automation, and quality of BI solutions created by the team.
  • Support daily operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of BI, data platform, and integration solutions.
  • Develop an understanding of Palsgaard’s broader IT application landscape and contribute to projects across global IT.

What we are looking for:

You bring a strong existing skill set, a relevant educational background, and solid hands-on experience within BI, data engineering, ETL processes, data warehousing/data platforms, and data modelling. You have the technical foundation to contribute actively from the start, while also bringing the curiosity and ambition needed to understand our business processes and help raise the capability, quality, and performance of our Global BI and Data Platform team.

Ideally, you bring a combination of:

  • A strong existing skill set within BI, ETL, data warehousing/data platforms, and semantic data modelling, supported by solid hands-on experience.
  • A good understanding of Microsoft-based technologies, preferably including Azure-based data warehouse development, Power BI/Fabric and Microsoft Dynamics AX or Finance and Operations (D365F&O).
  • The ability to understand existing business processes and translate business needs into sustainable data and application solutions.
  • An interest in working where business processes, technology, and data meet, combined with curiosity about new digital opportunities.
  • Experience with AI tools, combined with an understanding of relevant use cases and governance considerations, will be considered an advantage.

Who are you?

We are looking for a colleague who:

  • Has an outgoing and collaborative mindset, builds trust easily, and works effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Is a self-starter, takes ownership, works in a structured and pragmatic way with an eye for the detail, and follows initiatives through from idea to implementation.
  • Is motivated to contribute to the future roadmap for how data, BI, and AI are used across Palsgaard.
  • Communicates clearly and builds strong relationships across functions and locations in a global organization.

What We Offer

At Palsgaard, you will join a company with a strong heritage, ambitious growth plans, and a clear focus on digital transformation.

We offer attractive employment conditions, including a 7th vacation week, health insurance, profit sharing through an additional pension scheme, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development.

You will become part of an international environment with colleagues and customers around the world, while enjoying the benefits of working in a collaborative and informal culture located in beautiful surroundings at Palsgaard Estate in Juelsminde.

For further information, please contact Team Lead, Global BI and Data Platform, Martin Nordestgaard +45 4072 2788

Why Join Palsgaard?

This is a unique opportunity to take on a broad and influential role where you will help shape how data, BI, AI, and business applications are used across a global organization.

You will work with modern Microsoft technologies, drive digital initiatives across the organization, and contribute to building a scalable, integrated, and data-driven platform that supports our future growth.

At Palsgaard, technology is not just about systems—it is about enabling our people and business to perform at their best. As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be at the center of that journey.

Title: Business Development Analyst – Offshore Wind Industry
Place: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about analysing commercial and operational data to identify growth opportunities, market gaps and areas of competitive advantage? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading – Cadeler is looking for a Business Development Analyst with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. We are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and play a critical role in the energy transition with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we! We are now looking for a Business Development Analyst to help build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reports.

What will you do?

As our new Business Development Analyst, you will help create actionable insights based on auction and seabed leasing rounds, government targets, market intelligence etc. Furthermore, you will collaborate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions which meet client needs.

Your Main Tasks Include


Conduct market research and competitor analysis across the offshore wind sector, tracking project pipelines, opportunities, and industry trends.
Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reports summarising pipeline opportunities and market developments for senior management.
Develop a network of relationships with stakeholders in the industry.
Support development and maintenance of stakeholder data, ensuring accurate records of engagements, leads, and opportunities.
Attend industry conferences, exhibitions, and networking events, promoting Cadeler and gathering intelligence.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of business development processes, tools, and reporting methods.


To succeed in this role

Being part of the Cadeler community means you’ll have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for a strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail, who has a genuine interest in the industry and market dynamics. A good communicator who enjoys working as part of a team to deliver results.

We think you will be a good match if you:


Degree in relevant discipline or a track record and proof of performance in a similar position.
Experience in a business analyst, market analyst, or business development support role (essential); experience gained within offshore wind, marine or energy sectors is preferred.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft applications including Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data visualisation tools is a plus.
Demonstrable experience analysing data and producing clear reports or recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English, written and verbal


Come work with us!

By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, but we also have offices in Vejle, UK, and Taiwan, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

Apply

Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 14th of September.

If you have any questions regarding the position, or practical matters please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Firm

 

Established in 2020, KP Law (previously Keller Postman) is a specialist litigation boutique, focussing on collective redress.   

 

The firm has over 100 employees across offices in London, Manchester, Birmingham, and Liverpool, representing over 250,000 individual clients across a range of cases in areas such as product liability, competition, worker rights, data breach and privacy and financial services. 

 

Our ethos is to combine the best legal talent with a strong operational and technological platform to enable its clients to pursue cases that could not otherwise be brought against large corporates as a result of their wrongdoing. 

 

Uniquely, KP Law is owned and fully financed by a recognised UK litigation funder (Legatus Holdings), this allows us to take on larger, headline making cases with greater efficiency and confidence.  All of our cases are for claimants and carried out under contingent fee agreements at no cost or risk to its clients.

 

KP Law was ranked Tier 1 for Group Litigation: Claimant in The Legal 500 UK Guide 2026, and Band 2 for Group Litigation: Claimant in Chambers and Partners 2026.

 

The Role

 

Role Summary

As a Data Analyst you will play a pivotal role in providing valuable insights and analysis to internal and external customers. Working in a small team, you will collaborate with Legal teams, data engineers and developers to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organisation.  By delivering high quality analytical solutions across reporting solutions such as Power BI, the Data Analyst enables teams to make informed decisions, identify performance drivers, and continuously improve operational outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Reporting & Data Visualisation

Design, build, and maintain reports and dashboards that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
Apply data visualisation best practices to effectively communicate findings to varied audiences
Automate routine and recurring reports to improve efficiency and consistency.

Data Analysis & Insight

Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities aligned to business objectives
Provide analytical support to inform key business initiatives and decision making
Generate meaningful insights to support both operational and strategic outcomes

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with business teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Provide guidance and training to end‑users on accessing, interpreting, and leveraging reports and dashboards effectively.
Present insights and recommendations that influence operational and strategic decision‑making.

Data Quality, Governance & Integrity

Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across all reports and analytical outputs
Carry out regular data cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities
Support the implementation and adherence to data governance policies and standards




Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

Document methodologies, processes, and outputs to promote transparency, repeatability, and knowledge sharing




Continuous Improvement

Monitor the performance of existing reports and dashboards, implementing improvements where needed.
Contribute to the development of reporting standards, documentation, data definitions, and governance practices.

 

 

Essential Skills & Experience:

·Degree in a STEM subject or experience in data analysis or business intelligence.

·Proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and visualisation best practices.

·Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.

·Solid SQL skills for querying and preparing data.

·Experience working with stakeholders to understand needs and present findings.

·High attention to detail and strong data quality mindset.


 

Desirable Skills & Attributes:

·Experience working with Databricks for data transformation or analytics workflows.

·Experience developing Salesforce reports and dashboards.

·Foundational knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or analysis.

·Experience with cloud data environments such as Azure or AWS.

·Familiarity with ETL tools, or similar data‑integration technologies.

·Understanding of data modelling concepts.

·Familiarity with legal industry data and metrics.


 

Equal Opportunities

Our approach to our people is underpinned by our commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion and well-being. Our ambition is to build a richly diverse workforce made up of the best talent in our industry. With a workplace that is supportive and inclusive, recognises and nurtures talent, and has a strong sense of community between colleagues.

 

This means that everyone who either applies to or works for KP Law is treated equally, regardless of their gender, age, ethnic origin, nationality, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, or religious beliefs.

 

 

Our Values

At KP Law, we pride ourselves on being a values-led law firm.


Excellence in Everything

Together We Achieve More

There’s Always a Way


 

Our Benefits

We strive to offer a rounded benefits package, that employees value, no matter what stage of their career they are in. Current benefits include:

Annual discretionary bonus scheme
Company contributory pension scheme
Hybrid working
Life assurance
Cash-back healthcare scheme
Enhanced family friendly polices
Employee Assistance Programme
Subsidised gym membership
Cycle to Work scheme
Staff referral scheme

Title: Audience Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience
Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate


Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst | Financial Technology | Victoria, London | 4 Days a Week in Office | £55,000 to £65,000




I’m working with a growing financial technology client in London who are looking to hire an early-career Data Analyst into a maturing data function.




This would be a great role for a talented Data Analyst with aspirations of growing into a Data Science position over time. The immediate need is analytical and commercially focused, but you’ll be learning from a technically strong Data Scientist who can provide hands-on coaching and development.




This is not a deep data science or machine learning role from day one. It is a business-facing analyst position, working closely with finance, operations, marketing, and senior leadership to turn data into clear commercial insight.




The role will suit someone bright, curious, and early in their career who wants proper coaching, genuine exposure, and the chance to learn how a financial services business works from the inside.




You’ll report into a highly capable Data Scientist who is stepping into management and will provide hands-on technical guidance, with regular exposure to the Finance Director and CEO. The structure is flat, the data engineering team is already well established, and the environment is set up for someone to learn quickly without being left to figure everything out alone.




What you’ll be doing:

Analysing commercial, finance, and operational data
Spotting trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Communicating insight clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Working with established data processes and tooling
Partnering closely with more senior people before running independently with ideas
Building your commercial understanding of a fast-moving fintech environment




What they’re looking for:

Strong SQL and some Python experience
Exposure to modern data tooling such as dbt or Airflow
Some experience with data visualisation and reporting
Strong communication skills, especially with non-technical stakeholders
High EQ, curiosity, and willingness to learn
A collaborative mindset and the maturity to ask questions before building in isolation
Fintech, financial services, or card issuing experience would be a bonus, but is not essential




The key here is attitude and commercial thinking. The client is not looking for someone who wants to disappear into technical work. They want someone who can understand a business problem, work with others, and explain findings in plain English.




Interview process:

1st stage: Intro chat with senior finance and data stakeholders
2nd stage: Technical interview
Final stage: In-office meeting with the wider leadership and data team




If you’re a Data Analyst who wants to build strong commercial foundations while developing towards Data Science over time, this could be a really strong fit.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst


Bristol | Hybrid | Up to £35,000

We're working with an established organisation in Bristol that is looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join their growing data team.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their data career with a strong foundation in SQL, who wants to develop their experience across data retrieval, data modelling, Power BI and business reporting.

The Role


You'll work with business data to produce accurate, reliable reporting and analysis. A key part of the role will be using SQL to retrieve, manipulate and model data from relational databases, ensuring data is structured correctly and ready for reporting and analysis.

You'll also work closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements and translate these into practical data solutions, including Power BI reports and dashboards.

Key Responsibilities






Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate and analyse data from relational databases.




Build and maintain data models to support reporting and analytics.




Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, using DAX where required.




Work with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements.




Validate, cleanse and reconcile data to ensure accuracy and consistency.




Investigate data issues and resolve reporting discrepancies.




Test reports and datasets against source data.




Maintain documentation around data sources, definitions and transformations.




Support wider data quality, governance and reporting initiatives.


What We're Looking For


The key requirement is strong SQL knowledge and an understanding of how data is structured and modelled.

You'll ideally have:






Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregation, subqueries and data manipulation.




An understanding of relational databases and data modelling.




Some practical experience with Power BI, including reports and dashboards.




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.




Good communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.




A curious and proactive approach to learning and developing your technical skills.


This will be a 2 stage interview process and for the right candidate my client can interview next week!


If you're interested in this role, or know someone who would be, then please apply to this advert and reach out to a. methula@ioassociates.co.uk

Working Pattern: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

We want give every candidate the opportunity to perform at their best throughout the application and interview process and then ultimately in their role. If you require any adjustments during our recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

In the event that a high volume of suitable applications are received, the post may close prior to the specified closing date. Please apply as soon as possible if interested.

About The Role

Join our dynamic Ecommerce team at Matalan as an Ecommerce Data Analyst! In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in driving our online success by leveraging your technical expertise in data collection, tracking and analysis. You will transform complex web data into clear, compelling stories with actionable recommendations that directly influence business decisions.

A vital role within the Analytics and Ecommerce teams, you will deliver critical web data insights to the Ecommerce team. This involves transforming business questions into analytical problems, analysing intricate datasets, and presenting concise, persuasive, and actionable insights that drive informed decisions and optimize online performance.

Key Responsibilities -


Delivery of actionable insight: utilise a variety of analytical techniques to deliver valuable actionable insight that address diverse business challenges
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Comfortable building strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their analytical needs, identify challenges, opportunities and contribute to their strategic roadmaps
Commercial Impact Analysis: Able to evaluate the commercial viability of insights, quantify the impact of data driven decisions and prioritise future work that maximise value delivery.
Analytical Tool and Process Development: Develop and implement tools, reports, and processes that enhance the analytical capabilities of the team and wider business, with a focus on data democratisation and self serve analytics for the key teams.
Insight Democratisation: Create and maintain automated BI that promote data awareness and enhance the business knowledge of our online performance and customer behaviours.
Active member of the Analytics team: Sharing insight, analytical process and underlying data changes in the ecomm area with the wider analytics and data science team as part of our regular knowledge sharing.


About You


Educated to a degree level or with demonstrable relevant experience
Extensive experience of at least 4 years working with BigQuery is essential including a solid understanding of SQL coding
Strong Experience of Google analytics (GA4).
Extensive Experience of visualisation software essential (e.g. Power BI/ Looker).
Understanding of analysis methodologies essential (statistical techniques a plus). 
Awareness of ETL processes and database automation.
Experience working with AI tools to generate automated insights advantageous
Confident in Microsoft Excel and full Microsoft Suite. (Or cloud based equivalents)


Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we also offer the below core benefits:


20% staff discount, which increases with length of service
Thrive Recognition Scheme
Wellbeing support provided by the Retail Trust
Life Assurance
Retail Rewards platform offering discounts for other retailers
Pension Scheme
Access to a wide range of career development
