Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Analyst reporting into the Head of Data in our Nottingham office. You will manage the delivery of high-quality data solutions that support client, operational, and business objectives. Working within the Data Delivery team, you will combine technical capability with stakeholder engagement to ensure data products are delivered accurately, efficiently.

You can analyse, transform, and validate complex datasets using SQL or SAS, while identifying opportunities to improve processes, mitigate risks, and enhance existing data products. Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other modern data tooling would be advantageous.

As a key member of the team, the Data Analyst acts as a trusted partner to stakeholders. You will translate business requirements into data solutions, managing delivery expectations, and ensuring a high standard of customer service throughout the delivery lifecycle.

You will also play an important part in developing team capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of junior analysts.

Key Responsibilities


You will build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, developing a clear understanding of their business requirements and objectives.
Translate stakeholder requirements into effective data deliverables and solutions.
Manage client expectations and proactively address queries, issues, and risks.
Deliver excellent customer outcomes by ensuring solutions are accurate, valuable, and fit for purpose.


Data Delivery & Analysis


Own and deliver data extracts, reports, and analytical outputs to agreed quality, scope, and timelines.
Use SQL, SAS, and other analytical tools to interrogate, manipulate, and validate complex datasets.
Apply robust validation and quality assurance processes to all deliverables.
Investigate data-related issues and client queries, conducting root cause analysis and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support the delivery of proof-of-concepts, new products, and data-driven solutions.


Operational Excellence


Plan, prioritise, and manage workload across multiple deliveries and projects.
Provide accurate effort estimates and delivery timescales.
Monitor progress against commitments and escalate risks or issues.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, increase efficiency, and reduce operational risk.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of team practices, documentation, and standards.


Governance, Risk & Compliance


Ensure all deliveries comply with regulatory, contractual, and internal governance requirements.
Maintain awareness of data protection, security, and compliance obligations.
Identify, assess, and help mitigate operational and delivery risks.
Support audit, governance, and control activities where required.


Collaboration & Leadership


Support and coach junior team members, sharing technical expertise and best practice.
Lead or actively contribute to delivery reviews, project discussions, and problem-solving sessions.
Champion knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.


Qualifications


Strong SQL and/or SAS programming skills.
Experience working with complex datasets and data transformation processes.
Strong analytical skills.
You can engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience investigating and resolving data-related issues.


Desirable


Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other data technologies.
Experience delivering data solutions in a client-facing environment.
Knowledge of data governance, quality management, and regulatory requirements.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.
Experience working within project or change delivery environments.


Additional Information

Benefits package includes:


Hybrid working - 40% office based
Great compensation package and uncapped commission
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for a talented Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will help translate business questions into trusted data products and Power BI dashboards, supporting Salary Finance's mission to help our customers get out of debt faster and save for their future. You'll work alongside senior analysts, engineers and stakeholders across the business building the datasets, reports, and insights that inform decisions and enable safe growth of our loan book. This is a role where you'll grow your craft, contribute to team standards, and see the impact of your work reach real customers.




What you’ll do

Build High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will help the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Support Data Integrity:

You will follow the team's data governance standards and contribute to documentation across your analytical outputs

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
SQL Mastery: Advance level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design.




Who you are

While we embrace diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we’re united by a shared mindset. We look for team members who live these values every day:

Take Ownership: We own the entire journey and see outcomes through from start to finish
Dig Deeper :We ask why, investigate root causes, and build solutions that last
Stronger Together :We choose collaboration, share knowledge freely, and lift each other up
Momentum Matters :We act with purpose, remove blockers, and default to action
Make a Lasting Impact :We think long-term, put people before numbers, and change the system for good




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
Regular company socials & more great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at salaryfinance.com




Salary Finance is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.




If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The locations for this role are Newport and Titchfield (Fareham).

This role is aligned to ONS hybrid working principles, which are based on attending the office with purpose. The postholder will be expected to contribute to the organisation’s overall 40% office attendance, in line with business and role requirements.

The induction process for the role will be conducted in person.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Business Data Operations Division.

Business Data Operations Division (BDOD) is a large and diverse area of around 400 staff, collecting economic statistics from several million businesses a year. It is the foundation for most of the ONS’ core economic outputs, such as Gross Domestic Product (GDP). The primary role for the division is the data collection, editing and validation of survey data.

The Office for National Statistics (ONS) is the UK’s largest producer of official statistics, covering a range of key economic, social, and demographic topics. These include measuring changes in the value of the UK economy, estimating the size, geographic distribution, and characteristics of the population, and providing indicators of price inflation, employment, earnings, crime, and migration.

Job Description

A Data Analyst collects, organises and studies data to provide business insight.

Responsibilities Include:


Build analytical pipelines for automated processing of data used for regular reporting.
Lead the production of regular data and insight products.
Lead on the development and delivery of robust quality control processes over our outputs including the use of automated tests to validate processing.
Design and build creative data visualisations to deliver actionable insights for our business users.
Lead on the development of Power BI data models
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to collect information to support the measurement of ONS performance e.g. KPIs, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports etc used to track ONS performance.
Lead the delivery of management information products, liaising with stakeholders and collecting user requirements.
Lead the development of system and user process documentation; developing new documentation as required and updates to existing documentation.
Line manage, develop and coach 1-2 Data Analysts within your team.

Line manage, develop and coach 1-2 Data Analysts within your team.


Person specification

Essential Criteria:

lead the development of valuable statistical and analytical insights and reports
identify and apply a range of statistical and analytical techniques and tools, and support others in applying them
quality assure statistical techniques and analytical outputs across a team
engage with stakeholders and share statistical and analytical techniques to increase understanding and trust


Developing code for analysis (Practitioner)


design and implement the analytical approach, including code, using appropriate standards and tests
lead collaboration to review and improve analytical approaches, including shared code
guide others in producing analytical approach documentation, identifying improvements

listen to and interpret the needs of technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage their expectations
manage active and reactive communication
support or host difficult discussions within the team or with diverse senior stakeholders

use a range of data visualisations to simplify a complex story.
adapt a story to the needs of multidisciplinary stakeholders.
advise and support others in developing inclusive, accessible data visualisations that recognise different user needs.
suggest improvements to data visualisation processes and standards to increase efficiency and quality.

Communicating and Influencing

Technical skills

Alongside your salary of £41,985, Office for National Statistics contributes £12,163 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

The Office for National Statistics is part of the Civil Service, and as such we share a number of key benefits with other departments, whilst also having our own unique offerings to support our valued colleagues across the organisation.

Whether you are hearing about us for the first time or already know a bit about our organisation, we hope that our careers site will give you a great insight into the benefits and facilities available to our colleagues, and our fantastic working culture.

 

Inclusion & Accessibility

At ONS we are always looking to attract the very best people from the widest possible talent pool, and we are proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunities employer. As a Disability Confident Leader we’re committed to ensuring that all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

As part of our application process, you will be prompted to provide details of any reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process that you need. If you would like to discuss any reasonable adjustments before applying, please contact the recruitment team in the first instance.

If you would like an accessible version of any of the attachments or recruitment documents below or linked to in this advert, please contact the recruitment team who will be happy to assist.

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

Security Clearance

For ONS the requirement for SC clearance is to have been present in the UK for 3 consecutive years immediately prior to applying and the department will consider eligibility by exception on a case-by-case basis. You will be asked to provide information regarding your UK residency during your application, and failure to provide this will result in your application being rejected.

At the point of SC application, you will need to provide or give access to the following evidence:


Departmental or company records (personnel files, staff reports, sick leave reports and security records)
UK criminal records covering both spent and unspent criminal records
Your credit and financial history with a credit reference agency
Security Services records


Please note: We will reach out to you once the advert has closed to confirm eligibility for this role, this will be via an e-mail. Please check you e-mails.

Visa Sponsorship

ONS are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants are expected to hold a valid right to work in the UK when employment commences. If you are applying on a time-limited visa, this will need to be valid for at least 18 months at point of application.

To work at the ONS, candidates must meet both UK right to work and security clearance requirements (where applicable).

If you are unsure whether you meet the appropriate right to work or security clearance eligibility criteria, please refer to the guidance on Gov.uk or contact the recruitment email provided in the advert before applying. Failure to meet these requirements will result in your application being rejected and employment offers being withdrawn.

Application Process

Number of Stages: 2

Stage 1: Application

Stage 2: Interview

Stage 1 – Application

The assessment process at the application stage will be based on your work history, CV, skills, experience, and personal statement. It is important that your application is tailored to highlight the skills, knowledge, and experience relevant to the role.

A personal statement is required at application stage, the maximum word count allowed is 1,250 words, which should not be exceeded. You should provide evidence for each essential skill criterion listed in the person specification. As these criteria are scored, it is advisable to give clear examples for each one, including the impact of your actions, ideally utilising the STAR technique (Situation, Task, Action, Result).

In instances where a high number of applications are received, the sift pass mark may be adjusted, and candidates will be invited to interview based on merit order, i.e., those with the highest scores.

Please note that Success Profiles Behaviour examples are not required at this stage of the application process.

When a high volume of applications are received, the sift pass mark may be adjusted. Candidates will be invited to interview based on their merit order, with those achieving the highest scores being prioritised. Applicants who score below the adjusted pass mark but still pass will be placed on hold and may be invited to interview at a later date.

We often have similar roles available at different grades. If a candidate is suitable for a similar role or a lower grade than they have applied for, we may offer the candidate that role without the need to go through a further selection process providing the role has the same behaviours, and essential skills.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.



This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time, term-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

At Lithia UK, our mission is simple: to modernise personal transportation—whenever, wherever, and however our customers desire. We’re not just keeping up with change—we’re leading it. Whether it’s enhancing the customer journey, transforming operational efficiency, or unlocking new opportunities, data is at the heart of our decisions.

Take the lead in creating and delivering high-quality business intelligence tools that help our teams make smarter, data-driver decisions
Maintain and continuously improve our reporting solutions, ensuring they’re accurate, reliable, and easy for users to navigate
Build clear, insightful reports and dashboards that support decision-making across the business
Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver information that adds real value
Collaborate with teams across the business to uncover insights and identify opportunities that support our strategic goals
Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that make a real difference
Keep our data accurate, consistent, and accessible—ensuring it remains a trusted source of truth
Implement checks, validation processes, and controls to maintain high standards of data quality across everything we do.

Expertise within Power BI and are confident with designing, building and optimising dashboard that bring data to life and help teams make informed decisions
A minimum of 2-3 years experience within Data / BI Analytics
Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract and manipulate data with ease
An analytical mindset and can spot trends, uncover insights and find practical solutions
Great attention to detail, especially regarding reconciliation and ensuring accuracy across reports
A self-starter attitude and is comfortable owning projects from end to end whilst managing their time effectively
Understanding of data modelling and statistical techniques, applying these tools to analyse performance and support strategic decisions
Clear communication skill and presentation skills, ensuring data is presented in a way that’s meaningful, engaging and tailored to different audiences
Strong leadership and project management abilities, whether it’s leading a BI initiative or working across teams you will bring structure and momentum to your work

Enjoy 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays), giving you more time to relax, recharge, and do what you love

Access a new car through our Salary Sacrifice scheme and enjoy a smarter way to drive

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Wise Platform Pricing
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Wise Platform Pricing Analytics team at Wise.

Wise Platform brings the reach and low cost of Wise to business partners - read more about Wise Platform here.

The Wise Platform Pricing Analytics team manages the pricing model and P&L analysis for Wise Platform. The team supports Wise Platform by calculating prices for partners, monitoring and reviewing the financial sustainability of the program, and finding opportunities to continue improving the growth and profitability of the company.

This is an IC2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

What You'll Be Doing


Identify and propose pricing and cost improvements for Wise Platform, ensuring solutions directly link to achieving profitability and growth outcomes
Investigate complex cost data, and influence improvements in upstream data quality and revenue and cost allocation methodologies within the Product Economics domain
Explain the underlying product economics that contribute to prices, and liaise with subject matter experts to gather detailed knowledge on economic drivers
Monitor and review the financial performance of Wise Platform, surfacing insightful and actionable insights on the main drivers of profitability
Contribute to improvements to the pricing model by applying knowledge of costs and cost drivers to appropriate pricing strategies


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analytics
Stakeholder management skills; you know how to influence teams to deliver high-impact change, across analytics, engineering, and business specialists
Extensive experience using SQL to build and maintain complex data sources, and leveraging visualisation tools to surface critical insights
Experience with dbt and robust data modelling, including the ability to navigate complex dbt projects and create reusable, maintainable data assets for scalable analytics


Nice To Have But Not Essential


Experience working on Pricing, especially B2B Pricing
Experience working in Fintech or Financial Services
Experience using Lightdash or Superset
Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques, including the use of Python and statistical modelling


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Title: MI Analyst
Description:
As Lockton’s continued investment in Data and MI the appetite for data is only increasing and is highly valued by senior management.As a result, we are looking to recruit the appropriate data individual to join the team.

First and foremost, the right candidate must fit in with Lockton’s culture. At Lockton we value the following principles:

Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement




Role Responsibilities




Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, and translate reporting and analytics requirements.
Extract, transform, analyse, and interpret data from multiple sources to support business decision-making.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models.
Write efficient, scalable SQL queries to support reporting.
Deliver insights and recommendations that help stakeholders understand trends, performance, risks, and opportunities.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to promote a data-driven culture across the organisation.

We are seeking a proactive and analytical individual who enjoys solving complex data challenges and turning information into valuable business insight.

Power BI

Data ingestion and transformation (Power Query)
Data modelling
DAX development and optimisation

SQL & Data Analysis

Strong SQL development skills, including query optimisation and troubleshooting.
Solid understanding of relational database design and data modelling principles.
Experience analysing large and complex datasets to identify trends and business opportunities.




Excel

Advanced Excel skills, including:
Power Query
Power Pivot
Complex formulas and modelling techniques

Preferred Skills:

Experience working with Databricks in a modern data platform environment.
Knowledge of dbt (Data Build Tool) for data transformation and modelling.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with data engineering or ETL pipelines.
Exposure to version control and collaborative development practices (e.g., Git/GitHub).
Experience working within financial services, insurance, or other highly regulated industries.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About VPZ

VPZ is the UK’s leading specialist vape retailer. Since opening our first store in Edinburgh, we have grown to 200 locations across the UK.




We are continuing to invest in data and analytics so that teams across retail, e-commerce, manufacturing and operations can make faster, better informed decisions.




About the Role

As a Data Analyst, you will turn complex information into clear recommendations that influence commercial and operational decisions across the business.




You will build trusted dashboards, investigate performance trends and work with stakeholders to identify opportunities in areas such as store performance, product ranging, customer behaviour, stock management and campaign effectiveness.




This role would suit an analyst who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with commercial problem-solving and stakeholder communication.




Please note this role requires 5 days on site, here at Head Office in Newbridge, Edinburgh.




What You Will Do

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI or a comparable visualisation platform.
Analyse sales and operational performance across more than 190 stores, identifying trends, risks and commercial opportunities.
Evaluate product, category, store and channel performance to support ranging and investment decisions.
Present regular performance updates and clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Analyse customer behaviour, segmentation, retention and marketing campaign effectiveness.
Support demand forecasting, stock analysis and supply-chain optimisation.




What Success Looks Like

During your first six months, you will:

Establish trusted and consistently used performance dashboards
Improve the speed and reliability of recurring reporting
Deliver analysis that leads to measurable commercial or operational action;
Improve visibility of store, product, customer and stock performance;
Strengthen data quality and reduce unnecessary manual processes.




Essential Experience and Skills

You will be a strong match for this role if you have:
At least two years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or comparable analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to work with joins, aggregations, CTEs and complex datasets.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience creating dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau or a comparable platform.
The ability to interpret commercial performance and turn analysis into practical recommendations.




Desirable Experience

It would be beneficial, but not essential, if you have:
Experience in retail, e-commerce, FMCG or manufacturing analytics.
Experience extracting data from REST APIs.
Knowledge of MongoDB or another NoSQL database.
Experience using Python or R for analysis, automation or statistical modelling.
Experience in demand forecasting, stock optimisation or customer segmentation.




Please ensure you apply with an up-to-date CV.




Applicants must be 18 years old or above, any subsequent job offer is subject to pre-employment screening and right to work checks.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DATA ANALYST




ABOUT US

Every day, we push beyond expectations to help millions of people save money, at a time when it’s never mattered more. Through MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExpert, Quidco and our B2B partnerships we supply products to more than 24 million unique monthly visitors, helping UK households to save billions of pounds a year. Can you tell this is something we’re exceptionally proud of!

Creative, collaborative, ambitious – it’s hard work. But what makes it worth it? Leaving work knowing we’ve made a difference to our customers, users, and to each other.

Put our distinct brands together with our dedicated colleagues and you’ve got a workplace with lots of personality. We’re open-minded, diverse, and love our differences. Everyone plays a part, and comes together to work hard, go beyond, and make sure everyone feels they belong.




WHY JOIN THE TEAM?

Understanding data and using it to improve customer experience are critical pillars of MoneySuperMarket Group’s success, leading to an extensive investment in people and capabilities within our Group Data function.




The Data Analytics team plays an essential role in helping the business achieve its goals and are actively involved in identifying unique areas where data can add more value to our customers. We use machine learning, data-driven experimentation, and analytics techniques with a tech stack involving Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub, DBT and Tableau to gain insight into user behaviour, and optimise marketing and user experience.




Far more than number crunchers, MoneySuperMarket data analysts influence the direction of the company through actionable data-driven insight. The data analyst will work with the rest of the team to identify opportunities for personalisation, monitor performance of experiments, develop and track KPIs, and automate manual processes.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this hands-on role, you will apply your communications, technical and problem-solving skills to:

Work pro-actively within the data analytics team to deliver high impact projects that will:
Empower people across the business to make data-driven decisions by building self-serve reports and recommendations.
Deliver actionable insights across MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExperts and QuidCo brands.




Build relationships with stakeholders and ensure your work is communicated across the business.
Present findings and recommendations tailored to the relevant audience.
Troubleshoot and optimise existing data sources.
Work together with Data Engineers to productionise valuable output from your projects to commonly used data tables.
Support and be supported by other data analysts, data scientists and data engineers through knowledge sharing and upskilling.
You will learn and grow your capabilities by working with the latest technology and services, in particular the Google Cloud Platform.
Working on a cross-functional team, you will learn and grow your capabilities in areas such as statistics, data storytelling, web, and mobile app technologies and machine learning.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Previous professional experience in Data Analytics.
Experience with BI reporting tools such as Tableau or powerBI.
Experience with app analytics tools such as Google Analytics.
A good working knowledge of SQL.
Experience with code development tools such as GitHub and DBT.
Experience in managing stakeholder work requests.
Comfortable manipulating and analysing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources and formats.
Be detail oriented and adept in resolving bugs in SQL code and data cross checks.
Adept at data visualisation.
Be able to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner to senior management.




WHAT REWARDS ARE ON OFFER

Up to 27 holidays + bank holidays
Pension up to 6% employer contribution
Bonus scheme
Digital Doctor on demand
Work from anywhere scheme – 2 weeks per year
Financial coaching
Mental health platform access




HOW WE’LL INVEST IN YOU

We’re invested in your development. Expect mentorship, training, and opportunities to expand your skill set, including access to your own individual LinkedIn Learning license with access to over 16,000 courses.




At MONY Group, we believe in the strength of diversity and see inclusion as a strategic advantage. Our values guide us in creating a workplace where fairness and equity is a reality for all. We’re committed to minimising systemic bias and creating a level playing field for all candidates.




Contact us for reasonable accommodations in the application process, no need to disclose your disability or condition, just specify your needs. Unsure what to ask for? We can guide you through available accommodations.




We understand that job adverts only say so much and you’re likely to have a lot of questions. If you’d like to know more before applying such as more on hybrid working, salary, our parental leave policy etc, please just let us know, and we’ll be happy to help. You can contact the recruiter for this role, Kim at kim.richards@monygroup.com




We believe that success isn’t solely defined by ticking boxes on a skills checklist. We encourage your application, so we can discover your skills and experience that will help you succeed in this role.

We use machine learning, data-driven experimentation, and analytics techniques with a tech stack involving Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub, DBT and Tableau to gain insight into user behaviour, and optimise marketing and user experience.


Far more than number crunchers, MoneySuperMarket data analysts influence the direction of the company through actionable data-driven insight. The data analyst will work with the rest of the team to identify opportunities for personalisation, monitor performance of experiments, develop and track KPIs, and automate manual processes.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this hands-on role, you will apply your communications, technical and problem-solving skills to:

  • Work pro-actively within the data analytics team to deliver high impact projects that will:
  • Empower people across the business to make data-driven decisions by building self-serve reports and recommendations.
  • Deliver actionable insights across MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExperts and QuidCo brands.


  • Build relationships with stakeholders and ensure your work is communicated across the business.
  • Present findings and recommendations tailored to the relevant audience.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise existing data sources.
  • Work together with Data Engineers to productionise valuable output from your projects to commonly used data tables.
  • Support and be supported by other data analysts, data scientists and data engineers through knowledge sharing and upskilling.
  • You will learn and grow your capabilities by working with the latest technology and services, in particular the Google Cloud Platform.
  • Working on a cross-functional team, you will learn and grow your capabilities in areas such as statistics, data storytelling, web, and mobile app technologies and machine learning.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Previous professional experience in Data Analytics.
  • Experience with BI reporting tools such as Tableau or powerBI.
  • Experience with app analytics tools such as Google Analytics.
  • A good working knowledge of SQL.
  • Experience with code development tools such as GitHub and DBT.
  • Experience in managing stakeholder work requests.
  • Comfortable manipulating and analysing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources and formats.
  • Be detail oriented and adept in resolving bugs in SQL code and data cross checks.
  • Adept at data visualisation.
  • Be able to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner to senior management.


WHAT REWARDS ARE ON OFFER

  • Up to 27 holidays + bank holidays

  • Work from anywhere scheme – 2 weeks per year

Title: Senior Data Analyst-(Re)Insurance- SQL, Power BI, Azure technologies
Description:
Introduction

At Gallagher Re, we bring clarity to complexity by helping clients around the world make confident, data-driven decisions in a rapidly evolving risk landscape. Here, you’ll be part of a team that leverages world-class analytics and deep reinsurance expertise to deliver strategic advisory services and transactional excellence. Together, we transform advanced insights and market intelligence into strategies that protect businesses, drive performance, and shape the future of reinsurance. We’re a community of decision makers, future shapers, and trusted experts working side by side to deliver meaningful impact through innovative thinking and practical solutions. At Gallagher Re, your curiosity is welcomed, your growth is championed, and your work truly matters. This is a place where you'll have the freedom to explore new ideas, take ownership of your career, and collaborate with people who are as driven and inquisitive as you are.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our growing data and analytics team. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with underwriting, operations, claims, and finance stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will bring proven experience in the (Re)Insurance market, with hands-on experience working with Bordereaux and Delegated Authority data. You will play a key role in transforming complex data into meaningful analysis, improving data quality, and developing reporting solutions that drive operational efficiency and commercial outcomes. Previoous experience and knowldge of working with Data & Analytics in the insurannce industry is essential to be successful in this role.

We offer flexible/hybrid working and you will be expected in our London City office twice a week.

How You'll Make An Impact


Analyse and interpret large, complex datasets to provide business-critical insights and recommendations.
Work with Delegated Authority and Bordereaux data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations using Power BI.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.
Support the development and enhancement of data models, reporting frameworks, and analytical solutions.
Collaborate with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and operational teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Work with cloud-based data platforms, including Azure Data Lake, to support modern data architecture and analytics capabilities.
Identify data quality issues and implement controls and improvements to enhance data integrity.
Provide subject matter expertise on (Re)Insurance data structures, reporting requirements, and market best practices.


About You


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst within (Re)Insurance market is essential.
Extensive knowledge of Bordereaux and Delegated Authority business processes and datasets.
Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimise complex queries.
Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Experience working with Azure Data Lake and cloud-based data environments.
Fantastic analytical, problem-solving, and data visualisation skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Experience translating business requirements into meaningful analytical solutions.
Experience within the London Market insurance environment.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, or master data management principles.
Exposure to Azure Synapse, Data Factory, or other Azure analytics services.
Understanding of underwriting, claims, exposure management, or reinsurance reporting processes.


Compensation And Benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.


Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact


At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. Although this role is listed as full-time, if you’re in a job-share partnership, work reduced hours, or have any other flexible arrangement, please still get in touch. We will also offer reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process if required, so please let us know.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We are seeking experienced data analysts to join our teams providing data and intelligence across the shipping and energy industries. We deliver actionable data-driven insights across diverse global shipping, trade, offshore, renewables and energy datasets. You will have the opportunity to build on your data analytics skills, and develop deep knowledge in a dynamic and fast-paced industry that sits at the heart of the world economy.




What you’ll be doing:

Use the latest data science tools and techniques for data processing, analysis and visualisation of large, complex data sets
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, plan deliverables, and track implementation with analysts, data engineers and developers
Incorporate advanced AI and algorithms where relevant
Lead implementation of ETL and processing pipelines, data derivation and analysis
Work across teams, support clients and report progress to senior management

You’ll need to have:

3-4 years’ data analytics experience working with complex data models
Ability to update technical and non-technical stakeholders on progress on projects
Experience supervising junior analysts, data engineers and developers
Excellent SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures and spatial
Working knowledge of Python, JSON and DAX
Ability to deliver actionable insights clearly using visualisation tools such as Power BI
Strong numerical, data handling and analytical skills
A degree in a relevant numerate or analytical subject
Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail

We love to see:

Curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques, programming languages and software tools
Appreciation of the wider data science technology landscape including Databricks
Awareness of global trade, economics and statistics




Details:

Salary: Competitive (dependent on experience) plus bonus and benefits

Location: London/Midlands/Hybrid

Number of vacancies: 1-2

Start date: Q3 2026

Closing date: 13th September 2026 (applications accepted and reviewed immediately)




Working at Clarksons Research:

Clarksons Research is the leading global provider of intelligence and research across shipping, trade, offshore and energy. Respected worldwide, the Clarksons Research team of over 175 experts provides powerful analysis, insight, and data through a range of online platforms, reports, valuations, and consultancy work. Clarksons Research is part of the Clarksons Group, the world’s leading integrated shipping services provider and a FTSE 250 company.




Clarksons Research is currently offering exciting opportunities for experienced senior data analysts to join its expanding Analytics team. Successful candidates will join a fast-expanding business offering excellent opportunities for career progression within a supportive organisation with a strong track record of training, mentoring and ensuring people reach their full potential. We offer a competitive range of benefits including 25-days holiday, corporate pension scheme, gym and health programmes, cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans.




Think you’d be a good fit?

Send a CV and cover letter to Apeksha Mehta at recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512.




We also accept applications via LinkedIn though priority is given to applications received by email. Candidates with prior shipping industry experience are encouraged to contact us via email; we would be happy to arrange a discussion with a senior manager or director to explore opportunities for more experienced hires and how your background could best fit within the business.




To prioritise your application for immediate review or to highlight relevant maritime or energy industry experience, please send a CV and letter to recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512. 




For more information about us, have a look at clarksons.net/about-us and clarksons.com/research




What to expect from us: We believe in human insights and all applications are reviewed by real people, not algorithms. We know your time is valuable and aim to keep to a two-stage process where possible.

Title: Energy Data Analyst
Description:
🌍Energy Data Analyst | Permanent | Hybrid - Brighton | up to £32,000




Are you someone looking to build a career in data and have a passion for sustainability?




PT Renewables is exclusively partnered with a growing, specialist consultancy that helps organisations get a grip on their energy, water and carbon data.




They're now looking for a new Energy Data Analyst to join the team, being in the midst of energy, carbon and usage data with real scope for someone to continue to grow into it.




If you're someone who enjoys digging into a spreadsheet until you find out why the numbers don't add up, this could be a great next move.




The Role

Own energy data end-to-end for a client portfolio - collection, invoicing, and producing journals through SystemsLink.
Work with clients and suppliers to investigate and resolve data issues; electricity metering knowledge (ideally MHHS/AMR exposure) is a plus
Build Power BI reports covering consumption, spend and carbon data, including live reporting
Spot anomalies and gaps, and follow them through to a proper explanation, not just a flag
Act as a genuine client advocate - building relationships and challenging information that doesn't add up




The role will naturally expand into more carbon reporting and wider datasets as your confidence and skills develop.




About You

Some background in energy or utilities - brokerage, supplier, consultancy or a wider utility/data environment
Naturally curious and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in the "why" behind the data
Confident communicator who can build relationships with clients and suppliers
SystemsLink experience is a strong plus; Power BI exposure helps too




Package & Benefits

£32,000 salary
Hybrid working from Brighton office
Structured onboarding, with first six months focused on learning the role and systems
Funded Data Analyst course once established, with a route into a more technical role
Remote working flexibility once settled in
Exposure to live client portfolios, carbon reporting and M&V




If you're an ambitious Data Analyst with a background in energy or sustainability, we'd love to hear from you! Click apply now.

Description:
Salary: Competitive plus benefits

Working Pattern: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

We want give every candidate the opportunity to perform at their best throughout the application and interview process and then ultimately in their role. If you require any adjustments during our recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

In the event that a high volume of suitable applications are received, the post may close prior to the specified closing date. Please apply as soon as possible if interested.

About The Role

Join our dynamic Ecommerce team at Matalan as an Ecommerce Data Analyst! In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in driving our online success by leveraging your technical expertise in data collection, tracking and analysis. You will transform complex web data into clear, compelling stories with actionable recommendations that directly influence business decisions.

A vital role within the Analytics and Ecommerce teams, you will deliver critical web data insights to the Ecommerce team. This involves transforming business questions into analytical problems, analysing intricate datasets, and presenting concise, persuasive, and actionable insights that drive informed decisions and optimize online performance. You will also play a key role in advancing the teams general analytical understanding, tools and processes supporting the Analytics Manager.


Delivery of actionable insight: utilise a variety of analytical techniques to deliver valuable actionable insight that address diverse business challenges
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Comfortable building strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their analytical needs, identify challenges, opportunities and contribute to their strategic roadmaps
Commercial Impact Analysis: Able to evaluate the commercial viability of insights, quantify the impact of data driven decisions and prioritise future work that maximise value delivery.
Analytical Tool and Process Development: Develop and implement tools, reports, and processes that enhance the analytical capabilities of the team and wider business, with a focus on data democratisation and self serve analytics for the key teams.
Insight Democratisation: Create and maintain automated BI that promote data awareness and enhance the business knowledge of our online performance and customer behaviours.
Proactively Driving developments: identifying further business needs by fostering relationships throughout the business and proposing analytical solutions that drive our business forward.
AI generated business performance commentary: develop and maintain automated AI generated commentary on business performance
Active member of the Analytics team: Sharing insight, analytical process and underlying data changes in the ecom area with the wider analytics and data science team as part of our regular knowledge sharing.


About You


Educated to a degree level or with demonstrable relevant experience
Extensive experience of at least 5 years working with BigQuery is essential including a solid understanding of SQL coding
Strong Experience of Google analytics (GA4).
Extensive Experience of visualisation software essential (e.g. Power BI/ Looker).
Understanding of analysis methodologies essential (statistical techniques a plus). 
Awareness of ETL processes and database automation.
Experience working with AI tools to generate automated insights
Confident in Microsoft Excel and full Microsoft Suite. (Or cloud based equivalents)


Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we also offer the below core benefits:


20% staff discount, which increases with length of service
Thrive Recognition Scheme
Wellbeing support provided by the Retail Trust
Life Assurance
Retail Rewards platform offering discounts for other retailers
Pension Scheme
Access to a wide range of career development
Additional benefits may apply depending on your role and area of the business

Title: Advanced Analytics - Data Analyst - SQL
Description:
Data Analyst - Advanced Analytics

Middlesex / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office

£40,000 - £60,000 + excellent benefits, depending on experience

Ref: J13172




Join a high-performing analytics team and make an impact at scale.




If you're an ambitious Data Analyst looking for more than just another reporting role, this could be an opportunity worth exploring.

Our client is a highly successful, globally recognised organisation with an established reputation in its sector and a genuinely exciting data agenda. With analytics playing an increasingly important role in how the business operates and makes decisions, they are investing heavily in their people, technology and capabilities.




You’ll join a large, multi-disciplinary Advanced Analytics function that operates almost like an internal consultancy - partnering with teams across the organisation, tackling complex business challenges and delivering insights that genuinely influence decision-making.




This isn't a role where you'll simply be handed a set of requirements and asked to produce a dashboard. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge thinking, uncover opportunities and turn data into meaningful commercial insight.




Why join?




This is an opportunity to become part of a highly successful organisation that puts real investment behind its people and analytics capability.

You’ll benefit from:




• Working within a high-profile, established global organisation

• An internal consultancy-style environment, giving you exposure to a huge variety of business areas and challenges

• The opportunity to work alongside experienced Analytics Leads and talented analytical peers

• Exposure to advanced technologies, data and analytical techniques

• Significant opportunities to develop your technical and commercial skillset

• Regular interaction with stakeholders across the wider business, including senior decision-makers

• The chance to work on exciting, high-impact projects rather than simply maintaining BAU reporting

• A strong package of employee benefits, perks and rewards

• A collaborative culture where ideas are encouraged and analytical thinking is genuinely valued

• Hybrid working, with 3 days per week in the Middlesex office




The opportunity




The Advanced Analytics team is headed up by four Analytics Leads, each working across exciting and innovative projects for the wider business.

As a Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with one of these Leads and your fellow analysts, becoming a trusted analytical partner to different areas of the organisation.

Permanent position

Based in: Covent Garden, London




To ensure a fair process, late applications will not be considered under any circumstances.




The Royal Ballet and Opera continues to lead the way in opera, ballet, music and dance both live on stage and through multiple digital platforms, from live streaming to worldwide cinema screenings. Our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.




The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.




We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail.
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs.
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.

Experience with ticketing or CRM data.

Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Description:
Commercial Data Analyst

£45,000 – £55,000 | London | Hybrid, 3 days a week on site




Fancy a Data Analyst role where you're actually in the room when the decisions get made?




We're working with a fast-growing luxury fashion and eCommerce group that's investing heavily in its next stage of growth. At the centre of the business is a membership-led digital platform with a growing customer base and a lot of rich behavioural data to dig into.




They're now building out the data, tech and commercial infrastructure to support that growth, and are looking for a Commercial Data Analyst to be one of the foundational people on that journey.

This isn't a dashboards-into-the-void kind of role. You'll be working directly with senior commercial leadership, using data to understand customer behaviour, spot trends, and answer the questions that are actually driving growth across the business.




What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of analysis across customer, membership, trading and operational performance, including:

Using SQL to interrogate data across multiple systems and datasets
Turning broad commercial questions into clear, useful analysis
Spotting trends and opportunities worth digging into further
Building reporting and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar
Presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and senior stakeholders
Helping define and measure the KPIs that matter as the business scales
Working between Commercial and Technology as the business develops its central data warehouse
Supporting data quality, accuracy and reporting logic as that environment evolves




You won't be expected to architect or build the data warehouse, there's already technical ownership in place. Your job is making sure the data coming out of it is accurate, useful, and able to support real commercial decisions.




What we're looking for

Strong SQL skills and confidence working independently with data
Previous experience working with a data warehouse
Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Strong reporting and trend-analysis experience
The ability to explain data clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders
Commercial curiosity, and the confidence to look beyond the original question




Experience in eCommerce, consumer, subscription, membership, marketplace or app-led businesses would be particularly relevant but we're far more interested in how you think than whether you've used the exact same tech stack before.




Why consider it

This is a newly created role with genuine visibility and room to grow. You'll work closely with the senior leader responsible for Commercial Finance, Strategy and Growth, with regular exposure to the wider leadership team.




You'll also be joining at a point where the group is actively improving how it uses data, consolidating reporting, and building the foundations for its next phase of growth. For someone currently sat in a larger analytics team, this could be your chance to:




Take much broader ownership of your analysis
Work directly with senior decision-makers
See the commercial impact of the insights you produce
Help shape a developing data function
Build towards Senior, Manager and potentially broader Data & Analytics leadership as the business scales




Package

£45,000 – £55,000
Hybrid, 3 days a week in the London office
Private medical cover
Staff discount
Further benefits currently being introduced
