Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
*Hybrid or remote for people based in the UK*




What is the job?




We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.




What will you be doing?




Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.
Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.
Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.
Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.
Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.
Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.
Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.




What do you need?




Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.
Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.
A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.
Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.
Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.




What we offer:




Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays
Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave




About Us




Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Location: Stockport, Greater Manchester (Hybrid: 1 to 2 days per week in office)

Salary: Up to £40,000




Are you a data professional with strong SQL and Power BI skills looking to take the next step into modern analytics and Microsoft Fabric?




We are partnering with an established, innovation-focused software business to find a Data Analyst to join their collaborative R&D team. You will report directly to the IT Infrastructure Manager and work alongside experienced software engineers and testers in an environment that actively embraces modern, AI-assisted development tools.




Previous Microsoft Fabric experience is not a must, if you bring solid foundations in SQL and Power BI, the team will provide a dedicated, comprehensive training across Fabric, Azure, and modern cloud data practices.




What You'll Be Doing

Maintain & Enhance Power BI Reports: Support and optimize existing production dashboards, semantic models, and reporting logic.
Build New Solutions: Translate business and user requirements into clean, user-friendly reports and visualizations.
Data Investigation & Querying: Utilize SQL Server to query databases, resolve discrepancies, and ensure reporting reliability.
Modern Data Platform Growth: Get hands-on exposure to Microsoft Fabric workspaces, semantic models, and data pipelines alongside existing SSRS infrastructure.
Leverage AI Tools: Pragmatically use AI-assisted tools to streamline SQL/DAX writing, documentation, and troubleshooting.




What We're Looking For

Core Technical Stack: Hands-on experience writing and troubleshooting SQL queries (SQL Server) and developing/maintaining Power BI reports with DAX.
Experience Level: Practical experience in data analysis, reporting, or BI.
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive, detail-oriented approach to investigating data anomalies and validating business logic.
Bonus Points: Any exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL/cloud services, or SSRS.




Why Apply?

Structured Growth: Dedicated 1-on-1 mentorship during your first few months.
Modern Tech Stack: Immediate pathway to build production-level Microsoft Fabric and cloud analytics experience.
Forward-Thinking Culture: A supportive team that actually encourages you to use modern AI workflows to make your work more efficient.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
GoHenry Data Analyst




GoHenry is a UK-based fintech company created by parents to pioneer financial education. More recently, GoHenry moved into Europe and the US by joining forces with French fintech company PixPay and US investing app, Acorns.




Together, Acorns, PixPay, and GoHenry have over 6 million members across 5 countries.

We are focused on empowering families with engaging money management tools, educational content, and a seamless product experience that creates financial well-being from birth to adulthood. Join us on our mission to make every kid smart with money!




GoHenry is seeking an experienced and self-driven Data Analyst to be a pivotal part of our Data team, providing insights that drive our product forward and help millions of kids and teens build good financial habits. Key technologies are BigQuery, Dataform, Tableau, Veezoo, Amplitude and Monte Carlo.




This role is based in our London office, with the flexibility to work remotely provided you are willing to travel to London when needed. You will be a key member of the Data team, a vibrant group of analysts and engineers dedicated to mastering our craft.




What you will do at GoHenry:

Work with people across the business to deeply understand their objectives, providing analysis and insight to drive the product forwards.
Present critical insights and strategic recommendations to others in a way that is impactful but easy to understand.
Proactively perform in-depth data analysis to identify and understand anomalies.
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to structure, run, and analyse A/B tests, using statistical techniques to ensure reliable findings that improve the customer experience.
Design, build, test, deploy and monitor data models and semantic models, following all best practices and team standards and processes.
Share knowledge with other team members, playing an active role in the wider data team.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data practices, taking on new challenges as the team grows.




What you will bring to GoHenry:




Essential:

Very strong knowledge of SQL in a data warehouse environment.
Experience building robust and compelling dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau.
Good working knowledge of product experimentation techniques and statistical methods.
Experience using a data transformation tool such as dbt or Dataform.
A curiosity and desire to learn how GoHenry works, and gain a deep understanding of the product structure and business models.
Previous experience working as a data analyst, ideally in a B2C environment.
A team player fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
A hunger to continually improve yourself and others, using the latest technologies such as Claude Code to increase impact.




Desirable:

Good working knowledge of BigQuery.
Experience building semantic models / knowledge graphs, or a desire to learn.
Experience working with event analytic platforms such as Amplitude.




What's in it for you?

All the essentials you would expect, including a workplace pension plan, 33 days of holiday (including public holidays), & great company events local & abroad!

Other Offers:

GoFlex - Work from Home, Office, or a mix of both
Your Birthday Day off
25 days annual leave, in addition to 8 UK bank holidays
An excellent Induction & onboarding program with ongoing learning & development throughout your career
A choice between Bupa Health Cash Plan or Bupa Private Medical
Death in service – 4x your annual salary from month 1
Physical and Mental Wellbeing support and platforms for you and your family
Family-friendly leave policies
Enhanced maternity leave – 20 weeks full basic pay after 2 years’ service and 26 weeks full basic pay after 3 years’ service
Paternity leave – 4 weeks full pay after probation
Salary Sacrifice options




About GoHenry

We’re on a mission to help every kid be smart with money. Our goal? Create generations of independent, confident young adults, armed with money skills that will set them up for life.




How we do it:

We place the power in the hands of young people, giving them the tools they need to master the financial ropes for themselves. They can spend, save, earn, and give with GoHenry’s prepaid debit card and app – because learning through doing really works (and it’s more fun!). All while our unique built-in controls give parents total peace of mind.




We’re proud to say...

We ranked #38 in Newsweek's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces in the UK in 2023
We’re one of Tech Track’s top 50 fastest-growing UK companies.
We won Finders Kid’s Cards Customer Satisfaction Awards in 2022 and 2023.
We won the Tech for Good award at the Better Society Awards 2023
Our kids and parents have donated over £500,000 of their own money to NSPCC via their GoHenry accounts




But we’re still growing, and that’s why we need you.




GoHenry is an equal-opportunity employer, and we’re on a mission to foster a diverse & inclusive workplace. Individuals seeking employment at GoHenry are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst - Supply
Description:
Data Analyst

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace is critical to meeting the growing demand for high-quality human data. To champion this effort, you will own analytics across the entire participant lifecycle, spanning acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation.

What you’ll bring to the role


Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g., pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a track record of building scalable reporting frameworks in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Comfortable owning problems end-to-end—from raw data to executive-ready insight.
Experience analyzing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioral cohorts.
Experience designing and analyzing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking.
Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations.
Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance—understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially.
Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment, setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and driving initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
Proven ability to partner across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Finance functions.
Strong grasp of B2B and two-sided marketplace metrics and economics.
Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready insights that shape strategy and execution.


What you'll be doing


Working hands-on with SQL and Python
Building the metrics, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks that help us understand behavior and improve the participant experience.
Partnering closely with Product, Operations, Growth, and Data Science
Identifying opportunities, structuring experiments, and translating complex marketplace data into clear decisions that ensure participant health, marketplace liquidity, and long-term supply sustainability.


Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Overview:

Team Creation Limited is a fast-growing software development company operating across Asia and Europe. We provide services including market research, artificial intelligence solutions, cloud computing, and mobile application development for a broad range of international clients. Our focus is on delivering innovative and high-quality technology solutions while supporting the continued growth and development of our professional workforce.




Role Overview:

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to join our London team, working across our global product portfolio. You will partner with Product, Operations, and Commercial teams to shape decisions through rigorous analysis — from feature performance and A/B experimentation to market expansion, to user behaviour across regions.

We are looking for someone who is commercially sharp, technically strong, and can hold their own in a room of product managers and senior stakeholders.




Key Responsibilities:

Product analytics — Define metrics for new and existing features. Design and analyse A/B tests end-to-end: hypothesis, sample sizing, statistical readout, and decision recommendation. Diagnose user behaviour, identify drop-off points, and surface opportunities the product team has not yet considered.
Operational and commercial analysis — Build the analytical backbone for business reviews: revenue drivers, retention, cohort performance, LTV, segmentation. Translate dashboard observations into actionable next steps for ops and commercial leads.
New market and new product line analysis — Lead the analytics for market entries and product launches: sizing the opportunity, defining success metrics pre-launch, monitoring post-launch performance, and identifying what to scale or kill.
Deep-dive investigations — Own ambiguous business questions end-to-end. Frame the problem, design the analysis, build the models, validate assumptions, and present a clear recommendation. You are expected to drive the analysis, not wait to be told what to query.
Stakeholder influence — Communicate findings to Product, Ops, and senior leadership with clarity and conviction. Push back when the data disagrees with the prevailing view, and earn trust through rigour.




Qualifications & Skills:

5+ years of analytics experience in a consumer-facing product environment, with demonstrable impact on product and commercial outcomes.
Advanced SQL — comfortable writing performant queries against large, complex datasets; window functions, CTEs, query optimisation.
Strong Python — pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels (or equivalent); able to build analysis pipelines, not just notebooks.
Solid applied statistics — experimental design, hypothesis testing, sample sizing, multiple testing correction, regression, causal inference fundamentals. You know when a statistical method fits and, more importantly, when it does not.
Strong product sense — you understand how users interact with products, why features succeed or fail, and how to translate behavioural signals into product hypotheses. You think like a PM as much as an analyst.
Commercial thinking — you prioritise analysis by business impact, not data availability. You can articulate how your work moves revenue, retention, or growth.
Structured analytical thinking — you break ambiguous questions into structured problems, identify the right framework, and communicate the logic clearly. Frameworks such as AARRR, North Star, opportunity sizing, and driver trees should feel natural to you.
Exceptional communication — clear written and verbal English; able to influence non-technical audiences and challenge senior stakeholders with evidence.
Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Metabase).
Experience working with global or multi-region data — comfortable with timezone handling, currency normalisation, and cross-market comparisons.
Right to work in the UK.
Fluency in Mandarin or Cantonese is required in addition to English, for collaboration with regional teams.




We Offer:

Experience a dynamic and team-oriented work environment.
Opportunities for personal growth and learning.
An open, inclusive and supportive team where you will be valued, and your suggestions will be welcome.
26 days paid holiday per year, in addition to local public holidays.
Competitive salary.
Risk Benefits such as pension, Life Assurance (4x annual salary), Private Medical Insurance.
Team Building activities.
Local discounts and more...!

Multiple Regions, Global Hubs – Fully Remote

Competitive, Dependent on Location




Please note: Applications submitted through LinkedIn's official apply process will be considered after the closing date. CVs sent via direct message/email are not reviewed.

We're hiring Data Analysts to help turn client data into insight that feeds directly into AI-driven recommendations. You'll work close to the delivery teams building the actual solutions.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing


Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation.
Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently.
Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence.
Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth.
Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact.


What You’ll Bring


Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights.
Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel.
A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making.
A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes.


How You Will Make An Impact


Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance.
Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most.
Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability.
Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities.
Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness.
Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.


Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You’ll Get From Us


Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme
Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands.
Holiday entitlement
Hybrid Working Model
Refer-a-friend scheme
Learning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes.
Mental Health and Wellbeing Support
Life Assurance
Interest Free Loans

Title: Academy Head of Performance Analysis
Description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Head of Coaching

Reporting to: Assistant Academy Manager

Closing Date For Applications: 20th September 2026

About the Role:

The successful candidate will lead, coordinate, and drive the delivery of performance analysis support across all Academy age groups at Nottingham Forest FC. They will be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Academy analysis department, ensuring high-quality support is provided to players and staff throughout the development pathway.

The role will involve monitoring and tracking player development through the effective use of both objective and subjective performance data, helping to inform coaching practice and individual development plans.

In addition, the position holder will play a key role in upholding and embedding the Academy’s philosophy and methodology, supporting the wider vision of the Academy. Working closely with the Head of Player Development, Methodology and Innovation and Academy Coach Development Manager, they will contribute to the education and development of coaching staff while also actively participating in broader Academy management and strategic projects.

The Perks of the Job:


Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Access to high street and gym discounts.
Discount within our Club shop.
Free on-site parking.


Key Tasks and Responsibilities:


To lead the support provision and requirements of the performance analysis function within the academy.
Oversee the analysis related to philosophy and methodology, aiding the academy vision.
Manage the day-to-day academy analysis operations ensuring effective processes to deliver actionable insights across all age groups.
Work in partnership with MDT teams to ensure high level reporting methods are delivered to players, coaches and key stakeholders across academy and loans.
Oversee individual analysis of Academy players using subjective and objective data to inform the Head of Academy and Academy Management Team.
Lead specific analysis projects related to the long-term development of Nottingham Forest Academy Analysis department.
Drive the club’s analytical products and processes to ensure the delivery of high-quality, actionable insights that support player development and performance outcomes.
Ensure effective professional development programme is implemented for both individual staff and analysis team.
Recruit permanent staff when the need arises in line with club protocols.
Manage and oversee the academy internship programme, supporting the recruitment, development, and day-to-day guidance of interns within the department.
Produce when required monthly, quarterly and yearly reports in line with our Academy strategy to update on progress met and achieved in relation to our performance analysis strategic pillar.
To create successful and professional relationships with players and staff whilst maintaining professional distance from playing staff at all times.
To act, at all times, in a manner appropriate to a representative of Nottingham Forest FC
All staff are responsible for the wellbeing and safeguarding of children and vulnerable adults on all Club sites. If you have a concern or witness a Safeguarding matter, you must report it to the department’s Designated Safeguarding Officer (DSO) or the Club’s Lead DSO or Senior Safeguarding Manager. If It’s an emergency, you are to call the relevant emergency service such as Police or CAMHS.


What are we looking for:


Excellent understanding of football tactics and Talent Identification in players.
Excellent attention to detail and is very well organised and punctual
Able to communicate effectively at all levels and is fully computer literate.
Works effectively in a fast-paced environment; remains calm under pressure and is comfortable working to tight deadlines.
Prior experience managing kit and equipment for a sporting institution preferably within football (desirable)
Full knowledge and experience of all duties involved in a role of this nature.
Drive to achieve deadlines, organise and prioritise workload effectively, and continually review ways to improve efficiency and effectiveness
Demonstrate skills and attributes in a PA/administration capacity
Good verbal and written communication skills and be able to understand and explain matters arising in own area of work.
Excellent interpersonal skills, with people of all ages and backgrounds, able to maintain confidentiality, and act with tact and diplomacy
Willingness and flexibility to deal with urgent changes/ demands, whilst maintaining existing workload.
UEFA B license and educated in either Performance Analysis, Sports Science and/or coaching.
Excellent IT skills, including MS Office, intranets, web and Outlook
Experience in health and safety duties and responsibilities appropriate to the post (desirable)
Skill at handling difficult situations and confidential matters according to policy and procedures, referring to others where necessary/appropriate (desirable)


Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Contract type: Permanent

Hours: Full-time, 35 hours

Location: Head Office, Nottingham (Hybrid working, minimum 2 days per week)

Application process: Please apply via the application button which will direct you to our careers site. If you require any adjustments to assist you in applying, please contact careers@thenottingham.com




At Nottingham Building Society our talent acquisition approach is rooted in openness and inclusive hiring, so even if you don’t feel you tick every box, we’d still genuinely love to hear from you.




We are investing in the future of data, creating a brand-new enterprise Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric and Azure that will transform how we use data across the organisation. As a Data Engineer, you'll be at the heart of this initiative, helping to build the platform, frameworks and capabilities that will support everything from business insight and regulatory reporting to advanced analytics and AI. This is a rare opportunity to influence the design and direction of a modern data ecosystem from day one.




Joining a collaborative and forward-thinking team, you'll combine technical expertise with innovation to deliver scalable, secure and high-performing data solutions. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business, helping to unlock the value of data and drive better outcomes for our members. If you're passionate about modern data engineering and want to play a key role in shaping something new, we'd love to hear from you.




Here’s a taste of what you will be doing as a Data Engineer at Nottingham Building Society:




Build Our New Data Platform - Design, develop and operate a scalable, secure and high-performing data platform using Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Power BI technologies.
Develop Data Integration Solutions - Create and maintain robust ingestion and transformation pipelines, integrating data from internal systems and third-party platforms including Salesforce, Sopra Banking Services, CACI and Experian.
Engineer Modern Data Architectures - Design Lakehouse, Warehouse and Delta Lake solutions using medallion architectures to support enterprise analytics and reporting.
Deliver Analytics-Ready Data Assets - Build trusted, well-modelled datasets and semantic models that enable self-service BI, regulatory reporting and data-driven decision making.
Champion DataOps & DevOps - Develop automated deployment pipelines, CI/CD processes and engineering standards using Azure DevOps and Git-based development practices.
Drive Data Quality & Governance - Implement controls, monitoring, lineage and governance frameworks that ensure data remains reliable, secure and compliant.
Monitor & Optimise Performance - Continuously improve platform performance, observability and operational resilience through proactive monitoring and alerting.
Collaborate Across The Business - Work closely with Data Architects, Analysts and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that create meaningful value for members and colleagues.




About You:




Microsoft Fabric Expertise - You have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric technologies including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Spark and Power BI.
Strong Engineering Skills - You're proficient in SQL, Python and PySpark, with experience developing scalable and maintainable data solutions.
Modern Data Platform Experience - You've successfully built, enhanced or operated cloud-based data platforms, ideally within Azure environments.
Data Architecture Knowledge - You understand data modelling, ELT/ETL design, Delta Lake principles, data quality frameworks and modern engineering best practices.
Cloud & DevOps Capability - You have experience with Azure services, automation, CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code approaches.
Collaborative Mindset - You enjoy working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, building strong relationships and delivering outcomes together.
Continuous Improvement Focus - You're naturally curious, enjoy exploring new technologies and are passionate about improving processes, standards and ways of working.
Quality & Purpose Driven - You take pride in delivering high-quality solutions, balancing technical excellence with a commitment to creating positive outcomes for customers, colleagues and communities.




Reward & Benefits:




Competitive Package: Fair salary benchmarked against market data, annual discretionary bonus, and 29 days holiday plus bank holidays.
Health & Wellbeing: Access to Medicash, mental health first aiders, and a suite of wellbeing resources to support you inside and outside of work.
Work-Life Balance: 35-hour working week for full-time roles, with flexibility to help you perform at your best.
Career Growth: Ongoing personal and professional development, we’ll support your ambitions and help you grow your potential.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a friendly, values-led team that genuinely cares about doing the right thing for colleagues and customers.
Giving Back: Use two paid volunteering days each year to support causes close to your heart, through our Samuel Fox Foundation.
Sustainability Focus: Join a business committed to reducing its carbon footprint and making a positive impact on the environment.
Free access to Octopus Money: Financial coaching & tools that help you plan, manage, and make the most of your money.




Embracing Diversity Together:




We proudly embrace and celebrate diversity as a fundamental cornerstone of our values. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is not just essential for our success but is also a reflection of the vibrant communities we serve. Our commitment to diversity extends beyond our internal culture to the way we approach advertising and engage with our customers.




Our commitment means actively working to eliminate barriers and biases that may hinder equal opportunities within our organisation. We strive to ensure that all individuals, regardless of background, have an equal chance to thrive and advance in their careers.




We acknowledge that diversity is not just a goal to be achieved but a continuous journey toward creating an environment that embraces differences and promotes equal opportunities for all. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, creativity, and a sense of belonging for every member of our community.

Title: Water Resources Planning Specialist
Description:
Joining ARUP




Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.




We work across the entire water cycle, with utilities, local and regional governments, commercial and domestic water users and other partners. From designing and maintaining key water infrastructure to advising on natural catchments and flood defences, we help clients to consider the long-term economic, environmental and social dimensions of their proposals.




The opportunity




We are seeking a Water Resources Planning Specialist to join our growing Water Resources team, supporting water companies to develop resilient, sustainable and evidence-based plans to meet future water needs.




Water resources planning is central to responding to climate change, population growth, environmental protection and long-term resilience. Working across Water Resource Management Plans, Drought Plans, regional planning studies and Strategic Resource Options, you will help clients make informed decisions about future water supplies, drought resilience and investment priorities.




This is primarily a technical specialist role, rather than a project management position. You will take ownership of defined technical work packages, working alongside specialists in hydrology, environmental assessment, economics, engineering and digital delivery to develop robust planning evidence and clear recommendations.




The Role Will Focus On




Water resources planning, strategy development and supply-demand balance assessment.
Drought resilience, adaptive planning and climate change scenario testing.
Water resources modelling, data analysis and interpretation of planning evidence.
Option appraisal, best-value planning and Strategic Resource Options.
Environmental and regulatory assessment, including SEA, HRA and WFD-related inputs.
Clear technical reporting, client workshops, consultations and regulatory submissions.




Is this role right for you?




If you have all or some of the skills and experience below, and a passion for making a difference in the water sector - we’d love to hear from you.




Experience in water resources planning, water company planning, hydrology, environmental assessment or a related discipline.
A degree, or equivalent experience, in water resources, civil engineering, environmental engineering, geography, environmental science, hydrology or a related subject.
Understanding of WRMPs, Drought Plans, supply-demand balance assessment and resilience planning.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience analysing technical or environmental datasets.
Ability to prepare clear technical reports and communicate complex information simply.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.




Desirable

Experience supporting SROs or regional planning studies.
Knowledge of water resources and drought planning guidance, including relevant methods and emerging issues.
Knowledge of climate change adaptation, adaptive planning, options appraisal or best-value planning.
Understanding of SEA, HRA or WFD.
Experience with GIS, spatial analysis, digital delivery, regulatory submissions or consultation.
Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, with CIWEM, ICE or another relevant institution.




You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If you bring relevant experience, strong analytical skills and a willingness to keep learning, we would like to hear from you.




This role is intended for an established technical professional who is developing recognised expertise in water resources planning. You will lead defined technical work packages, provide high-quality planning advice and contribute to major water resources programmes, with support from senior specialists and project managers on overall project leadership and commercial management.

What We Offer You




At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.




Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.




We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.




We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.




Different people, shared values




Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.




Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup

Title: Category Manager
Description:
Category Manager – FMCG

Location: Nottingham

Sector: FMCG / Consumer Goods




The Role




An established and growing FMCG business is looking for a commercially focused Category Manager to lead category strategy and development across key retail customers.

This is a highly commercial role, using shopper, market and retailer data to identify growth opportunities, influence customer plans and support the wider commercial strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Own and develop category strategies and customer-specific category plans
Analyse market, shopper and retailer data to identify trends, opportunities and risks
Translate data and insights into clear commercial recommendations
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Customer teams
Develop category reviews, presentations and customer-facing recommendations
Identify opportunities across range, distribution, pricing, promotions, merchandising and NPD
Support and influence key retailer relationships
Monitor competitor activity, market performance and category trends
Build compelling category stories and presentations for retail customers
Use data and insight to drive category growth, revenue and profitability
Support wider commercial projects and strategic initiatives

About You

We're looking for someone with:

3–5+ years' FMCG Category Management / Category Insight experience
Experience working with major UK retailers
Strong understanding of category, shopper and market data
Experience using Nielsen/Circana, Kantar, IRI or similar data sources
Strong commercial understanding and the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations
Confidence presenting insights and recommendations to customers and senior stakeholders
Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills
Ideally, experience within FMCG, consumer goods, retail or a related category

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity for a commercially minded Category Manager to join a well-established consumer business, working across key retail customers and having a genuine influence on category growth and commercial strategy.

Title: Procurement Analyst
Description:
Job Description

We're looking for a talented Procurement Analyst to support the growing maturity of our procurement function and help drive supplier excellence across our supply chain.

The role

As a Procurement Analyst, you'll report to the Head of Procurement, playing a key part in a newly created role that supports the development of our procurement function at Browne Jacobson. You'll help ensure our suppliers align with the needs of our clients and meet expectations around DEI and sustainability, sharing insights and findings from data collection with the procurement team and the wider firm.

What You'll Be Doing

Drawing on your analytical skills, you'll take ownership of key procurement activities, including:



Managing the firm's supplier due diligence process to ensure an appropriate assessment of the risk profile of new and existing suppliers.
Developing a KPI structure and related reporting to plan, track and measure procurement and supplier activities and performance.
Working with multiple internal and external stakeholders to improve sustainability and DEI visibility across our supply chains, and introducing strategies to increase engagement with diverse and local suppliers - including tracking and reporting metrics.

Title: Associate AI Data Engineer
Description:
Role Purpose

Location- Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom

Level - Associate

Department - Product R&D

Working Pattern - Remote

Benefits - Benefits at Ideagen

Salary - £32k - £48k Dependent On Experience.

At Ideagen, we're on a mission to embed AI at the heart of our products and create smarter experiences for customers around the world.

As an Associate AI Data Engineer, you'll help build the data foundations that power these innovations. From developing scalable data pipelines to preparing and governing AI-ready datasets, you'll play a key role in enabling machine learning, automation and generative AI solutions across our product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone looking to accelerate their career in data engineering while gaining exposure to real-world AI challenges. You'll work with modern technologies, collaborate with highly skilled engineers, and contribute to projects that are helping shape the next generation of AI-powered products at Ideagen.

Responsibilities


Building scalable data pipelines that power AI models, machine learning workflows, and intelligent product features.
Transforming large and complex datasets into trusted, high-quality, AI-ready data assets.
Developing ETL/ELT solutions using Python, SQL, AWS, and modern data engineering practices.
Improving data quality, monitoring, governance, and reliability across data platforms.
Contributing to innovative AI initiatives, including dataset versioning, labelling workflows, and AI-powered automation.
Collaborating with AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to solve complex technical challenges.
Exploring new technologies and helping evolve the platforms that support Ideagen's AI strategy.


Skills And Experience


Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data integration solutions.
Strong Python and SQL skills with the ability to develop, troubleshoot, and optimise data workflows.
Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, or Athena.
Understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring, and governance principles.
Passion for solving complex problems using data, technology, and automation.
Interest or experience in AI, machine learning, MLOps, or large language models would be advantageous.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced AI environment.


About Ideagen

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day - from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.

We’re building a future-ready team, and AI is part of how we work smarter. If you're curious, adaptable and open to using AI to improve how you work, you’ll thrive at Ideagen!

What is next?

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com . All matters will be treated with strict confidence.

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process. Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

Title: Global Pricing Solutions Senior Specialist (Anywhere in Europe)
Description:
Meda Pharma GmbH & Co KG

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach, and better access to treatment.

For those driven to live their lives with purpose, Viatris helps employees realize their full potential by creating a collaborative culture that fosters courage and resilience. Viatris is more than just a place to work. This is a place to make a difference in the world.

The Role & What You Will Be Doing

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference, and here’s how the Global Pricing Solutions Senior Specialist (Anywhere in Europe) role will make an impact:

The Global Pricing Solution Senior Specialist is responsible for owning and optimizing Viatris’ global pricing system, ensuring it supports accurate, efficient, and compliant pricing operations across markets. This role acts as the key link between business, IT, vendors, and end users, driving system performance, enhancements, upgrades, master data integrity, reporting, and user enablement. The position plays a critical part in strengthening international reference pricing capabilities, improving data quality and process consistency, and enabling global and local stakeholders to make informed pricing decisions.


Be a business owner of the Pricing System (International Reference Pricing), working with IT and Vendor to resolve issues and enhance system capabilities and features, development, enhancements, testing and deployment of systems and trainings
Take the lead of regular and scheduled system upgrades/releases provided by Vendor with proper timeline management
User management for the Global Pricing System (Control of user access, number of licenses and development of pricing system training resources for current and new users).
Be the point of contact in the Pricing System for the system end users. Partner with Regulatory, Pricing, Market access and other stakeholders at local and global level to understand their needs, ensure their proper training and to improve processes
Collaborate with Global Pricing team by providing system support, mass data upload and custom data reports
Validate and manage the system Codes/SKU information/Launches (master data), including integration of acquired and/or divested portfolios
Pricing System master data updates, improvements and validation based on the harmonization with Financial Budget / Volumes / FX rates
Data integration of different sources via API within the Pricing System
Pricing System data audit and accuracy vs other sources



About Your Skills & Experience

For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:


Must have extensive experience of Pricing System (International Reference Pricing); preferably as a solution owner. Experience with ModelN or Navlin platforms is a plus
Must have experience in partnering with IT teams to develop or maintain commercial systems, being part of IT project management
Must possess strong technical skills and knowledge of Microsoft office, mainly Excel. Experience with master data and/or database management based on SQL and/or ETL tool a plus
Strong interaction and communication with stakeholders to understand their needs
Business acumen to transform business needs to technical terms
Previous experience in International Reference Price is desired
Regional or Global experience is desired
Detail-oriented and result-driven
Must possess analytical, communication, influencing, problem solving and writing skills
Proficiency in speaking, comprehending, reading, and writing English is required
Education: Business, Finance background preferred



At Viatris, we are dedicated to building a truly diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t fully align with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why Viatris?

At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits, and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives, and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. You will also have the opportunity to access excellent career progression opportunities and work-life balance initiatives.

The Role & What You Will Be Doing

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference, and here’s how the Global Pricing Solutions Senior Specialist (Anywhere in Europe) role will make an impact:

The Global Pricing Solution Senior Specialist is responsible for owning and optimizing Viatris’ global pricing system, ensuring it supports accurate, efficient, and compliant pricing operations across markets. This role acts as the key link between business, IT, vendors, and end users, driving system performance, enhancements, upgrades, master data integrity, reporting, and user enablement. The position plays a critical part in strengthening international reference pricing capabilities, improving data quality and process consistency, and enabling global and local stakeholders to make informed pricing decisions.

  • Be a business owner of the Pricing System (International Reference Pricing), working with IT and Vendor to resolve issues and enhance system capabilities and features, development, enhancements, testing and deployment of systems and trainings
  • Take the lead of regular and scheduled system upgrades/releases provided by Vendor with proper timeline management
  • User management for the Global Pricing System (Control of user access, number of licenses and development of pricing system training resources for current and new users).
  • Be the point of contact in the Pricing System for the system end users. Partner with Regulatory, Pricing, Market access and other stakeholders at local and global level to understand their needs, ensure their proper training and to improve processes
  • Collaborate with Global Pricing team by providing system support, mass data upload and custom data reports
  • Validate and manage the system Codes/SKU information/Launches (master data), including integration of acquired and/or divested portfolios
  • Pricing System master data updates, improvements and validation based on the harmonization with Financial Budget / Volumes / FX rates
  • Data integration of different sources via API within the Pricing System
  • Pricing System data audit and accuracy vs other sources


About Your Skills & Experience

For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

  • Must have extensive experience of Pricing System (International Reference Pricing); preferably as a solution owner. Experience with ModelN or Navlin platforms is a plus
  • Must have experience in partnering with IT teams to develop or maintain commercial systems, being part of IT project management
  • Must possess strong technical skills and knowledge of Microsoft office, mainly Excel. Experience with master data and/or database management based on SQL and/or ETL tool a plus
  • Strong interaction and communication with stakeholders to understand their needs
  • Business acumen to transform business needs to technical terms
  • Previous experience in International Reference Price is desired
  • Regional or Global experience is desired
  • Detail-oriented and result-driven
  • Must possess analytical, communication, influencing, problem solving and writing skills
  • Proficiency in speaking, comprehending, reading, and writing English is required
  • Education: Business, Finance background preferred


At Viatris, we are dedicated to building a truly diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t fully align with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Title: Digital Business Analyst
Description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

The Business Analyst will work within a global delivery team, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Architects, Project and Portfolio Management teams, project support teams, and Business Change teams, reporting to the Head of Delivery.

This role supports the successful delivery of a prioritised portfolio of projects and programmes across the organisation. It offers the opportunity to contribute to key business initiatives that support Arup's strategic goals and commitment to design excellence. The position provides broad exposure to enterprise-wide transformation and the delivery of the firm's five-year strategy.

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.


Provides exposure to work on global projects and programmes as well as emerging technologies
Being part of a global team that provides exposure to different countries and cultures
Establishes a solid career pathway that is competency based where development opportunities are part of continued professional development
The role engages in requirements workshops and engineering, stakeholder analysis, value management, opportunities to proxy as product managers, testing analysis, communities of practice and skills network engagement as well as opportunities to own continuous improvement initiatives


Did you know: Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year at the Chartered Institute of IT’s UK IT Industry Awards.

Is this role right for you?


Experienced in working on projects with highly satisfied sponsors and end users, having achieved tangible results and business outcomes, leading to value creation and benefits realisation
Capable of articulating the value of business analysis when engaging with stakeholders, and calling upon a range of business analysis techniques when eliciting requirements
Experience working with different delivery methodologies, with a focus on agile and iterative value creation in a user-centred design environment
Proven track record in software product development, data or automation projects in a cloud-oriented, secure, global landscape
Experience working with diverse teams across several global locations, time zones or cultural backgrounds


What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We care about you and want you to perform at your best, which is why we offer one of the most competitive benefits packages in our sector. As a member organisation, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). We also provide private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at Careers - Your Life at Arup .

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit our Careers page Our aim is to make this process as streamlined and easy as possible for our applicants.

Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal and applications sent via email will not be considered. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world.

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

An environment that will give you freedom to design with a purpose, focus on your skills to deliver quality work to our clients, opportunity to learn and share knowledge openly. You will have the opportunity to utilise your technical expertise to improve the lives of the most vulnerable in the communities in which we live and work through Arup's community engagement programme.  

You'll have access to lots of learning opportunities and ongoing training through Arup university and other learning programmes.

Title: Credit Risk Manager
Description:
Salary: From 48K, depending on experience

Hours: Monday to Friday, 36.25 hours per week (between 8am and 4pm)

Working style: Hybrid – 3 days per week on site

Location: Calverton, Nottingham

We’re looking for an outstanding Credit Risk Manager to lead our Risk and Data Integrity team.

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It's the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals together. This is our calling.

Let’s talk about the role!

As Credit Risk Manager you will be managing the credit risk strategies of VF’s EMEA Credit Department, including the protection of the debtor asset and simultaneously optimising commercial growth. You will provide focus to motivate and develop your team in new and innovative ways of working.

How you will make a difference:


Responsible for developing the credit risk strategy and policy, including challenging current practices and implementing processes
Ensure the analysis of customer financial accounts including balance sheet, profit and loss statement & cash flow statement, as well as stress-testing the findings
Accountable for overseeing the processing and opening of all new accounts for the whole of VF's EMEA business with appropriate risk analysis and data quality
Conduct regular risk meetings wither internal- and external stakeholders, including regular updates on macro-economic data
Provide specialised training on systems and risk related processes to the Credit Department as well as training to impacted external stakeholders
Explore new ways of working using AI with the goal of automating repetitive and time-consuming parts of processes


Skills For Success


Deep understanding of credit risk and credit risk modelling, in particular IFRS 9
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Leadership Skills, managing Team Leaders and projects
Be comfortable to make a decision, be assertive and adaptable
Strong stakeholder management, negotiating and influencing skills 
Practical knowledge Power BI, Python or Tableau as well as creation of AI agents would be beneficial


What’s In It For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package:


A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do
An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together
Being part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization
50% employee discount on all VF brands both in store and online
Subsidised canteen and break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks
Health Shield membership and access to numerous health and wellbeing initiatives
Employee Assistance Program, offering access to free services such as Mental Health and wellbeing support as well as legal and financial advice.
25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) rising to 29 with length of service and your birthday off
12% contributory smart pension scheme (8% on us, 4% from you)
Cycle to work scheme
Free secure onsite parking


Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity:

As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, VF is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both VF associates and applicants alike.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

Title: PPC & Paid Media Manager
Description:
Job Description

Overview




Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world?




At TTS we aim to give every child, every day, a reason to love learning.




We're proud to have supplied schools and learning environments across the globe with innovative educational resources for 40 years offering over 50,000 resources, of which 6,000 are our own developed IP!




Our in-house experts collaborate with teachers and educational experts to create unique and innovative resources that engage children and inspire a lifelong love of learning. Every TTS resource provides unlimited learning opportunities and is made to last, making the most of schools’ and nurseries’ limited budgets and ensuring years of classroom use.




TTS is part of the RM Group – a pioneer in the education technology space, and since 2004, we share a vision to improve education outcomes worldwide.

At RM, we’ve been pioneers of education technology since 1973. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide.




What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful.




RM operates through three divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions), Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools), and TTS (educational resources).




Visit our website to find out more: https://www.tts-group.co.uk/




The education sector is transforming, so this is an exciting time to join RM as a Digital Performance Manager, working in a hybrid capacity, with two days per week based in Hucknall.




We are seeking an experienced PPC & Paid Media Manager to join TTS and drive the success and growth of our paid online marketing campaigns for our market-leading ecommerce brand in the education sector.




For paid digital advertising you will be responsible for the strategy, execution, and optimisation of paid search campaigns across various online channels. Your focus will be on maximising return on advertising spend, driving customer acquisition, and contributing to the overall revenue growth of the business.




This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about search and has a proven track record of increasing traffic and revenue.







Responsibilities




Job Purpose:




As part of a small and experienced core team, the PPC & Paid Media Manager role is both hands-on and strategic and your day-to-day work will be key to delivering and shaping the future direction and growth of the business.




You will be instrumental in helping to drive and deliver the ambitious paid advertising strategy and revenue targets, in a competitive B2B ecommerce environment.
