Title: Volunteer Reports Specialist – History, Impact & Institutional Reporting with Animana & Hecho por nosotros
Description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Fellow

Ashoka Fellows are leading social entrepreneurs that have been taken through a rigorous selection process, testing the quality of their ideas and character, to become part of the Ashoka Fellowship and Network. Ashoka Fellows take on the challenges of building innovative system change ideas to make and spread social impact in a world wrought with challenges. They refuse to let the ‘impossible’ stand in their way to creating a better world.

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

The textile and creative industries touch every layer of society, yet remain among the world’s most polluting and exploitative sectors. Hecho por Nosotros (HxN) exists to transform this reality. Founded by Adriana Marina, PhD in Economics and Ashoka Fellow, HxN is a UN ECOSOC-accredited NGO with 17 years of experience advancing a fair, regenerative, and inclusive creative economy—one where indigenous knowledge is protected, artisans are recognized as innovators, and technology strengthens communities. Together with our sister organization animaná, a certified B Corp social enterprise and ethical fashion brand, we have connected 8,500+ artisans, 20,000+ natural fiber producers, and 80+ organizations across Latin America, Africa, and Asia. Our work sits at the intersection of fashion, culture, technology, and systemic change, with an international presence through the United Nations, Ashoka, AI for Good, Erasmus+, UNEP, and Stanford. At the heart of our work is the convergence of Artificial Intelligence and Ancestral Intelligence—using innovation to preserve knowledge, strengthen communities, and transform global value chains. We are not simply an NGO. We are a platform, a fellowship, and a movement – made by us, for all of us. @hechoxnosotros | @animanaonline

For more information, please visit https://www.hechoxnosotros.org/

Job Description

Hecho por Nosotros (HxN) is looking for a Reports Specialist to join a permanent and high-priority team responsible for documenting, structuring, analyzing, and communicating the organization’s work, history, and impact. The role combines two interconnected dimensions of reporting. The first focuses on developing the internal systems needed to collect information across HxN, including reporting frameworks, forms, timelines, and processes that enable different areas to consistently document their work and contributions in a timely manner. The second focuses on transforming this information into institutional reports and accountability documents for external organizations, international institutions, and strategic networks. Beyond collecting data, the team plays an important role in telling the story of HxN. Our reports should reflect the organization’s history, evolution, and impact as an interconnected whole rather than relying on generic descriptions or isolated figures. Strong storytelling, research, analytical, and writing skills are therefore essential to connect information from different areas and communicate the significance of HxN’s work. The key responsibilities of this role are as follows:


The Reports Specialist will design and improve internal reporting frameworks, forms, and processes to ensure that HxN teams document and submit relevant information consistently and on time.
The role will coordinate the collection and organization of data, evidence, and sources across departments, contributing to History & Impact Reports that communicate HxN’s evolution, work, and impact through a coherent and meaningful narrative.
The Specialist will also support the preparation of institutional reports and accountability documents for international organizations and networks, including the United Nations Global Compact, contributing to the Communication on Engagement (CoE) and Communication on Progress (CoP).
The role combines research, storytelling, analysis, and cross-area coordination to strengthen HxN’s reporting practices and institutional documentation.


After completing an initial 6-month volunteer period, participants may request a certificate acknowledging their collaboration with Hecho por Nosotros (HxN) and animana, including the area in which they contributed and the tasks and responsibilities carried out during their experience with the organization. Please let us know today if you'd like to join us!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 10–15 hours/week

The estimated duration of the project is: 6-12 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English

Desired Skills And Experience


Bachelor’s degree, graduate student, or equivalent experience in Communications, Journalism, International Relations, International Development, Public Policy, Sustainability, Social Sciences, Research, Project Management, or a related field.
Experience in reporting, research, impact assessment, institutional communications, documentation, storytelling, or project coordination is highly valued.
Familiarity with international organizations, the United Nations, UN Global Compact, SDGs, or other institutional and sustainability frameworks is an asset.
Strong analytical, organizational, research, and writing skills, with the ability to work with information from multiple sources and translate it into clear, structured, and meaningful reports.
Experience designing reporting frameworks, forms, data collection systems, or similar processes is an asset.
Strong storytelling skills and the ability to identify connections between different areas of an organization.
Fluent English is required; Spanish is an asset.

Title: User Researcher
Description:
About Dambuster Studios

Originally founded in 1999 as Free Radical Design our ambition and passion comes through as strongly now as when we first began. We are always seeking individuals who can emulate our values - passion, quality, and teamwork - which are embodied in our diverse and inclusive culture.

Even if you’re not sure that you meet all the criteria for a role, don’t be put off from applying - we want to hear from you. Our only requirement is that you work from the UK, and if you’re not here right now we can discuss relocation if the role requires you be on-site frequently (if the role requires this, it’s outlined in the advert below). Our internal Wellbeing Committee and Mental Health First Aiders help ensure that our diversity is championed in a safe environment in our city centre studio.

User Researcher

Dambuster Studios - creators of the number one BAFTA-nominated smash hit Dead Island 2 - has an exciting opportunity for a User Researcher to join our highly talented GamesLab team.

This is an exciting opportunity to grow your user research career in the games industry, work across multiple unreleased and unannounced titles and genres, and develop your practice with support from seasoned experts in a dedicated lab environment.

Please note:


We can only offer this role on a fully studio-based or hybrid basis. If hybrid, you must live within 50 miles of our studio or be willing to relocate to within 50 miles and be able to come into the studio three days per week as a minimum.
You will be required to be on site for the set-up and running of play tests.


Role Overview

We’re looking for someone curious, perceptive, and with a passion for gaming. Working closely with the Senior User Researchers and Data Science team, you will play a pivotal role in the design, implementation, and analysis of play tests across multiple titles. You will help shape study plans, facilitate play tests, analyse evidence, and produce actionable insights.

What We Can Offer You


Core hours 9.30am - 4pm, remaining hours worked flexibly
Relocation support to Nottingham, UK (if required)
Holiday allowance that increases with service (to a maximum of 30 days plus statutory public holidays)
Inclusion into the studio’s annual pay review (effective 1st July) following 12 months service
Company pension contribution that increases with service
Private Medical Insurance via AXA Health, including dental and optical cover
Life Assurance Scheme via Zurich (x3 salary cover)
Company enhanced full pay for maternity leave for the first 26 weeks (to qualifying expectant mothers)
Clear career progression within Dambuster Studios
Studio funded learning and development opportunities
Modern game development environment with the latest technologies
Vibrant, modern city centre location with good transport links
Travel Loan Scheme for Nottingham-based employees
Fully subsidised gym membership with Virgin gym (Nottingham)
Quarterly company funded cross-team events such as our Annual Christmas Party, Summer Family BBQ and Teambuilding activities
Free financial advice
Employee referral bonus scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Weekly office treats, including breakfast on Monday and pastries on Friday


Responsibilities


Define, with support, the objectives and focus of each user test.
Own, with support, the day-to-day planning and delivery of defined qualitative and quantitative research studies, including moderating tests, observing users, analysing findings, and preparing reports.
Own the technical set-up and smooth running of research sessions, as well as proactive maintenance of the lab space and equipment.
Support the development and maintenance of our recruitment database.
Continue to develop research competencies through working with and learning from teammates.
Contribute to improvements in research tools, processes, and practice; stay current with games user research, accessibility, data protection, and relevant industry developments.
Act as a representative of the lab and a research champion to maintain positive relationships with internal and external teams.


Requirements


2+ years of practical experience planning and conducting user research, using qualitative and quantitative methods in a professional, academic, or equivalent applied setting.
A passion for Video Games and the gaming industry.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport, establish credibility, and adapt communication across cultures.
Excellent written communication skills.
Curiosity, creativity, and enjoyment of solving complex issues.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel and PowerPoint).
Experience with survey design, user research, and user research theory and methodology (desirable)
Data analysis and visualisation experience (desirable)
Experience with PC gaming, video streaming and/ or editing (desirable)


Equal Opportunities Statement

Dambuster Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Anyone considering their next step in their career journey with Dambuster will receive consideration without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity or paternity, or membership in any other legally protected category. We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees, and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to apply.

We operate a transparent recruitment process that removes barriers for those who require reasonable adjustments. If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or onboarding process, or if you are successful in securing a position with us, please let us know what we can do to ensure your success.

PL/SQL

Title: Senior Technical Analyst - SAP
Description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to shape the future of SAP within a business that is transforming the way technology supports complex projects and operations? We're looking for a Senior Technical Analyst to help drive business improvement, platform modernisation, and the effective use of SAP and related manufacturing systems.

Laing O'Rourke's IT function has renewed its strategy to support the company's ambition to transform the construction industry, making it more sustainable, more productive, and fit for the future.

Technology has a critical role to play in achieving this ambition. Our focus is on applying digital capability in ways that genuinely matter, shaping how complex projects are delivered, how decisions are made, and how innovation improves outcomes for people, communities, and the environment.

Our mission is clear: to create a modern and resilient technology environment where trusted data informs every decision, AI enhances every process, and digital capability enables the organisation to operate with greater scale and productivity.

To deliver this, we are building a different kind of IT function, one that is trusted by the business, forward looking in its thinking, and deeply connected to operational outcomes. We are looking for individuals who are curious, thoughtful, and motivated by contributing to work that has real industry impact.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Technical Analyst, you'll play a key role in shaping how SAP supports business processes, service delivery, and operational performance across the organisation. Acting as the link between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, you'll translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions that deliver measurable value.

Working closely with platform owners, engineers, delivery partners, and business stakeholders, you'll help ensure SAP capabilities are used effectively, processes are simplified, and technology investments remain aligned to long-term business objectives.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and define business outcomes.
Translate business requirements into clear solution options, platform enhancements, and prioritised delivery plans.
Collaborate with SAP engineers and delivery teams to design solutions that maximise standard SAP functionality and minimise unnecessary customisation.
Support the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and requirements definition through to testing, deployment, and operational handover.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and optimise business processes across SAP and associated manufacturing systems.
Contribute to platform roadmaps, capability assessments, process models, governance activities, and future-state designs.
Ensure platform changes support operational readiness and can be effectively adopted by the business.
Promote continuous improvement and support the ongoing evolution of SAP capabilities across the organisation.


Essential Requirements


Strong experience working with SAP ECC6 and/or S/4HANA environments.
Proven expertise across key SAP modules such as SD, QM and PP.
Experience delivering SAP configuration, implementations, upgrades and enhancements.
Solid understanding of SAP technical components including ABAP, interfaces and custom development.
Experience translating business requirements into effective technology solutions and platform improvements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance business needs and technical considerations.
Understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, data flows, security considerations and platform dependencies.
Experience working with stakeholders across both business and IT functions.
Excellent communication, facilitation and documentation skills.


Desirable Requirements


Experience with additional SAP modules including WM, MM, PM, DMS, EPP, MPS, FI/CO or CATS.
Experience working within manufacturing, engineering, construction or other project-based organisations.
Knowledge of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Fiori and modern SAP architecture concepts.
Experience with SAP integration technologies, APIs, middleware and enterprise integration patterns.
Exposure to Manufacturing Systems, MES, shop-floor technology or operational technology environments.
Experience supporting digital transformation, platform modernisation or large-scale SAP programmes.
Relevant SAP certifications or business analysis qualifications.


What Makes This Role Compelling?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future direction of a critical enterprise platform while working at the intersection of business improvement and technology delivery. You'll influence platform strategy, contribute to digital transformation initiatives and help deliver solutions that improve productivity, standardisation and operational performance across the organisation.

You'll also have the opportunity to broaden your expertise across enterprise architecture, integrations, manufacturing systems, data and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled business capabilities.

About Laing O'Rourke

Laing O'Rourke is an international engineering and construction business known for pushing boundaries in digital engineering, modern methods of construction and sustainable delivery. With more than 150 years of heritage, we are committed to creating environments in which diverse teams can excel and thrive.

Accessibility & Inclusion

We are proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme. If you meet the essential criteria and would like to be considered through our Offer an Interview scheme, please let us know. We're also happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

If you require an alternative format of this advert or need support during the application, please contact: resourcingteam@laingorourke.com

Are you ready to make a difference? At Boots, we’re on the lookout for a Business Architect - Talent to join our dynamic HR team in Nottingham. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping our talent processes and driving meaningful change across the organisation.

As a Business Architect, you will work closely with the Talent Workstream Lead and Subject Matter Experts to ensure our business processes meet the evolving needs of our teams. You’ll be at the forefront of designing efficient processes that enhance our employee experience and support our commitment to building a brilliant Boots for our people.




Key responsibilities:

Working with Talent Workstream Lead and SMEs, ensure the business processes for the workstream and module meet business requirements
Work with the Lead Business Architect to ensure the E2E processes meet the requirements of the ToM and provide any potential impacts to the People Function Taxonomy
Supports the Workstream Lead with process design decisions ensuring integrity within the design
Involvement in design workshops to ensure the business needs are identified and met and change impacts are understood, identifying opportunities to remove process steps and implement process efficiencies ensuring standardization and consistency
Document future state processes and review and input into design configuration workbooks so that SOPs can be created

Knowledge of Talent, Performance and Succession processes
Ability to move between big picture and small detail over the duration of the project
Detail orientated
Ability to apply a user experience lens, keeping in mind user journey through process design
Excellent communication and collaboration skills – able to engage across multiple stakeholder groups within the programme and function
Critical thinker, willing to positively challenge with a view for process improvement
Ability to operate to tight deadlines
Experience of BPMN or previous process mapping is desirable




It would be great if you also have:

Experience in change management and training support
Familiarity with data migration and reporting processes




Where your brilliance can take you:

At Boots, we believe in your potential. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career within a supportive environment that champions learning and development. Your contributions will be valued, and you’ll be empowered to make a real impact.

Title: Forecasting Lead - Principal Associate
Description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Forecasting Lead - Principal Associate

About This Role

This is an exciting opportunity to manage a small but mighty team responsible for producing demand forecasting for our Customer Operations area. If you are experienced in using tools and techniques to manipulate data, managing others and interested in Forecasting and Planning, then please read on!

What You’ll Do


Lead a small team to cover the production of all forecasts across operations
Produce medium and long term customer demand forecasts for critical contact centre process areas and oversee the creation of back office operations forecasts
Play a lead role in the creation of our operations budgets and outlook refreshes with Finance, through the provision of future volume demand views
Utilise planning data, models and insight to provide compelling advice and recommendations
Maintain strong, collaborative relationships by engaging stakeholders to become a trusted partner of the operation
Continually improve the quality and accuracy of our forecasts by reviewing tools, assumptions, models and processes
Communicate capacity plan outputs in a simple, easy to understand way
Ensure the efficient and effective use of resources in line with agreed planning periods


What We’re Looking For


Experience of producing forecasts in an operational environment to deadlines
Understanding of complex models (Excel based) to enable a continuous improvement based approach and solve problems
Experience coaching and managing a small team to maintain engagement and good service to our customers
Fantastic stakeholder management skills and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and effectively


We are committed to creating a level playing field and seek to create teams that are representative of our customers and the communities we serve. We’d love to hear from you if you identify with a typically under-represented group in our industry and are particularly keen to hear from women and ethnic minority candidates.

Where And How You'll Work

This is a permanent position and will be based in our Nottingham offices.

Our flexible, hybrid working model gives you the opportunity to work both remotely and in our offices, which provide great spaces for in-person collaboration.

Our core office days are Tuesday to Thursday, but the number of days you actually spend in the office will be led by your team, the work you’re doing and your preferences. Many of our associates have flexible working patterns, so we’re open to discuss flexible working arrangements with you.

What’s In It For You


Bring us all this - and you’ll be well rewarded with a role contributing to the roadmap of an organisation committed to transformation
We offer high performers strong and diverse career progression, investing heavily in developing great people through our Capital One University training programmes (and appropriate external providers)
Immediate access to our core benefits including pension scheme, bonus, generous holiday entitlement and private medical insurance – with flexible benefits available including season-ticket loans, cycle to work scheme and enhanced parental leave
Open-plan workspaces and accessible facilities designed to inspire and support you. Our Nottingham head-office has a fully-serviced gym, subsidised restaurant, mindfulness and music rooms. In London, you can heighten your mood with a run on our rooftop running track or an espresso at the Workshop Coffee café


What You Should Know About How We Recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible. And we offer benefits that attract people at all ages and stages.

We Also Partner With Organisations Including The Women In Finance And Race At Work Charters, Stonewall And UpReach To Find People From Every Walk Of Life And Help Them Thrive With Us. We Have a Whole Host Of Internal Networks And Support Groups You Could Be Involved In, To Name a Few

Forecasting Lead - Principal Associate

About This Role

This is an exciting opportunity to manage a small but mighty team responsible for producing demand forecasting for our Customer Operations area. If you are experienced in using tools and techniques to manipulate data, managing others and interested in Forecasting and Planning, then please read on!

What You’ll Do

  • Lead a small team to cover the production of all forecasts across operations
  • Produce medium and long term customer demand forecasts for critical contact centre process areas and oversee the creation of back office operations forecasts
  • Play a lead role in the creation of our operations budgets and outlook refreshes with Finance, through the provision of future volume demand views
  • Utilise planning data, models and insight to provide compelling advice and recommendations
  • Maintain strong, collaborative relationships by engaging stakeholders to become a trusted partner of the operation
  • Continually improve the quality and accuracy of our forecasts by reviewing tools, assumptions, models and processes
  • Communicate capacity plan outputs in a simple, easy to understand way
  • Ensure the efficient and effective use of resources in line with agreed planning periods

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience of producing forecasts in an operational environment to deadlines
  • Understanding of complex models (Excel based) to enable a continuous improvement based approach and solve problems
  • Experience coaching and managing a small team to maintain engagement and good service to our customers
  • Fantastic stakeholder management skills and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and effectively

We are committed to creating a level playing field and seek to create teams that are representative of our customers and the communities we serve. We’d love to hear from you if you identify with a typically under-represented group in our industry and are particularly keen to hear from women and ethnic minority candidates.

Where And How You'll Work

This is a permanent position and will be based in our Nottingham offices.

Our flexible, hybrid working model gives you the opportunity to work both remotely and in our offices, which provide great spaces for in-person collaboration.

Our core office days are Tuesday to Thursday, but the number of days you actually spend in the office will be led by your team, the work you’re doing and your preferences. Many of our associates have flexible working patterns, so we’re open to discuss flexible working arrangements with you.

What’s In It For You

  • Bring us all this - and you’ll be well rewarded with a role contributing to the roadmap of an organisation committed to transformation
  • We offer high performers strong and diverse career progression, investing heavily in developing great people through our Capital One University training programmes (and appropriate external providers)
  • Immediate access to our core benefits including pension scheme, bonus, generous holiday entitlement and private medical insurance – with flexible benefits available including season-ticket loans, cycle to work scheme and enhanced parental leave
  • Open-plan workspaces and accessible facilities designed to inspire and support you. Our Nottingham head-office has a fully-serviced gym, subsidised restaurant, mindfulness and music rooms. In London, you can heighten your mood with a run on our rooftop running track or an espresso at the Workshop Coffee café
